article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو قد يفوق الأرقام الرسمية بأربعة أضعاف - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in Congo could exceed official figures by four times - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the true scale of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be two to four times higher than official figures, reflecting transmission-tracing challenges. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO's emergency chief, said about 80% of new infections are not linked to known cases, signaling broad community transmission, especially in Ituri Province. Official tallies report 1,792 cases and 625 deaths, with about 90% of cases concentrated in Ituri and the outbreak extending to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Laboratory results from Bunia show high positivity rates, indicating sustained transmission despite progress in containment elsewhere. No details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行は公式統計の4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行規模が公式統計より大幅に過小評価されている可能性を警告しており、新規感染の8割が感染経路不明という広範な市中感染を示唆する重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事案。
triage.notes: 新規感染の約80%が既知の感染者と関連付けられず、追跡不能な市中感染が拡大している点が特に懸念される。Ituri州が中心だが北キブ・南キブ・チョポ州にも拡大しており、WHOによる公式集計の過小評価警告は流行制御の困難さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: الخارجية الصينية: وصول فريق من الخبراء الطبيين الصينيين إلى أوغندا للمساعدة في مكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese Foreign Ministry: A team of Chinese medical experts has arrived in Uganda to help combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response in Africa: China has dispatched another team of medical experts to Kampala, Uganda, to assist the country’s response. Acknowledging an ongoing outbreak, the arrival follows earlier missions that sent two Chinese teams to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ugandan team has held exchanges with local health authorities and medical research institutions and supported the World Health Organization–Africa CDC Ebola Incident Management Team. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning stated Beijing’s continued readiness to help African nations according to on-the-ground needs and capacities, with ongoing cooperation to accelerate outbreak control. No case counts were cited. The move underscores international collaboration and capacity-building to curb Ebola in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 中国外交部:エボラ対策支援のため中国人医療専門家チームがウガンダに到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行に対し中国が医療支援チームを派遣しており、WHO・アフリカCDCも関与する国際的対応が進行中であるため、IHR基準複数該当としてフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダにおけるエボラ対応への中国の医療支援だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。以前DRCにも中国チームが派遣された旨の記述があり、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。症例数などの詳細情報は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: 648 νεκροί σε 1.830 επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: 648 dead in 1,830 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola has reached 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15, according to authorities. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with transmission ongoing as of 2026-07-11. Ebola virus disease is known for hemorrhagic fever. The article notes that the deadliest DR Congo outbreak occurred in 2018–2020, with about 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 cases. No details are provided on laboratory confirmation or imported/exported cases in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行:確定症例1,830件中648人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く(約35%)、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチンや治療法がないブンディブギョ株での大規模流行であり、2018-2020年の大流行に次ぐ規模となっている点に留意。続報でヒト-ヒト感染の広がりや国際対応状況を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: inquiétudes après la découverte de quatre cas d'Ebola à Kisangani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Concerns following the discovery of four Ebola cases in Kisangani.
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola cases have been confirmed in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo, with two fatalities and two patients currently isolated and treated. The first two cases involve women who worked in mining areas near Nyanya, Ituri; one was pregnant, and laboratory testing confirmed Ebola. A third Kisangani case is a patient who had escaped after a fire at a treatment center in PK50, Ituri, about ten days earlier. The fourth is a police officer infected in Nia-Nia before arriving in Kisangani. Authorities are conducting exhaustive contact tracing and expanding surveillance in Tshopo to prevent further spread into this large city near Ituri. Entry-point controls and case management are being reinforced to limit risky movements. Ituri still accounts for more than 90% of cases concentrated in five to six health zones, as of 11 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:キサンガニで新たに4件のエボラ症例が確認され懸念広がる
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤感染症がイトゥリ州から人口密集都市キサンガニへ拡大しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）が複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 南スーダンが発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及がなく除外。イトゥリ州が依然として症例の90%以上を占めるが、大都市キサンガニへの拡大が新たな懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 1 830 cas et 648 décès au 9 juillet, l'Ituri atteint 25 zones de santé touchées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 1,830 cases and 648 deaths as of July 9, Ituri has reached 25 affected health zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths as of July 9, 2026, across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with a 35.4% fatality. Ituri remains the epicenter, with 25 of 36 health zones affected; Boga in Irumu reports its first confirmed case, linked to a patient from Bunia, raising cross-border transmission concerns. North Kivu has 11 zones affected; Kisangani in Tshopo records two cases (one linked to Nia-Nia) and two cases imported in Wamba, Haut-Uele. South Kivu has three cases and one death in Miti-Murhesa, with over 42 days without a new confirmed case, signaling possible end of transmission there. A health meeting in Bunia addressed payroll delays; WHO cites 1,561 cases and 506 deaths (as of July 7), with Bundibugyo having no licensed vaccine or treatment. A July 2 trial tests MBP134 and remdesivir; neither validated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：7月9日時点で1,830症例、648死亡。イトゥリ州では25の保健地区が影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 致死率35.4%の大規模エボラ流行がコンゴ民主共和国の複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）で継続しており、国境を越えた伝播懸念もあることからIHR基準複数該当・WHO監視下のシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo（ウガンダ）は記事中でワクチン・治療薬未承認地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダへの越境伝播懸念は記載あるが確定症例の言及なし。WHO報告値（1,561例、506死亡、7月7日時点）と現地報告値に差異あり、続報要確認。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا إلى 1830 حالة وتسجيل 648 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola cases rise to 1,830 with 648 deaths recorded.
article.articleSummary: On 11 July 2026, health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report a rise in laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections to 1,830, with 648 deaths among the infected. The ministry notes that this current outbreak wave exhibits a high fatality rate, underscoring the severity of the ongoing epidemic in the country. The update indicates continued transmission and mortality, though it does not detail geographic hotspots within DR Congo, sources of infection, or public health measures underway. No information is provided about vaccination efforts or international assistance in the briefing. The figures emphasize the urgent need for sustained outbreak response, surveillance, and access to care to reduce deaths and curb spread in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ感染者数1,830人に上昇、死者648人を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で致死率が高く（約35%）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準を複数満たしPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 感染者1,830人、死者648人（致死率約35.4%）と非常に高い致死率を示しており、深刻なエボラ流行が継続中。地理的詳細、感染源、対応策、ワクチン接種状況、国際支援の有無は記事内に情報なし。続報でこれらの詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو يفوق الأرقام الرسمية بأربعة أضعاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is fourfold higher than official figures.
article.articleSummary: On 11 July 2026, the World Health Organization warns that the true scale of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be two to four times higher than official counts. WHO Emergency Director Chikwe Ihekweazu says about 80% of new infections have no link to known cases, indicating widespread community transmission, notably in Ituri province. Government data show 1,792 cases and 625 deaths, with around 90% of all cases concentrated in Ituri and the outbreak extending to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Laboratory results from Bunia city reveal high positivity rates, reflecting ongoing transmission despite some containment progress in other areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、公式数値の4倍に達する恐れ
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染拡大（公式数値の2〜4倍、症例の80%が感染経路不明）を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案である。
triage.notes: 症例の80%が既知の感染者と関連がなく、地域社会での広範な伝播が示唆されている。イトゥリ州が中心だが北キブ、南キブ、ツショピ州にも拡大しており、致死率は約35%（625/1792）と高い。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: 648 θάνατοι επί συνόλου 1.830 επιβεβαιωμένων κρουσμάτων
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 648 deaths out of 1,830 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, there are 1,830 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 648 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to authorities releasing the latest tally. This outbreak is the DR Congo's 17th Ebola event and was declared on May 15; it is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved therapy. Ebola hemorrhagic fever has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades. The most deadly DR Congo outbreak occurred from 2018 to 2020, with nearly 2,300 deaths among about 3,500 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱流行:確定症例1,830例中648人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(確定1,830例、死亡648例、致死率約35%)であり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株によるものでIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: DRCで17回目のエボラ流行、ブンディブギョ株によるもの。ワクチン・承認済み治療法がなく致死率が高い。国際的な支援や監視が必要とされる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca sốt xuất huyết ở Đắk Lắk tăng hơn 150% trong nửa đầu năm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cases in Đắk Lắk Province rise by more than 150% in the first half of the year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Đắk Lắk Province has surged by 154% in the first half of 2026, with 1,518 cases across 14 outbreaks and more than 210 cases treated at health facilities in the past week. Hotspots include Tuy Hòa Ward, Buôn Ma Thuột City, and the communes of Phú Hòa, Đồng Xuân, Sông Hinh, Krông Ana, Ea Súp, and Ea H'leo. The Đắk Lắk CDC notes intensified collaboration with local health services to curb transmission during the rainy-season peak, prioritizing vector control, sanitation, and public awareness. Measures include removing mosquito breeding sites, chemical spraying, larviciding at outbreak sites, and enhanced training for frontline health workers to bolster surveillance and rapid response. Separately, Gia Lai province reported its first dengue-related death in 2026, a 27-year-old man with underlying conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省のデング熱患者数、上半期に150%以上増加
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダクラク省で雨季に伴うデング熱患者の季節的増加が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、地域当局による通常のベクター対策で対応可能な状況であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの雨季における季節性感染症であり、Đắk Lắk省及びGia Lai省での死亡例報告があるが、国レベルでのCDCによる対応（防除・啓発活動）が進行中。国際的な波及の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo continues to outpace response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus persists with 1,792 confirmed infections and 625 deaths (case fatality ~34%). Ituri province remains the epicenter; a WHO official says 80% of new infections are not on any contact list, indicating largely undetected spread. Modeling and test positivity suggest true cases could be two to four times higher than confirmed. Health workers are heavily affected: 112 infected, 32 dead; response is hampered by conflict, inadequate contact tracing, and strikes over unpaid benefits. Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths. The outbreak is described as Africa’s fastest-growing and the continent’s third largest on record, potentially surpassing 2014–2016 West Africa and the 2018 DRC outbreaks. No approved vaccines or Bundibugyo-specific treatments; two antivirals MBP134 and remdesivir are in early trials at one site, with plans to expand to 10 sites.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、対応能力を上回るペースで拡大継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(1792例、死亡625例)で国際的拡大(ウガンダにも波及)、80%が接触者リスト外という制御不能な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・アンゴラも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに該当なし。記事の主題はDRC(イツリ州)のエボラ流行であり、ウガンダへの波及は言及されるものの対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン未承認、治療薬も試験段階で管理可能性に深刻な懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Fourth DR Congo province officially declares Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 11 July 2026, Haut-Uele province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo became the country’s fourth province to officially declare an Ebola outbreak. The declaration followed confirmation by the National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB) that seven fatal Bundibugyo Ebola cases were recorded in the Wamba health zone. Provincial Governor Jean Bakomito Gambu announced the outbreak in a statement issued by his communications office after INRB’s Thursday confirmation of the seven deaths. This marks the fourth province to declare an Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ、エボラ出血熱の発生を公式宣言した4番目の州
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）による死亡例が確認され、DRCで4番目の州が公式に発生を宣言しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ拡大の懸念があるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既に複数州でエボラ発生が宣言されており、国内での拡大が継続している点に注意。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Testing drugs that could treat dengue
article.articleSummary: Two potential dengue drugs are moving toward trials as the Dengue Alliance (DNDi) with Brazil, India, Malaysia, and Thailand targets antivirals and host-directed therapies to curb severe inflammation. Dengue remains without a direct cure; current care is supportive. The virus stays in the body about 10 days, with fever lasting roughly 4–5 days after onset, making early treatment crucial. Severe disease often results from the inflammatory response, causing plasma leakage and circulatory shock after the virus is cleared. The Alliance plans to test two candidates by 2027. One is a monoclonal antibody developed by Serum Institute of India, to be trialed in India and at alliance sites; Malaysia coordinates trials via the Health Ministry, with Hospital Raja Permaisuri Bainun in Ipoh as a primary site and other clinics. IV administration takes about an hour for dengue patients aged five and up. The aim is to reduce complications, deaths, and downtime.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱治療薬の治験
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の新規発生や流行拡大を報じるものではなく、治療薬候補の臨床試験計画に関する研究開発ニュースであり、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はDengue Alliance（DNDi）によるデング熱治療薬候補（モノクローナル抗体等）の臨床試験計画に関するもので、実際の患者急増や流行状況を報じる内容ではない。マレーシアも試験拠点として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يودي بحياة 648 شخصا في الكونغو والإصابات تتجاوز 1800 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims 648 lives in Congo, with infections exceeding 1,800.
article.articleSummary: From Kinshasa on July 11, authorities report that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 648 people and infected 1,830 confirmed cases, as of Thursday. Government data released Friday evening indicate that these totals reflect the full toll accumulated, including the most recent 24-hour period. Health authorities are continuing to monitor transmission and intensify containment efforts to limit spread. The report provides no specifics on clinical symptoms, infection sources, laboratory confirmation beyond the label 'confirmed,' or the geographic distribution within the country. The figures underscore a sustained outbreak in the DRC, with ongoing public-health measures and surveillance aimed at curbing further infections and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴで648人の死者、感染者は1800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(死亡648人、感染1830人)であり、重篤な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率が約35%と高く、感染規模も大きいため、フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。地理的分布や感染源についての情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يودي بحياة 648 شخصا في الكونغو والإصابات تتجاوز 1800 حالة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims 648 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and infections exceed 1,800 cases - Ardo Point
article.articleSummary: Ebola claims 648 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1,830 confirmed infections reported as of Thursday, according to government data released Friday evening. The Kinshasa-based update notes these figures cover the full 24-hour period and reflect ongoing transmission as health authorities intensify containment efforts. The report indicates the outbreak remains under close surveillance, with authorities continuing to monitor the situation and implement containment measures to curb spread. The information underscores a persistent outbreak in the DRC as of July 11, 2026, with public health authorities actively tracking developments. The report offers no further details on infection sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で648人死亡、感染者数1,800人超え
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者648人・感染者1,830人と重篤な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 感染源や輸入/輸出症例に関する詳細情報は記事に記載なし。続報でWHO対応状況や国際的拡大リスクの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: خبراء صينيون يصلون أوغندا لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese experts arrive in Uganda to confront an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response in Uganda receives international support as Chinese experts arrive in Kampala to assist Uganda's measures against the ongoing Ebola outbreak. The team, announced by Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning, traveled to Uganda at Kampala's invitation to contribute expertise and guidance for local response. China notes prior deployments of two expert teams to the Democratic Republic of Congo, which were acknowledged positively by authorities. The new Chinese contingent held meetings with Ugandan health authorities, medical and research institutions, and collaborated with the World Health Organization’s Ebola incident management support team and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention to align support with local needs. China commits to continuing assistance to African countries within its capabilities to help contain Ebola and limit its spread.

triage.headline_ja: 中国人専門家チームがウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行対応のため到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤かつ異常な公衆衛生イベントであり、既に中国・WHO・アフリカCDCなど国際的な支援体制が動いていることから国際的関心・拡大リスクが高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダにおける進行中のエボラ出血熱流行への中国専門家派遣であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCへの言及は過去の専門家派遣に関する文脈であり、現在の流行地点ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: DR CONGO-BUNIA-EBOLA OUTBREAK-EPIDEMIC CONTROL
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains in a 'very active' phase and has not yet peaked, health authorities said July 11, 2026. In Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, a medical worker disinfected before burying a deceased person infected with the Ebola virus on July 9, 2026. The Kinshasa report describes ongoing transmission and persistent outbreak-control measures amid the active situation. No case counts or deaths are provided in this brief. The article offers a frontline snapshot of responses, including disinfection and safe burial protocols, as authorities continue surveillance and containment efforts in Bunia and wider Ituri Province as of mid-July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国ブニア：エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク・流行制御
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な人-人感染が確認され「非常に活発」な段階にあり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡者数は本記事に記載なし。継続監視と続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Туристам в Азии рассказали, как снизить риск заражения лихорадкой денге

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Στους 648 οι θάνατοι από την επιδημία Έμπολα - 1830 τα κρούσματα

article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 1,830 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus cases have been reported, with 648 deaths, as of May 15 when the outbreak was declared. The most deadly DRC outbreak occurred during 2018–2020, resulting in about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. Authorities have released daily tallies, noting ongoing transmission. The report underscores the absence of a vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo and highlights the public health challenge posed by this strain.

article.articleHeadline: Chuyên gia cảnh báo về gánh nặng khó lường do sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại Đồng Nai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn of the unpredictable burden caused by dengue fever in Dong Nai
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Dong Nai, Vietnam, remains a major concern amid the monsoon. By end-June 2026, Dong Nai reported 4,413 dengue cases, down 24.8% year-on-year, yet monthly cases rose to 527 in June, up about 30% from May. The province leads national dengue deaths, accounting for 3 of 7 fatalities since January. Contributing factors include its border proximity to Ho Chi Minh City, dense transport networks, numerous industrial zones and crowded accommodations, plus construction-site pits and standing water that foster Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and virus transmission. Early dengue presents like flu; by days 3–7, defervescence may herald severe complications (shock, hemorrhage, multi-organ failure). Warning signs include lethargy, reduced urination, severe abdominal or hepatic pain, skin rash, and cold extremities. Healthcare burden is high: 10,000+ outpatient visits annually, ~3,000 hospitalizations, ~1,000 severe cases with organ involvement; costs for severe cases can reach 200–750 million VND. An ongoing June 2026 public health talk emphasizes prevention and early treatment.

article.articleHeadline: Cuộc chiến chống lao gặp khó vì nhiều người không biết mình nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fight against tuberculosis faces difficulties because many people do not know they are infected.
article.articleSummary: TB remains a major public health challenge as the world aims to end TB by 2030. At APAC-IRIDS 2026 in Thailand, experts warn millions are missed annually; about one-quarter of the population carries latent TB bacteria. In 2024, TB reached 10.7 million cases, with 1.1 million deaths and 2.4 million undiagnosed or unreported; Asia-Pacific region accounted for 6.6 million cases (61%). Late detection and reliance on older tests allow ongoing transmission, including drug-resistant TB. Expanded molecular testing and rapid diagnostics are needed. Preventive strategies must scale up, especially for high-risk groups (household contacts, children under five, people living with HIV, the immunocompromised, diabetics) and latent infection treatment. Many carriers are asymptomatic; chest X-rays can be normal. Integrated screening for TB with HIV, hepatitis C, and diabetes, plus AI-assisted radiology, could shorten diagnosis, but resources, infrastructure, and workforce gaps persist, notably in Pakistan and Indonesia, amid climate-related access challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 結核との闘い、多くの感染者が自身の感染に気づいていないため困難に直面
triage.triage_reason: 内容はアジア太平洋地域における結核対策の一般的な課題・学会報告であり、特定の突発的アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は学会(APAC-IRIDS 2026、タイで開催)における結核の世界的・地域的状況報告。パキスタンとインドネシアのリソース・インフラ課題に言及があるが、対象国リストにパキスタンは含まれないため除外。既存の慢性的公衆衛生課題であり、緊急性の高いシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: पशुपालक रहें सतर्क, इस मौसम में भेड़-बकरियों पर मंडरा रहा 'मुफला रोग' का खतरा!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Livestock owners, stay vigilant; this season the threat of 'Mufla disease' looms over sheep and goats!
article.articleSummary: Monsoon season, while beneficial for farming, calls for heightened vigilance by livestock keepers. Increased rain and humidity contribute to the rapid spread of several infectious diseases among sheep and goats, with Mufla disease identified as the principal threat. Mufla is a viral infectious disease that starts in one or two animals within a flock and can swiftly spread to the entire herd. Without timely identification and preventive measures, livestock owners are at risk of substantial economic losses. The article stresses early recognition of symptoms and precautionary actions during this period to curb outbreaks and safeguard flock health.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜飼育者は警戒を、この季節に羊・ヤギに『ムフラ病』の脅威が迫る！
triage.triage_reason: 羊・ヤギを対象とした動物疾患（ムフラ病）に関する季節的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な発生報告や人への健康影響は確認されない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物（羊・ヤギ）の疾患に関する季節的注意喚起記事であり、具体的な発生事例の報告ではないため、対象国リストへの計上は見送り。人獣共通感染症としての言及もなし。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikansk hjälparbetare smittad av ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American aid worker infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Kongo-Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has tested positive for Ebola, according to the US CDC. The CDC is coordinating with the patient’s employer, other U.S. federal agencies, Congolese health authorities, and partners in Kongo-Kinshasa to prevent further transmission. The World Health Organization reported earlier in the week that the Ebola outbreak death toll has reached 600. The current outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment. The report provides no details on symptom onset or exposure history beyond the confirmed infection. The case underscores ongoing international public health coordination to monitor and respond to the outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人援助従事者がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大（米国人感染者）が確認されており、死亡者数600人に達する大規模アウトブレイクで、ワクチン・治療法が存在しない変異株によるものであるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大の証拠として記載。ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、死者600人という重大な公衆衛生上の影響がある。

article.articleHeadline: Cuarta provincia de RD de Congo es oficialmente afectada por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fourth province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo is officially affected by an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Alto Uele province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has become the fourth province officially affected by the Ebola outbreak after seven deaths were confirmed in the Wamba health zone, per INIB. Gov. Jean Bakomito Gambu declared the outbreak in Alto Uele following confirmation of seven fatalities tied to the Bundibugyo strain. The current outbreak had previously been reported in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with alerts in Pawa and Boma Mangbetu health zones and Isiro, the provincial capital. Epidemiological data show 1,792 confirmed cases across the three main affected provinces, including 625 deaths and 295 recoveries. The governor urged residents to stay calm and act responsibly, avoiding panic and misinformation. (As of 11 July 2026)

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の第4州が正式にエボラ出血熱の流行に見舞われる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国内で第4の州に拡大し、累計1,792症例・625死亡という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: エボラはBundibugyo株。既にイトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州で確認されており、今回アルトウエレ州が第4の州として追加。致死率が高く(625/1792)、複数州にまたがる拡大が続いている点で懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva casos de ébola a 1.830 y 648 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises Ebola cases to 1,830 and 648 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 10, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,830 confirmed Ebola cases and 648 deaths (case fatality rate 34.1%), with 764 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 295 recoveries. Contact tracing stands at 78.6%. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu and South Kivu, with investigations ongoing for two cases detected in Kisangani, Tshopo. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in Ituri, a border province with Uganda and South Sudan. The virus has spread to Uganda, with 20 confirmed infections, including 15 imported from the DRC and two deaths among them. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with a 30–50% fatality range and no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea and internal bleeding. It is the third-worst Ebola epidemic and seventeenth outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数を1,830人、死者648人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で大規模に拡大し（1,830症例、648死亡）、ウガンダへの国際拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境リスクが指摘されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、致死率30-50%のBundibugyo株による第17回目のDRC国内アウトブレイクであり、史上3番目の規模とされる重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikaan in Congo besmet met ebolavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American in Congo infected with Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: An American in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has contracted Ebola virus disease. The U.S. CDC is coordinating with the patient’s employer, other U.S. government agencies, and Congolese partners to prevent further transmission and identify high‑risk contacts; no information on the patient’s clinical status has been released. Congolese authorities report 1,830 confirmed Ebola infections caused by the Bundibugyo variant, with 648 fatalities among those cases. The report notes laboratory confirmation of Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease but provides no details on the infection source or exposure timeline. Response efforts focus on containment, contact tracing, and multinational collaboration to curb spread. This article highlights the ongoing Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in Congo and international public health coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでアメリカ人がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株エボラの大規模流行（確定1,830例、死亡648例）が継続中であり、米国人感染者も確認され国際的拡大の懸念があるため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。致死率は約35%と高く、感染拡大・国際協調の動向を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: До 648 человек увеличилось число жертв лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola virus disease in DR Congo has risen to 648.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths as of July 11, 2026, per government data. About 90% of registered cases are in Ituri Province, with ongoing transmission in Bunia and the districts of Rwampara, Mongbwalu, and Nyakunde. Transmission continues to spread in these areas, and total confirmed cases have surpassed 1,700. WHO officials say the situation remains unstable with ongoing spread. The article also references discussions about unapproved WHO therapies and a Russian vaccine. The Guardian’s June 6 report is cited, noting US CDC concerns that the outbreak could follow a dangerous trajectory, potentially reaching up to 20,000 cases, akin to the 2014 epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の死者数が648人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで1,830例・648人の死者を出し拡大継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイツリ州（ブニア、ムンババロ、ニャクンデ等）での流行拡大を主題としている。ルワンダ（Kigali Province）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及されていないため除外。CDCは最悪2万例に達する可能性を懸念しており、2014年流行に匹敵する規模との指摘あり。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от Эболы в ДР Конго увеличилось до 648 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 648.
article.articleSummary: On 11 July 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 648 people and infected 1,830, according to Reuters citing the DRC Ministry of Communications. The updated tally shows an increase from 625 deaths previously reported. Five eastern regions of the DRC are affected. The outbreak continues to drive regional health concerns. The UN Development Programme projects that, under a worst-case scenario, the epidemic could cause up to $3.6 billion in economic damage across African economies, with spillover effects for neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の死者数が648人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部5地域で継続的に拡大し、死者648人・感染者1,830人と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、周辺国への波及と経済的損失の懸念もあるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 国連開発計画（UNDP）が最悪シナリオで最大36億ドルの経済損失と近隣諸国への波及を予測しており、地域的な公衆衛生・経済リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikansk hjälparbetare smittad av ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American aid worker infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, an American citizen employed by a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has been infected with Ebola, per the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). The CDC states it is collaborating with the employer and local health authorities to prevent further transmission. The World Health Organization (WHO) reports more than 600 deaths in the ongoing Ebola outbreak. The article provides limited clinical detail beyond the infection and containment measures, with no information on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or the exact infection source beyond exposure in the DRC. There is no information about export or additional suspected cases. The report underscores continued risk to international aid workers and the need for coordinated public health responses in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人援助従事者がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイクで600人以上の死者が出ており、米国人援助従事者への感染が確認されたことは国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示すため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（600人以上死亡）が主題であり、米国人援助従事者の感染はその文脈における個別症例。

article.articleHeadline: Jovem de 28 anos morre em Iconha com suspeita de dengue hemorrágica - Folha BJI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 28-year-old dies in Iconha with suspected dengue hemorrhagic fever - Folha BJI.
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old Alana Grassi died in Iconha, in southern Espírito Santo, Brazil, amid a suspected dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF). Her family reports symptoms compatible with DHF, but official confirmation awaits laboratory results and a statement from the Secretaria de Saúde. She first sought care at Iconha's Pronto Atendimento and was transferred to the Santa Casa de Misericórdia de Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, the regional reference hospital, where she died despite medical efforts. As of now, there is no confirmed DHF diagnosis; the case is under investigation. Grassi leaves two young daughters, and her death prompted widespread mourning in Iconha, with tributes from relatives, friends, and residents. The article notes ongoing tests and official health authorities' confirmation pending.

triage.headline_ja: イコーニャで28歳の女性がデング出血熱疑いで死亡 - Folha BJI
triage.triage_reason: 単一の死亡例で診断は未確定（検査結果待ち）。ブラジルではデング熱は流行地域であり、この一例のみでは異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは低いが、重症死亡例として続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 診断は未確定であり、地元コミュニティでの反響は大きいが公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は限定的。デング出血熱としての確定検査結果と地域での症例数増加の有無を継続的に確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria claims Class V student's life in Odisha's Malkangiri ashram school hostel
article.articleSummary: Malaria killed Abhilash Muduli, a Class V pupil at Sindhiguda Ashram School in Khairput, Malkangiri district, Odisha. The Bamera village resident developed fever and vomiting, tested positive for malaria at Kudumulugumma Community Health Centre on July 8, and received the first anti-malarial dose there. He was later returned to the school hostel, where a second dose was given the following day; a third dose was due at the school that day. Despite his father Dina Muduli’s request to take him home, authorities kept him at the hostel as treatment continued. On Friday morning, July 10, 2026, Abhilash’s condition worsened and he died around 11 am during treatment at Kudumulugumma CHC. District welfare officer A Srinivas Achary confirmed malaria and noted the death occurred under treatment; officials from ST & SC Development Department and police attended, with the body handed to the family after formalities.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州マルカンギリ県のアシュラム学校寮でマラリアにより5年生の生徒が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単発のマラリア死亡例であり、地域的流行拡大や異常性を示す情報がなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念も見られない。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの当該地域で流行性疾患であり、単発の学校寮での死亡例。地域的アウトブレイクや異常発生を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo tuyên bố thêm địa phương bùng phát dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo declares additional localities with Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in Haut-Uele, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, after 7 deaths attributed to Bundibugyo Ebola virus. This marks the fourth province affected alongside Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. INRB confirmed seven deaths in the Wamba health zone on July 9, with a governor's declaration of the outbreak across Haut-Uele. Suspected cases have been detected in Pawa, Boma Mangbetu, and the city of Isiro, capital of Haut-Uele. As of July 9, DRC has reported 1,792 Ebola cases, 625 deaths, and 295 recoveries. UNICEF warns the eastern outbreak could worsen a severe humanitarian crisis unless international response also maintains essential health services and other disease programs. UNICEF Africa regional director Gilles Fagninou notes rapid transmission; fear reducing births in health facilities from about 130 to ~30 monthly in affected areas illustrates deteriorating trust in health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行地域がさらに拡大したと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が第4の州（Haut-Uele）に拡大し、累計1,792例・625死亡と規模が大きく、人道危機悪化の懸念もあるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: UNICEFが国際支援の必要性と保健施設への信頼低下による二次的な健康被害の可能性を指摘している。continued monitoring for further province expansion recommended.

article.articleHeadline: Kolejna epidemia Eboli. Wskaźnik śmiertelności to 50%. Ponad tysiąc chorych
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another Ebola epidemic. The case fatality rate is 50%. More than a thousand cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) with no approved therapy or vaccine. As of July 10, 2026, 1,759 laboratory-confirmed cases and 600 deaths in the DRC; 20 cases and 2 deaths reported in Uganda. The epidemic, unfolding in North Kivu, Ituri, and South Kivu amid regional conflict and displacement, is fueled by poor sanitation, malnutrition, malaria, and distrust of aid organizations. A prevalent theory points to a 44-year-old Congolese pastor; a funeral coffin incident in Mongbwalu and subsequent transmission contributed to early deaths. A doctor returning from DRC in Europe sparked sensational coverage; WHO flags very high risk in DRC and high risk in Uganda and neighboring countries. Past outbreaks (2014-2016 West Africa; 2018 DRC) and the 2020 approval of Imazeb provide context, and no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo. WHO and Brazil urge full Pandemic Accord implementation.

triage.headline_ja: 続くエボラ流行。致死率は50%、患者は1000人以上。
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が大規模流行し致死率約50%、隣国ウガンダにも拡大しWHOが最高レベルのリスク評価を出しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダやアンゴラ、ブラジルも発生地域に含まれていたが、記事の主題としての感染発生国はDRCのみ（ウガンダは対象国リスト外、ブラジルはPandemic Accord実施の文脈で言及されたのみで発生国ではない）。ヨーロッパへの帰国医師についても記載あるが対象国リストに該当なし。渡航・貿易制限については記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva casos de ébola a 1.830 y 648 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises Ebola cases to 1,830 and 648 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths (case fatality rate 34.1%), with 764 in isolation/hospitalization and 295 recovered as of July 10, 2026. Contact tracing stands at 78.6%. The outbreak is centered in Ituri (epicenter) and the North and South Kivu provinces, with two Kisangani cases under investigation in Tshopo. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the epidemic has spread to Uganda, reporting 20 confirmed infections (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. The circulating Bundibugyo strain carries a typical fatality rate of 30–50% and lacks an approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, hemorrhagic symptoms, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. It marks the third-worst Ebola outbreak and the seventeenth to affect the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数を1,830人、死者648人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、致死率34.1%、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Baguio records 41 COVID-19 cases
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-11, Baguio City reports 41 COVID-19 cases, with the majority among healthcare workers and hospital staff, while the general public is largely unaffected. All reported cases are mild, and there is no cause for alarm. The City Health Services Office (CHSO) and hospitals are closely monitoring conditions within health facilities and will reinforce protective measures in hospitals. Authorities urge continued vigilance and adherence to simple precautions: wearing masks in crowded places, washing hands regularly, and staying home when sick. Health facilities are described as safe and fully capable of serving the community. Timely updates will be provided as needed, with Magalong calling for calm and confidence as the situation is managed.

triage.headline_ja: バギオ市、COVID-19の41症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 軽症例のみで公衆への影響は限定的、当局も「懸念なし」と明言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当が乏しい。
triage.notes: 医療従事者中心の軽症例クラスターであり、既知の疾患(COVID-19)の通常範囲内の変動と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Туристам на Мальдивах рассказали, как не заразиться лихорадкой денге
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tourists in the Maldives were told how to avoid dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk advised for tourists in the Maldives as cases rise on the Raa, Kaafu, and Baa atolls. Russian consulate in the Maldives, citing RIA Novosti, urged travelers to guard against bites: apply repellents, wear long-sleeved clothing, choose air-conditioned lodging with mosquito nets, ensure regular insecticide treatment of the surroundings, and avoid standing water. The note adds that dengue is present in South and Southeast Asia and other tropical regions, with infection possible from a single mosquito bite. Additionally, Rosppotrebnadzor warns that dengue on Bali, Indonesia, may masquerade as flu. Emphasis is on personal protection to reduce transmission risk for travelers to tropical regions.

triage.headline_ja: モルディブの観光客にデング熱感染を防ぐ方法が伝えられる
triage.triage_reason: モルディブでの季節的なデング熱流行に関する旅行者向け一般的注意喚起記事であり、対象国における新規性・異常性・重大な公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はモルディブでの旅行者向けデング熱注意喚起であり、モルディブは対象国リストに含まれない。バリ島(インドネシア)への言及は副次的な一般情報（デング熱がインフルエンザに似ているという注意喚起）であり、具体的な発生状況の報告ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 648 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 648.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has driven the death toll to 648, with 625 deaths reported the previous day, according to a situation report detailing confirmed infections and fatalities in the last 24 hours. Health Minister Roger Kamba said authorities have widened the officially affected areas to include the northern Chobo and Haut-Uele provinces. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with regional risk assessed as high. The update underscores ongoing international concern and the need for heightened surveillance, rapid case finding, isolation, and cross-border vigilance to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、648人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのエボラ流行で死者数が急増しており、複数州への拡大と越境リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: ಬೆಳ್ಳಾರೆ: ಮಲೇರಿಯಾ ಹಾಗೂ ಡೆಂಗ್ಯೂ ವಿರೋಧಿ ಮಾಸಚಾರಣೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಗಾರ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bellare: Workshop on a mass campaign against malaria and dengue
article.articleSummary: June 10 workshop at Bellare Primary Health Center launched a mass campaign against malaria and dengue, with Dr. Kiran inaugurating and hospital staff in attendance. The program then shifted to KPS High School for broader outreach. Senior Primary Health Safety Officer Mamta Rai, Junior PHO Vasanti, and Health Inspector Charan Kumar Kudekallu attended. The health officials presented detailed information on communicable diseases, including malaria, dengue, chikungunya, and leptospirosis, and underscored the importance of safe drinking water. The Senior PHO also discussed HPV vaccination and personal hygiene as part of adolescent health education. The Junior PHO addressed nutrition and anemia to reinforce student health. The session was attended by the school vice principal Uma Kumari and teachers, aiming to raise awareness and preventive practices among students and the wider community.

triage.headline_ja: ベラーレ:マラリア・デング熱対策の啓発キャンペーンワークショップ

triage.notes: 記事はインド・カルナータカ州ベラーレ地区の保健所が実施した学校向け健康教育・予防啓発活動の報告であり、実際の患者発生や流行を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Αμερικανός διαγνώστηκε με Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό, λένε τα CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American diagnosed with Ebola in DR Congo, says the CDC.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-11, an American humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. The CDC said the case is being managed in coordination with the patient’s employing organization and other federal partners in the DRC to prevent further transmission and to identify high-risk contacts. The announcement underscores ongoing surveillance and contact-tracing efforts in response to this Bundibugyo Ebola infection. No details were provided on the patient's symptoms, date of onset, or potential exposure source. The report confirms a laboratory-detected infection and illustrates continued U.S. public health support for outbreak prevention and risk assessment in the DRC.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American citizen tests positive for Ebola in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, an American citizen employed by a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola. The result was disclosed by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention in a statement issued overnight Saturday. The article provides no figures for cases or deaths, nor details on symptoms, exposure source, or additional laboratory information beyond the positive result. There is no information about imported or exported cases. The report highlights ongoing public health monitoring in DR Congo for Ebola virus disease, with the Bundibugyo strain identified in a single international aid worker. Further updates from health authorities were not included in the article.

article.articleHeadline: "Θερίζει" ο Έμπολα: 648 οι θάνατοι στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 648 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Authorities report 1,830 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 648 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since the outbreak was declared on May 15, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. This outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola virus disease causes hemorrhagic fever. Over the past five decades, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa. The most deadly DRC outbreak occurred in 2018–2020, with about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: "猛威を振るう"エボラ：コンゴで648人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,830症例・648死亡という大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法なし）の発生であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Американец заразился стрептококком на свадьбе в Индии и лишился ног
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American contracted streptococcus at a wedding in India and lost his legs.
article.articleSummary: An American, 39-year-old Andrew Wasil, contracted a streptococcal infection at his brother’s wedding in India (February 2025). The infection rapidly affected the lungs and other organs, necessitating over six weeks in an Indian ICU and above-knee amputations to halt spread. He was repatriated to the United States, where he remained ill for months and died four months after the initial infection. Separately, UK resident Laurie Denman learned that 38 Taenia solium (pork tapeworm) larvae were present in her brain, causing neurocysticercosis. Her first symptoms—headaches and a seizure—appeared in 2011. She received antiparasitic therapy, steroids, and anticonvulsants, but relapses included panic attacks and paranoia. She has been seizure-free for about ten years and advocates awareness of this rare disease.

triage.notes: 記事は2件の個別症例（渡航者の溶血性連鎖球菌感染症による死亡、英国人女性の脳嚢虫症の闘病記）を扱ったヒューマンインタレスト記事であり、感染症のクラスターやアウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: CKG di Jaktim terintegrasi dengan skrining TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CKG in East Jakarta Integrated with TB Screening
article.articleSummary: In East Jakarta, the Suku Dinas Kesehatan Jakarta Timur expands the Free Health Check (CKG) program by integrating tuberculosis (TB) screening with broader health services. Arief Wahyudhy, head of the East Jakarta Health Office, said the integration enables people to access multiple services in a single visit, ensuring fast, comfortable, and quality care as participation rises. CKG services are now integrated across all service lines at puskesmas, allowing residents to seek treatment while also benefiting from other health services. To widen reach, the Jakarta Timur government is deploying outreach services to schools, government offices, houses of worship, community groups, and public events such as Pekan Raya Jakarta (PRJ). The objective is easier access to preventive health assessments and timely screening through streamlined, one-stop visits.

article.articleHeadline: Cartas al director: Ébola sin fronteras | El Diario Vasco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Letters to the Editor: Ebola Without Borders | El Diario Vasco
article.articleSummary: Letter to the Editor: Ebola Without Borders highlights the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, urging reflection that behind every figure lies a life lost and a family shattered. In a globalized world with thousands crossing borders daily, the piece warns that a severe epidemic cannot be confined to a single region, and no continent is fully protected from viral spread. The author, Ander Murillo of Ordizia, argues that Europe should move beyond observation. It calls for reinforced epidemiological surveillance, strengthened sanitary controls, increased international cooperation, and intensified support to affected countries to contain a highly dangerous disease. The letter stresses that viruses travel with people, and that robust, collaborative public health responses are essential to prevent cross-border transmission of Ebola.

article.articleHeadline: Rise of Covid-19 cases in Baguio remains 'manageable' -- mayor
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 in Baguio City, Philippines, remains manageable. Since the start of 2026, Baguio has logged 41 confirmed cases, with infections rising since May but staying mild and under control, according to Mayor Benjamin Magalong on July 11, 2026. Most cases involve healthcare workers and hospital personnel rather than the general public; no severe illness or deaths are reported in the article. The City Health Services Office, working with hospitals, is closely monitoring cases and implementing containment measures within health facilities. Authorities are strengthening infection prevention in hospitals to keep facilities safe and able to serve the public. Residents are urged to maintain basic precautions—wear masks in crowded areas, wash hands regularly, and stay home when ill—with updates to be provided as needed by health officials.

article.articleHeadline: ایبولا وائرس 561 زندگیاں نگل گیا! ڈاکٹرز اور طبی عملہ بھی میدان چھوڑنے پر مجبور - MM NEWS URDU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus has claimed 561 lives! Doctors and medical staff were also forced to withdraw from the field - MM NEWS URDU.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. As of the latest official update, 1,561 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported and 506 deaths since the outbreak was formally declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain is driving this outbreak; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, though vaccines exist for the Zaire strain used in other outbreaks. Health workers, including doctors and nurses, in Ituri have issued a 24-hour notice demanding unpaid dues and better working conditions; strikes threaten to disrupt patient care and experimental trials that began enrollment days earlier. Identified patient zero remains unknown; ongoing contact tracing aims to curb transmission across three eastern provinces. WHO warns this marks one of the worst starts to a Congo outbreak, highlighting health-system and resource challenges.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが561人の命を奪う！医師や医療スタッフも現場離脱を余儀なくされる - MM NEWS URDU

triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・特効治療薬がなく、医療従事者のストライキが対応能力を一層低下させるリスクがある。WHOも「コンゴ史上最悪の立ち上がりの一つ」と警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Un joueur anglais placé à l'isolement : un virus frappe l'Angleterre et la Norvège avant leur quart de finale de Coupe du monde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An English player placed in isolation: a virus strikes England and Norway ahead of their World Cup quarter-final.
article.articleSummary: Ahead of the World Cup quarter-final between England and Norway at the Hard Rock Stadium in Miami, a virus disrupted preparations on both sides. England's Declan Rice was placed in isolation after contracting an unspecified virus, missing training and casting uncertainty over his availability for the July 11, 23:00 local kickoff. Norway also reported multiple cases among players and staff, with symptoms including cough and a strong hoarseness; coach Ståle Solbakken and captain Martin Ødegaard said the situation was under control and the squad would be ready. England had beaten Mexico 3-2 and Norway had upset Brazil 2-1 to reach the quarter-final. The match, a high-profile clash, remains contingent on the virus’s progression, but both teams express confidence in fielding a full squad.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: 648 deaths out of 1,830 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak is underway in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 1,830 laboratory-confirmed cases and 648 deaths reported by authorities. Declared on May 15, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or therapeutic agent. Ebola virus disease causes hemorrhagic fever and has killed more than 15,000 people across Africa over the past five decades. The most deadly DRC outbreak occurred during 2018–2020, recording approximately 3,500 cases and around 2,300 deaths. The current tally underscores the persistent public health challenge posed by EVD in central Africa.

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में सरकारी आंकड़ों से चार गुना अधिक हो सकता है इबोला का प्रकोप, 80 नए मरीजों के संक्रमण का नहीं मिल रहा सुराग - drc ebola outbreak 4x worse than reported who warns
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak could be four times higher than official figures, with no trace of infection among 80 new patients — DRC Ebola outbreak 4x worse than reported, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be four times higher than official figures. As of July 11, 2026, there are 1,792 infections and 625 deaths. WHO warns that about 80% of new confirmed cases in Ituri's Bunia area have no known contact with earlier cases, indicating substantial community transmission. The outbreak center is Ituri Province, especially Bunia, Ramppara, Mongbwalu, and Nyakunde health zones; the virus has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo (Tshopo) Province. The Bundibugyo strain may cause milder symptoms, potentially reducing perceived risk and driving families to care at home, delaying treatment and prolonging community spread. About 90% of cases remain in Ituri's core zones; Bunia testing shows roughly 50% positivity. Deaths outside treatment centers account for about 70% of fatalities. The biggest challenge is surveillance, with 21,000 community health workers deployed for door-to-door case finding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、政府発表の4倍規模の可能性 ― 新規80人の感染経路不明とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラの感染者・死者数が公式発表を大幅に上回る可能性があり、新規症例の80%で感染経路不明というコミュニティ内伝播の証拠がある。複数州への拡大とWHOの警告により、深刻性・異常性・流行性のいずれの基準も満たす。
triage.notes: Ituri州Bunia地域を中心に、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tshopo州へ拡大。死亡の70%が治療施設外で発生しており、サーベイランスの不備と地域社会での隠れた感染拡大が示唆される。Bundibugyo株による軽症化が受診遅延を招いている可能性。

TB screening focus highlights infectious disease prevention within routine health checks.
