article.articleHeadline: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat fresh child deaths: Symptoms, treatment, prevention and everything you need to know
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Chandipura virus (CHPV) outbreak in Gujarat’s Sabarkantha and Panchmahal districts has caused three child deaths, prompting intensified surveillance, dedicated hospital wards, lab testing, and door-to-door screening. CHPV, a Rhabdoviridae member causing Acute Encephalitis Syndrome, was first identified in 1965 in Chandipura village, Maharashtra. Transmission is primarily via bites of infected sand flies, not person-to-person; monsoon-driven vector activity raises outbreak risk. Symptoms can escalate within 24–48 hours to AES, including sudden high fever, severe headache, vomiting, seizures, confusion, and loss of consciousness. No specific antiviral or vaccine exists; care is supportive—hospitalization, IV fluids, fever management, anti-seizure meds, respiratory support, and continuous neurological monitoring. Prevention emphasizes vector control and personal protection (nets, repellents, long sleeves), sanitation, and public surveillance. Early medical attention is crucial, as not all monsoon fevers are CHPV.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染症が発生、新たな子どもの死亡例：症状、治療法、予防法まとめ
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州で子ども3名が死亡するチャンディプラウイルス（急性脳炎症候群）の集団発生が確認され、重症度が高く行政による監視強化が行われているためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介で人-人感染はないが、モンスーン期に再発する既知の疾患。ワクチン・特効薬がなく小児の重症化・死亡例があるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Toll Reaches 600 as Suspected Cases Spread Beyond Congo's Outbreak Zone
article.articleSummary: 600 Ebola deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of July 11, 2026, in the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak. Suspected infections have emerged in Kisangani (Tshopo) and Haut-Uele, prompting expanded surveillance; Kisangani reports two suspected cases, with one linked to the Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri (outbreak origin) and the other with no known transmission link and under investigation. Surveillance and contact tracing are intensified to determine whether cases reflect isolated events or wider community transmission beyond Ituri. The Bundibugyo virus is a rare strain with no approved vaccine or targeted treatment; clinical trials of experimental therapies began at the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. Ongoing conflict, attacks on health facilities, and funding shortages complicate response efforts, but WHO and partners continue case detection, laboratory testing, and community education to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数600人に到達、コンゴの流行地域を超えて疑い例が拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による死者600人・確定症例1,759人が報告され、流行地域外（キサンガニ、オートウエレ）にも疑い症例が拡大しており、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ紛争下で対応が困難な状況にあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株は承認ワクチン・特異的治療法がない稀な株。武力紛争・医療施設への攻撃・資金不足が対応を複雑化させている。伝播の起点であるイツリ州を超えた地域社会内感染の可能性について、接触者追跡調査で確認中。

article.articleHeadline: Θετικός στον Έμπολα Αμερικανός εργαζόμενος στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American worker in Congo tests positive for Ebola
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Ebola, specifically the Bundibugyo strain, the CDC announced. The agency is coordinating with the employing organization, other federal partners, and Congolese authorities to curb further transmission and identify high‑risk contacts. As of the latest tally, the DRC reports 1,830 laboratory‑confirmed Ebola cases and 648 deaths in this outbreak, which was declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain is the cause of the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola virus disease produces hemorrhagic fever and has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades; the deadliest DRC outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths out of 3,500 cases. The situation underscores ongoing risk and the need for rapid contact tracing and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで働くアメリカ人労働者、エボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクにより1,830症例・648死亡が報告され、ワクチンや特効薬がない中、国際的な人・組織を通じた拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国人労働者感染は国際的拡散リスクの象徴例。DRCの17回目のエボラ流行で、ワクチン・治療法未承認の点も重大。米国(発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外)は感染者の国籍に過ぎず、発生自体はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Θετικός στον ιό Αμερικανός εργαζόμενος σε ανθρωπιστική οργάνωση στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: An American humanitarian worker in Congo tests positive for the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola confirmed in an American humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo. As of 2026-07-11, authorities monitor progression and are conducting all necessary procedures to identify individuals who may have been exposed and are at high risk. The CDC announced the positive test and is working closely with the humanitarian organization, other US federal agencies, and DRC health authorities to prevent further transmission through immediate contact tracing and adherence to public health protocols. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals and can cause severe hemorrhagic disease, underscoring the importance of rapid detection and containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴでの人道支援活動に従事するアメリカ人がウイルス陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がアメリカ人人道支援者から確認され、CDCが関与する国際的な症例であり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国人罹患者は国際的な感染拡大リスクを示唆するが、発症地・感染源はDRC国内であるため、対象国としてはDRCのみを列挙。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ‫ ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 648 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 648.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: death toll up to 648 with 1,830 confirmed cases. New figures cover the last 24 hours. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba announces expansion of the officially affected areas to include the northern and northeastern provinces of Chobo and Haut-Uele. The World Health Organization warns the true scale could be two to four times higher than official counts, with four in five new infections in some areas not linked to known cases. The update signals ongoing transmission and monitoring across the country; the brief provides no details on symptoms or vaccination measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、648人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者数・症例数が急増し、感染地域が拡大していること、WHOが実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性を指摘しヒト-ヒト感染が疑われる点から、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルRRAが必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngola(3351879)が含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。記事本文の詳細は空欄のためサマリーのみで評価。WHOは実際の感染規模が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、感染連鎖が不明な症例が多いことから継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة الوفيات الناجمة عن فيروس "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 648 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 648.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 648 deaths and 1,830 confirmed cases. The figures cover cases and deaths recorded in the previous 24 hours. Health authorities say the officially affected areas have been expanded to include Chobo and Haut-Uele provinces in the north and northeast. The World Health Organization has previously warned that the outbreak's true scale may be two to four times higher than official counts, and noted that in some areas four of every five new infections are not linked to known cases, indicating substantial undetected transmission. The update underscores ongoing transmission and expansion of the outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルスによる死者数、648人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者648人・症例1,830人に達し、感染地域が拡大、未検出感染も多いとWHOが警告しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngola（Cuanza Norte州）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（北部・北東部のHaut-Uele州等）の拡大のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikaanse hulpverlener in Congo besmet met ebolavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American aid worker in Congo infected with Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: An American aid worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been infected with the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus, according to the U.S. CDC. The patient worked for a humanitarian organization in Congo; CDC, Congolese authorities, and international partners are coordinating to prevent further spread and identify close contacts. Congolese authorities report 1,830 confirmed Ebola infections and 648 deaths linked to the outbreak, through all confirmed cases up to Thursday. Public health teams are maintaining surveillance and pursuing source and contact investigations to rapidly map new cases and contain transmission; authorities emphasize ongoing monitoring and collaboration to control this event.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでアメリカ人援助従事者がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例1,830名・死亡648名の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、米国人援助従事者への感染や国際的な渡航者への波及可能性があり、深刻性・国際拡大リスクともに該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。既存の大規模アウトブレイク（1,830例、648死亡）が継続中であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Αμερικανός πολίτης στη ΛΔ Κονγκό διεγνώσθη θετικός στον ιό του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American citizen in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen employed by a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain. The case was confirmed and announced by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). The CDC is collaborating with the employing organization, other federal agencies, and partners in the DRC to prevent further transmission and to identify high-risk contacts. The report provides no details on symptoms, diagnosis date, or case counts. The response emphasizes rapid public health actions, including surveillance and contact tracing, to limit potential spread within the local area.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で米国人がエボラウイルス陽性と診断
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な人員の感染例であることから国際拡大のリスクがあり、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株によるエボラで、CDCが対応にあたっている。症状・診断日・症例数など詳細情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв вируса Эбола в ДР Конго достигло 648 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 648.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,830 laboratory-confirmed Ebola fever cases and 648 deaths in the current outbreak, which began on 15 May. Earlier in July, the tally stood at 1,333 cases and 399 deaths, a case-fatality rate of about 29.7%. The surge has strained health systems, with in Ituri Province healthcare workers going on unpaid-salary protests and security and burial teams voicing discontent. The outbreak response has faced staffing challenges, complicating case management and funeral activities. Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said Moscow is prepared to establish serial production of an Ebola vaccine, signaling potential vaccine-scale-up. The report cites Al Jazeera on Facebook as a source. Ongoing monitoring and response efforts remain crucial as the outbreak progresses in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴでのエボラウイルスによる死者数が648人に達した
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（1,830症例、648死亡、致死率約29.7%）が進行中であり、医療体制の逼迫と人員不足も報告されているため、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ロシアはワクチン生産支援を表明した文脈で言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。イツリ州における医療従事者のストライキや埋葬チームの不満など、対応能力の逼迫が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: У Конгу потврђено 1.830 случајева еболе, 648 преминулих
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 1,830 Ebola cases confirmed, 648 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo totals 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths. The outbreak is centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, where 80% of new patients are not linked to known contacts, indicating substantial transmission outside traced chains. In North Kivu Province, where case numbers are lower, nearly all new infections come from contact lists, suggesting some progress in surveillance. World Health Organization Ebola Emergency Director Chikwe Ihekweazu warned the true scale could be two to four times higher than official counts due to under-ascertainment. The data underscore ongoing transmission with gaps in contact tracing, emphasizing the need for intensified surveillance and investigation in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱1,830例確認、648人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1,830例、648死亡）が継続中で、80%の新規患者が既知の接触者と関連しないなど市中伝播が示唆され、WHOも過小把握を警告しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: WHOのエボラ緊急対応責任者が実際の症例数は公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、過小把握と追跡調査の不備が深刻な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Skala epidemii może być znacznie większa niż oficjalne dane
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The scale of the epidemic may be significantly larger than official data.
article.articleSummary: Four of five new Ebola infections in parts of the Democratic Republic of Congo have no link to previously diagnosed patients, according to WHO emergency chief Chikwe Ihekweazu. The true scale may be 2–4 times higher than official counts, based on transmission models and test positivity. About 80% of newly confirmed cases come from contacts not on established lists. The epicenter is Ituri Province, accounting for about 90% of reported cases, with spillover into North Kivu, South Kivu, and Upper Uele, and cases reported in Uganda. In Bunia, Ituri’s capital, roughly half of those tested are positive. Around 70% of deaths occur among those not treated in facilities. The circulating strain may cause milder symptoms, prompting home care and sustained transmission. Declared May 15; this is the 17th outbreak in DR Congo since 1976, following a previous outbreak that ended in 2025. Transmission is via contact with blood, secretions, or excretions; no vaccine exists.

triage.headline_ja: エビデミックの規模は公式データよりも著しく大きい可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが公式統計を大幅に上回る規模である可能性がWHOにより指摘されており、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染者の実数が公式統計の2〜4倍に上る可能性がWHOにより指摘されている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Demam Berdarah Mengintai, Delapan Warga di Banyumas Mulai Terjangkit - Suara Merdeka Purbalingga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Looms, Eight Residents in Banyumas Have Begun Contracting Dengue
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, eight residents across three houses in Desa Dawuhan Kulon, Kedungbanteng District, Banyumas Regency, Indonesia, are suspected dengue fever (DBD) cases after a two-week cluster. All eight received hospital care; six have recovered, while two remain hospitalized or under treatment. The first case was described by resident Jufri, with fever triggering illness in other family members—including his son, daughter-in-law, two grandchildren, and a domestic helper—within the same neighborhood. The developing cluster has raised local concern as dengue season approaches. Residents are calling for an epidemiological investigation and fogging to curb transmission by the Aedes mosquitoes. The report notes suspected cases but provides no information on laboratory confirmation. This outbreak cluster highlights the need for follow-up public health action in Banyumas.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の脅威、バンユマスで住民8人が感染し始める
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの一地域における小規模なデング熱クラスターであり、地域の風土病として例年発生するレベルの事案。ただし続報（検査確認や拡大状況）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 検査確認前の疑い症例であり、デング熱はインドネシアで季節性・地方流行性の疾患。地域住民から疫学調査とフォギングの要望が出ている程度で、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は現時点で確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Macacos Bugios são avistados no Parque Estadual do Desengano, em Santa Maria Madalena - Diário do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Howler monkeys spotted at Desengano State Park, in Santa Maria Madalena - Rio de Janeiro Daily
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, three howler monkeys were spotted at Desengano State Park in Santa Maria Madalena, interior Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Park ranger Mateus Guinancio observed a family—father, mother, and a dependent infant—and photographed one individual. The sighting is rare and a biodiversity milestone for Rio de Janeiro, as the species has suffered drastic population declines and remains endangered. The howler monkey is listed as Vulnerable by the IUCN. Past drivers of decline include habitat loss and a Yellow Fever outbreak between 2016 and 2018. The apparent resurgence in the wild is attributed to conservation actions and signals the species' recovery. These primates, emblematic of the Atlantic Forest, live in canopy groups and play a crucial ecological role by feeding on leaves, fruits, and flowers, aiding seed dispersal and forest regeneration.

triage.headline_ja: サンタ・マリア・マダレナのデセンガーノ州立公園でホエザルが目撃される - リオデジャネイロ日報
triage.triage_reason: 記事はホエザルの生息回復に関する生物多様性ニュースであり、黄熱病は2016-2018年の過去の流行に言及されているのみで、現在の感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: 黄熱病は過去（2016-2018年）の流行として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Αμερικανός πολίτης στη ΛΔ Κονγκό διεγνώσθη θετικός στον ιό του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American citizen in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On July 11, 2026, an American citizen employed by a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced the result and said they are coordinating with the employer, other federal agencies, and partners in the DRC to prevent further transmission and to identify high-risk contacts. The public health response focuses on contact tracing and containment, with no further clinical details about symptoms, exposure, or patient status disclosed. The incident underscores ongoing vigilance for Ebola activity in the DRC and the importance of collaboration between U.S. federal authorities and local partners to manage transmission risk and prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス陽性と診断される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の感染例であり、致死率の高い疾患で国際的な人的移動を伴う人道支援関係者が罹患していることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の重大性が認められる。
triage.notes: 米国人はDRCで感染したものであり、米国自体での発生ではないため米国は対象国リストに含まれず除外。CDCと現地関係者の連携によるコンタクトトレーシングが進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Alcune considerazioni sull'attuale epidemia di Ebola nella Repubblica Democratica del Congo - di Edoardo Almagià - Politica Insieme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Some reflections on the current Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - by Edoardo Almagià - Politica Insieme
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is in the midst of its 17th Ebola epidemic, with more than 200 deaths one month after onset. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or widely available therapy. The epidemic occurs within deep structural fragility: poverty, political instability, armed conflict, weak health systems, and limited care access. In rural eastern Congo, hospitals are scarce and communities often seek traditional healers, delaying detection and sustaining household transmission. Daily mobility for work, mining, and trade, plus cross-border flows, facilitates spread and complicates contact tracing. Misinformation and distrust of authorities hinder prevention and reporting. The WHO notes high population mobility, intense trade, and precarious security complicating tracing. The outbreak strains local economies—markets slow, schools close, trade declines—highlighting vulnerabilities and the risk of regional spillover.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国における現行エボラ流行についての考察 - エドアルド・アルマジア著 - Politica Insieme
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で第17次エボラ流行が進行中で、発症から1ヶ月で200人以上が死亡し、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、越境移動によるリスクも指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 承認ワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行で、脆弱な保健システム、武力紛争、住民の高い移動性（鉱業・貿易・越境）が拡大リスクを高めている。WHOも追跡の困難さを指摘しており、地域的波及の恐れがある。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Конго побила исторический рекорд по скорости заражения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo breaks historic record for fastest transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the fastest-spreading in history, according to Africa CDC, with more than 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths in the DRC, and 20 cases with 2 deaths in neighboring Uganda, as per WHO data published July 7. The Bundibugyo strain is spreading faster than other known Ebola variants, outpacing containment efforts. Lack of an approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo raises international concern; antiviral cocktail trials are ongoing but have not yielded significant results. Merck’s Ervebo vaccine, effective against the Zaire strain, does not protect Bundibugyo; an experimental vaccine approved in the U.S. in 2024 exists but is in limited supply and not broadly licensed in Africa. The article notes that Ebola was first identified in 1976 in the DRC, near the Ebola River; previous Western Africa 2013-2016 outbreak caused over 11,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、感染拡大速度で史上最速記録を更新
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が史上最速の拡大速度を示し、致死率も高く、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・アンゴラも発生地域として挙げられているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行とウガンダへの越境拡大。ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Fresh Covid Detection in Andhra Pradesh as Kadapa Records Two Deaths and Four Cases - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 re-emerged in Andhra Pradesh’s Kadapa district with two deaths and four RT-PCR–confirmed infections, prompting intensified surveillance as of 11 July 2026. All four new cases were detected at Kadapa Virology Laboratory; three patients are in home isolation, while one with mild symptoms is in a designated Covid ward. Officials suspect an Omicron sub-lineage; genome sequencing by NIV Pune is underway to identify the exact variant. The two fatalities include a 60-year-old with diabetes and kidney disease who began care at SVIMS, Tirupati, before transfer to CMC Vellore and death, and a 43-year-old patient who died during treatment with Covid-positive status; underlying conditions for the second case are not fully disclosed. All four infections had completed the two-dose vaccination schedule, with one booster for one individual. Authorities stress no evidence of a large-scale outbreak and have strengthened contact tracing, ILI/SARI surveillance, isolation bed capacity, oxygen/ICU readiness, and infection-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州カダパで新型コロナ再検出、死亡2例・感染4例を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における少数のCOVID-19症例・死亡例の報告であり、当局も大規模流行の証拠はないとしている。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常のサーベイランス報道に留まる。
triage.notes: 疾患名にNipahが含まれるが、記事サマリーはCOVID-19のみに言及しており、Nipahに関する情報は本記事には存在しない。死亡例は基礎疾患を有する患者であり、ワクチン接種も完了済み。当局は大規模流行を否定し、通常の監視強化対応を実施している。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand issues dengue, chikungunya alert during monsoon
article.articleSummary: Jharkhand on high alert for dengue and chikungunya during the monsoon, with Additional Chief Secretary Ajay Kumar Singh directing districts to intensify surveillance in waterlogged areas and prioritize destruction of mosquito breeding sites. The Health Department advisory to Deputy Commissioners calls for an immediate campaign to curb transmission as female Aedes mosquitoes breed in clean water. Common sites include water-filled containers, coolers, plastic bottles, open tanks, old tyres, and discarded items around homes. Municipal corporations, MPWs, Sahiyas, and volunteers will jointly identify and destroy breeding habitats, with vector surveillance central to the plan. Door-to-door inspections, ensuring equipment such as plastic dippers, pipettes, and larva collection vials are available, and action plans submitted to state HQ. Citizens are urged to prevent stagnation, clean water containers regularly, keep tanks covered, and seek treatment promptly if fever appears; collective action is essential.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州、モンスーン期におけるデング熱・チクングニア熱の警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期の季節性デング熱・チクングニア熱に対する予防的注意喚起であり、実際の症例急増や異常事態を示す情報がないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド・ジャールカンド州が例年のモンスーン期に実施する予防的サーベイランス・蚊の発生源対策を報じるものであり、具体的な症例数や異常な感染拡大の報告はない。ルーティンの公衆衛生対策として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يواصل الانتشار في الكونغو الديمقراطية... مناطق جديدة تدخل دائرة التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... new areas enter the outbreak zone.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths as of 2026-07-11, according to government data released on Friday evening and covering cases through Thursday. The official health report indicates ongoing transmission amid a widening outbreak. Authorities formally expanded the affected areas to include Chopo and Haut-Uele in the northern and northeastern DRC, signaling geographic spread. The figures are laboratory-confirmed, reflecting current outbreak dynamics and surveillance efforts. The article provides no details on infection sources, vaccination status, or imported/exported cases. This update underscores the persistence of Ebola in the DRC and the need for ongoing public health response in newly affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大を続ける…新たな地域が流行圏に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例・死亡数が多数に上り、新たな地域への拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 累積症例1,830例、死亡648例と致死率が高く、Chopo・Haut-Uele地域への拡大が確認されている。感染源やワクチン接種状況、輸入・輸出症例の詳細は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Spike in homosexual HIV infections sparks grave concern from Ghana AIDS Commission
article.articleSummary: HIV prevalence among homosexuals in Ghana’s Bono Region stands at 26%, according to Ahmed Ibrahim Bambilla, the Bono, Bono East and Ahafo Regional Coordinator of the Ghana AIDS Commission. In Sunyani, he noted the region’s HIV prevalence among commercial sex workers is 6%. The Ghana AIDS Commission is distributing Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP) to vulnerable populations, highlighting its efficacy in preventing HIV infection. He urged people living with HIV to adhere to antiretroviral therapy; six months of consistent treatment can lead to viral suppression. Ghana has achieved about 89% viral suppression nationwide, reducing onward transmission. The remarks reflect grave concern over rapid spread within the gay community in the Bono Region and underscore the need for sustained prevention and treatment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 同性愛者間のHIV感染急増、ガーナ・エイズ委員会が深刻な懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: HIVはガーナにおいて既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事は特定集団における有病率の統計報告であって、急性・異常な公衆衛生イベントとは言えないため。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の風土病であり、EBSの急性感染症シグナルトリアージの対象としては適切性が低い。国内の既存対策（PrEP配布、ART遵守推進）が継続的に行われている状況の報告。

article.articleHeadline: Смертельный вирус снова набирает силу: в Конго тревожно растут цифры, которых боялся весь мир
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly virus is gaining strength again: in Congo, alarming figures that the whole world feared are rising.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) worsens rapidly: 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths reported by July 11, with mortality over one‑third. The virus is spreading intensely, particularly in Ituri, which accounts for about 90% of registered cases, including Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbvalu, and Nyakunde. WHO says stabilization is premature as transmission crosses administrative boundaries and logistics remain challenging in a highly populated, unstable region. US CDC analysts warn the outbreak is on a dangerous trajectory, with worst‑case projections up to 20,000 cases if unchecked; risk to global health due to cross‑border movement persists. Responses emphasize ring vaccination, isolation, and decontamination, but access to patients is hampered by conditions in Ituri. International agencies advocate vaccine expansion and frontline support; while experimental vaccines and protocols exist, effectiveness hinges on rapid, coordinated action to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスが再び勢いを増す：コンゴで世界が恐れていた数字が不気味に増加している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を複数満たすエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクであり、死亡率が高く国境を越えた拡大リスクとWHO・CDCによる懸念表明もあるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文はコンゴ（イトゥリ州）でのアウトブレイクを主題としており、ルワンダでの発生は言及されていない。ルワンダは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。CDCによる最悪シナリオでは2万症例に達する可能性が指摘されており、越境拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 雨天摔破皮，别用纸巾按压伤口，感染风险可能翻倍！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainy-day fall causing a skin abrasion? Do not press the wound with a tissue; infection risk could double.
article.articleSummary: Rainy-season injuries in Beijing pose infection risk from rainwater contaminants such as Pseudomonas aeruginosa and tetanus-causing Clostridium tetani. Pressing wounds with tissue or wipes can leave fibers and irritants, potentially doubling infection risk. Emergency physician Yu Jieqiong from Beijing Friendship Hospital outlines first-aid steps: (1) move away from rainwater exposure; (2) rinse the wound with clean running cooled boiled water or bottled purified water for at least 1 minute, directing water from the wound center outward; (3) if possible, rewash with sterile saline or disinfect with povidone-iodine (three center-outward applications); (4) gently pat dry with sterile gauze—do not rub; (5) apply a thin layer of mupirocin or erythromycin ointment, then cover with sterile gauze and secure with tape. These measures aim to minimize contamination and infection risk during the rainy season in China.

triage.headline_ja: 雨天摔破皮，别用纸巾按压伤口，感染风险可能翻倍！（雨天で擦り傷、ティッシュで押さえないで！感染リスクが倍増する可能性）
triage.triage_reason: 個人の応急処置に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団感染事例の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は破傷風菌や緑膿菌による創傷感染予防の一般的な医療アドバイス記事であり、具体的な感染症の発生・流行事例ではないため対象国の該当なしとした。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Philippines reports bird flu outbreak, WOAH confirms cases
article.articleSummary: On 11 July 2026, the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) reported a highly pathogenic H5N1 bird flu outbreak in the Philippines, affecting backyard poultry in Oriental Mindoro province. The virus was detected in a flock of 39 birds in the town of Capalan, triggering culling of all birds as a precaution. The report underscores ongoing global concern about avian influenza, which has disrupted poultry supply, driven higher food prices, and increased the risk of human transmission. No human cases are described in the article; emphasis is on animal health measures and confirmed infection in a small backyard flock. No details are provided on infection source or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンで鳥インフルエンザ発生、WOAHが症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザがフィリピンの裏庭養鶏で確認されたが、人間感染例はなく、規模も小さい（39羽）。動物のみの発生であるため直ちにPICKUPとはしないが、H5N1の潜在的なヒト感染リスクを踏まえ継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事は動物衛生（家禽）の発生報告であり、人間感染例の記載はない。WOAHへの報告に基づく動物疾病としての対応（殺処分）が既に実施されている。H5N1は継続的な監視対象であるためWATCHとしたが、現時点で人間への影響やヒト-ヒト感染の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Reports 1,830 Ebola Cases, 648 Deaths Amid Worsening Outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 1,830 confirmed Ebola cases and 648 deaths as outbreak intensifies, with 90% of infections in Ituri province, Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nyakunde. The virus is Bundibugyo, a rarer strain with no approved vaccine or licensed treatment. The outbreak began in mid-May 2026 and WHO classifies it as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, while Africa CDC calls it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in Africa. WHO warns the true scale is likely 2–4 times higher than official counts, with as many as four in five new patients having no known epidemiological link, indicating widespread community transmission. The virus has spread beyond Ituri into North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo. Contributing factors include late treatment seeking, home care, conflict, displacement, funding shortfalls, misinformation, and attacks on health workers. About 21,000 community health workers are being trained; clinical trials of Remdesivir and MBP134, alone or in combination, are underway.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱1,830例・死者648人を報告—拡大する流行
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICと宣言した急拡大中のエボラ流行であり、致死率が高く地域間伝播・コミュニティ内感染が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEIC宣言済み、Africa CDCは『アフリカで最も急速に拡大するエボラ流行』と表現。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株であり、致死率・地域拡大・コミュニティ感染の観点から高リスク。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では主題として言及されていないため除外。

A tally released today, July 11, 2026, confirms these totals and provides the current accounting of the epidemic in the DRC. The report from authorities notes the ongoing impact of the Ebola outbreak in the country as of the stated date. These figures reflect the latest official counts published by the DRC authorities and pertain to the laboratory-confirmed cases and fatalities associated with the May 15 outbreak declaration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の死者数が648人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例1,830例、死者648人と大規模な流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は約35%（648/1830）と高く、継続的なモニタリングと国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Health department reports travel-related dengue case in Oahu resident
article.articleSummary: Six dengue cases have been reported in Hawaii this year, with the latest travel-related case on Oahu, bringing Oahu totals to five and Kauai to one. The most recent case is an Oahu resident who was exposed while traveling in a dengue-endemic region. Hawaii Department of Health teams have been deployed to inspect and implement mosquito-control measures in the area; officials say the risk of local transmission remains low given the circumstances. Dengue virus is transmitted by mosquitoes and is common in tropical and subtropical areas of Central and South America, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Pacific and Caribbean islands. Countries with higher-than-usual activity include Samoa, Vietnam, Colombia, Cambodia, Maldives, Mali, New Caledonia, Timor-Leste, Bolivia, and Guyana. Travelers should review travel guidance 4–6 weeks before travel. Symptoms include fever, nausea, vomiting, rash, and body aches. If traveled and symptomatic, contact a healthcare provider or call DOH at (808) 586-4586.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、オアフ島住民の渡航関連デング熱症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: ハワイ在住者の渡航関連デング熱単発症例であり、地域内伝播リスクは低いとされている。対象国での発生事例ではなく、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念や国際的拡大の兆候もない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国ハワイ州の渡航関連デング熱症例であり、対象国リストに米国は含まれない。ベトナム・カンボジア等は『高活動地域』として背景情報的に言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: सावधान! बारिश के पानी में चलने से पहले रहें अलर्ट, लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस का बढ़ रहा खतरा, जानिए बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caution! Be alert before walking in rainwater; the risk of leptospirosis is rising. Learn how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk is rising in Mumbai during the monsoon, as floodwater exposure from ongoing heavy rains prompts warnings by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation. Walking through pooled rainwater or mud increases leptospirosis infection risk, and the disease can be fatal if treatment is delayed. The article underscores precaution during the monsoon season, especially for individuals with open wounds. While rain brings benefits, it also amplifies mosquito-borne and waterborne illnesses, including dengue, malaria, typhoid, and cholera; leptospirosis is highlighted as a flood-related threat. The piece aims to inform on what the infection is and how to protect oneself; as of July 11, 2026, authorities urge vigilance during flooded conditions and rain exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！雨水の中を歩く前に警戒を、レプトスピラ症のリスクが増加中、予防法を知ろう

triage.notes: モンスーン期に毎年見られる季節性の公衆衛生啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や流行の急増を示すデータは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola claims 648 lives in DR Congo as confirmed cases surpass 1,800
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed 648 lives and 1,830 confirmed infections, according to government data released in Kinshasa. The latest epidemiological situation report notes these figures reflect total infections and deaths recorded over the prior 24 hours, with data current as of Thursday, July 9, 2026. Authorities are monitoring the outbreak and intensifying efforts to contain the virus’s spread, as the Friday-evening release confirms an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者648人、確認感染者数1,800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者648人・感染者1,830人と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率は約35%（648/1830）と高く、コンゴ政府がキンシャサで状況を発表。継続的なアウトブレイクであり、続報・国際支援状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen tests positive for Ebola | CNN
article.articleSummary: US citizen working for a humanitarian group in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus, per the CDC. The agency is coordinating with the employing organization and DRC partners to prevent transmission and identify high-risk contacts; no further patient details were released. As of late Friday, the DRC reports 1,830 confirmed Ebola cases and 648 deaths. The United States has no confirmed cases, and the overall risk to Americans remains low. The outbreak remains confined to remote areas of the DRC and neighboring Uganda. In May, American missionary Dr. Peter Stafford contracted Ebola in the DRC; his wife Rebekah Stafford and two other doctors were monitored, and the family was evacuated to Berlin for quarantine and treatment. Last month, the first Ebola case outside Africa was reported in France, where a humanitarian worker tested positive after returning from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がエボラ検査で陽性 | CNN
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクにおいて米国人感染者が確認され、フランス・ドイツへの国際的波及も既に発生しており、致死率も高いことからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイクを主題としており、米国・フランス・ドイツは感染者の後送・治療先であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。ウガンダは近隣国として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。DRCの症例数1,830、死亡648（致死率約35%）と非常に深刻。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Warns Congo Ebola Outbreak May Be Up To Four Times Larger Than Official Figures
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak could be 2–4 times larger than official counts, reflecting difficulties tracing transmission chains. As of the latest government data, there are 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths. About 80% of new infections cannot be linked to known cases, signaling widespread community transmission, with Ituri Province bearing the brunt (≈90% of reported cases). The outbreak extends beyond Ituri to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. In Bunia, test results show persistently high positivity rates, indicating ongoing transmission despite progress in some areas. The findings underscore ongoing containment challenges posed by unlinked transmissions and broad community spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ流行は公式数値の最大4倍に達する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）に加え、市中感染の広がりと追跡不能な感染連鎖が確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 80%の新規感染例が既知の感染連鎖と紐付けできず、市中感染が広範囲に及んでいる点が特に懸念される。イツリ州が最多だが北キブ、南キブ、ツショポ州にも拡大。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Τα 648 έφτασαν τα θύματα της επιδημίας του ιού Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The 648 victims of the Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo total 1,830, with 648 deaths, as of the latest tally following the outbreak declared on May 15. The 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved therapy. Ebola, a hemorrhagic fever, has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past fifty years. The most deadly DRC outbreak occurred during 2018–2020, resulting in about 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths. The current outbreak underscores ongoing transmission risk and the need for continued public health response, surveillance, and containment measures, even in the absence of a targeted vaccine for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラウイルス流行の犠牲者が648人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン未承認)が大規模流行しており、症例数1,830・死者648人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大・支援の必要性も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・承認済み治療法がなく、過去の流行(2018-2020年)でも大規模被害を出しているため継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Warns Congo's Ebola Outbreak Could Be Four Times Larger Than Official Data - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province and Bunia city, with 1,792 infections and 625 deaths reported by July 10, 2026, according to government data. WHO cautions the true burden may be 2–4 times higher due to hidden community transmission, with about 50% of Bunia-tested individuals positive and 80% of recently diagnosed cases in heavily affected areas lacking links to known cases. The outbreak, declared PHEIC in May 2026, has spread beyond Ituri; Uganda reports epidemiologically linked transmission, and a doctor returning to France in June was confirmed with Bundibugyo Ebola. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists; WHO/partners are testing candidates, and a PARTNERS trial is underway. Diagnostic capability expanded in July with a Bundibugyo-specific molecular test added to WHO’s Emergency Use Listing, and about 21,000 community health workers are being trained to strengthen surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴのエボラ流行が公式データの4倍規模になる可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行がDRCで拡大中、公式報告の数倍の感染が疑われ、ウガンダ・フランスへの越境例も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびフランスでの関連症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOはPHEIC下で症例数が公式報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 648 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo rises to 648.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has risen to 1,830 confirmed cases, with 648 deaths, government data released Friday show; the figures reflect confirmed infections up to Thursday. The previous toll was 625 deaths. Health Minister Roger Kamba said authorities expanded the list of affected areas to include Chobo and Haut-Uele provinces in the north and northeast. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with the regional risk assessed as high. The update confirms an ongoing outbreak with continued transmission and the need for sustained public health action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数、648人に増加
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイクが拡大しており、死者数増加・感染地域拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 1830 حالة و648 وفاة وفق أحدث البيانات الرسمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 1,830 cases and 648 deaths according to the latest official data.
article.articleSummary: As of Friday evening, July 10, 2026, government data show Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths. The figures reflect confirmed infections up to Thursday, according to a situation report that records infections and fatalities in the previous 24 hours. The update indicates the outbreak in the DRC remains active, with authorities continuing to tally and report new confirmed cases and deaths as they are identified. This update, published on July 11, 2026, relies on the latest official data available at the time.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が1,830人、死者648人に上昇 最新公式データによる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数1,830件・死亡648件（致死率約35%）という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な監視が必要なアウトブレイクが継続している。
triage.notes: 致死率が約35%と非常に高く、症例数も継続的に増加している大規模なエボラアウトブレイク。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Στους 648 οι θάνατοι από την επιδημία Έμπολα - Cyprus Times
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Deaths from the Ebola outbreak reach 648 - Cyprus Times
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is currently confronting its 17th Ebola outbreak, identified as stemming from the Bundibugyo virus strain. The authorities report 1,830 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 648 deaths since the outbreak was officially declared on 15 May. Notably, the Bundibugyo strain has no available vaccine or proven therapeutic option. Ebola virus disease manifests as a hemorrhagic fever, and, across Africa, has claimed more than 15,000 lives over the last five decades. The most deadly outbreak in the Congo occurred between 2018 and 2020, resulting in about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ流行による死者648人に - Cyprus Times
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生している第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）で1,830症例・648名死亡と大規模化しており、ワクチン・治療法が確立していないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・確立された治療法が存在せず、致死率が高い（648/1830=約35%）。過去の2018-2020年流行（約2300人死亡）に次ぐ規模となっている可能性があり、フルRRAでの継続評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chợ mua bán gia súc lớn nhất Lào Cai tạm dừng hoạt động vì dịch lở mồm long móng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lao Cai's largest livestock market suspends operations due to foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) has triggered containment actions in Lao Cai Province after positive samples for the FMD virus were detected at Bắc Hà’s largest livestock market. The Bắc Hà Commune People’s Committee ordered a suspension of cattle trade, collection, and inter-market transport at Bắc Hà Market from July 11, 2026, until the outbreak is controlled. A cross-sector FMD Control Committee was established; authorities are intensifying biosecurity measures, sanitation, and disinfectant use, and tightening entry controls for people and vehicles to farming areas. Farmers are urged to sign pledges not to conceal disease or engage in selling, transporting, or slaughtering sick animals. Surveillance includes tracing the origins of batches linked to positives, reviewing herd totals, and mobilizing emergency vaccination by assessing vaccine stocks. Communications are being amplified via platforms and mobile broadcasts. Movement of cattle and animal products will be checked for violations to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ラオカイ省最大の家畜市場、口蹄疫のため営業停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（口蹄疫）であり人への直接的な公衆衛生影響は認められないが、家畜市場の閉鎖や緊急対応措置など経済・農業への影響があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物疾病（口蹄疫）であり、人畜共通感染症ではないためヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは低い。ただし家畜市場閉鎖や貿易制限的措置が取られており、農業・経済への影響として注視対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Spike in homosexual HIV infections sparks grave concern from Ghana AIDS Commission - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-11, HIV prevalence among homosexuals in Ghana's Bono Region is 26%, per Ahmed Ibrahim Bambilla, Bono, Bono East and Ahafo Regional Coordinator of the Ghana AIDS Commission. The region also shows 6% HIV prevalence among commercial sex workers, prompting concern about rising infections in the gay community. GAC is distributing Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP) to vulnerable groups, citing high efficacy. Bambilla urged consistent ART adherence, noting that six months of regular medication can achieve viral suppression. He cited that the country has reached 89% viral suppression, reducing onward transmission. The remarks were made in Sunyani during a media interview, underscoring ongoing prevention programs to curb new infections and protect people living with HIV.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ・エイズ委員会、同性愛者間のHIV感染急増に重大な懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症であるHIVの特定集団における有病率報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威や社会的関心の急激な高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、ART・PrEPによる管理体制が既に確立されている。地域保健当局によるルーティンの啓発・予防プログラムの一環としての発言であり、突発的な公衆衛生危機ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ভারতে ফিরছে কোভিড-১৯? ভাইরাসের প্রত্যাবর্তন নিয়ে মিলে গেল বাবা ভাঙ্গার ভয়ঙ্কর ভবিষ্যদ্বাণী
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is COVID-19 returning to India? Baba Vanga's terrifying prophecy about the virus's return has come true.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 persists with limited transmission globally, including India where one death and a few additional infections have been reported. Online claims about Baba Vanga’s prophecy resurfacing lack credible evidence or historical documentation. Experts note that new viral variants arise through mutation, but a new variant does not automatically recreate the 2020-type crisis. The World Health Organization and national public health agencies continue to monitor the situation; rising cases trigger genome sequencing, surveillance, and reinforced health measures as needed. Preventive practices—handwashing, masking when appropriate, resting at home when ill, and vaccination for high-risk groups—remain effective. Public health decisions should be guided by scientific data and official guidance, not social media rumors. Although not fully over, the current situation is comparatively well controlled, and advances strengthen the ability to respond to future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: インドでCOVID-19が再流行？ウイルス再来をめぐるババ・ヴァンガの恐ろしい予言が的中
triage.triage_reason: 記事は予言・オカルト話題を中心とした内容であり、実際の公衆衛生上の異常な増加や重大な影響を示す情報はなく、COVID-19は既知の低レベル流行として言及されているに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はオカルト的な予言話題が中心で、COVID-19自体は「限定的な流行が継続」「よく制御されている」と評されており、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns DR Congo Ebola outbreak is spreading largely undetected
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia, continues to spread largely undetected in heavily affected areas. 70-80% of new Bunia-area cases originate from outside known contact lists, hindering transmission-tracing. Government data report 1,792 infections and 625 deaths, while WHO modeling suggests the true scale could be two to four times larger than reported. In response, authorities are training 21,000 community health workers to conduct house-to-house visits, identify suspected cases, and encourage patients to seek care. This underscores ongoing transmission and the need for intensified surveillance and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが検知されないまま拡大していると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで、既知の接触者リスト外からの感染が70-80%を占め、実際の感染規模が報告の2-4倍の可能性があるとWHOが警告しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHOがモデリングにより実際の感染規模を報告の2-4倍と推定しており、感染追跡が困難な状況。21,000人の地域保健ワーカー動員という大規模対応が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Citizen Tests Positive for Ebola in Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-11, the CDC announced a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola, caused by Bundibugyo virus, one of three Ebola species for which there are no targeted vaccines or treatments. The CDC is coordinating with the employer, U.S. agencies, public health authorities, and Congolese partners to prevent further transmission and identify close contacts. The ongoing outbreak in Congo has caused more than 600 deaths out of about 1,800 cases, with spillover to Uganda (20 confirmed cases, two deaths) per the World Health Organization. The article notes a prior U.S. case, Dr. Peter Stafford, who contracted Ebola in May in Congo, was treated in Berlin, and returned to the U.S. after recovery. It also references political controversy over U.S. entry or quarantine plans for exposed Americans, including discussions to relocate patients to Kenya, which faced legal opposition and lacked a clear plan as of publication.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染した米国市民が陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ流行（600人以上死亡、1800症例）にワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョウ株が関与し、米国市民の感染と国際的な政治論争（検疫・入国方針）が発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たすシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダへのスピルオーバー（20症例、2死亡）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。米国・ドイツ・ケニアも同様に対象国リスト外のため除外。ブンディブギョウ・エボラウイルスはワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo'da Çalışan ABD'li Ebola Oldu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American with Ebola who worked in DR Congo has died.
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The CDC says it is working with the worker’s employer, other federal agencies, and Congolese partners to break the transmission chain and identify high-risk contacts; no further patient details have been released by the CDC or the State Department. In the DRC outbreak, confirmed Ebola cases total 1,830 with 648 deaths. The United States has not confirmed any Ebola cases; risk to the American public and travelers remains low, with the outbreak confined to remote areas of the DRC and neighboring Uganda and very low US-spread risk. Earlier, in May, American aid worker Peter Stafford, a Christian missionary doctor, tested positive for Ebola-like symptoms; his wife Rebekah Stafford and others who treated patients in the DRC were monitored. Stafford was evacuated to Berlin for treatment and quarantine. France later reported its first Ebola case outside Africa after a humanitarian worker returned from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で活動していた米国人がエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（確定1,830例、死亡648例）に加え、米国人援助者の感染・死亡、ドイツ（ベルリン）への搬送、フランスでのアフリカ域外初症例報告など国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国、フランス、ドイツ（ベルリン）は搬送・報告先であり感染発生地ではないため対象国リストから除外。ウガンダは隣接感染拡大地域として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго достигло 648
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in DR Congo has reached 648.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, the Ebola fever death toll in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 648. The report notes outbreaks driven by a new Ebola virus variant that has sparked transmission in several African countries. Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov stated that Moscow is prepared in a short timeframe to deploy serial production of a vaccine against this variant, aiming to accelerate vaccination in affected regions. He added that Russian specialists have previously worked in the region and conducted the field research necessary to support vaccine development. The piece emphasizes vaccine manufacturing as a key response amid multi-country outbreaks, though it provides no details on vaccine trials, timelines, or efficacy.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が648人に到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新変異株による複数国での感染拡大と多数の死者が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・国際的拡大リスクの観点からフルRRAが必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ロシアはワクチン供給支援を表明しているのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。新変異株による多国感染拡大の詳細（具体的な国名・症例数）は記事内に不明瞭。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : cinq cas d'Ebola pourraient être déclarés guéris dans la zone de santé de Nizi - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: five Ebola cases could be declared cured in the Nizi health zone - LePotentiel.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Ituri's Nizi health zone, Djugu territory, Democratic Republic of Congo. As of July 11, 2026, five patients could be declared cured in the coming days. The advancement stems from a new on-site laboratory enabling local diagnostics, replacing prior shipments of samples to Bunia over 30 kilometers away, reducing diagnostic delays and aiding patient follow-up. An Ebola Treatment Center at the Nizi General Reference Hospital has begun admitting patients, with several showing positive evolution under partner support; previously critical patients were reported to be able to walk outside after about a week. Dr. Jean-Claude Lonzana, the zone medical chief, notes that on-site testing accelerates control exams and monitoring, and he anticipates at least five cures within four days, signaling encouraging progress in Ituri's Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：ニジ保健地域でエボラ患者5人が近く治癒宣言される可能性 - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR附属書2で常に通報対象となる重篤な疾患であり、DRCイトゥリ州で進行中のアウトブレイクに関する続報であるため、経過確認のためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は治癒進展という前向きな内容だが、エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイクであり、パートナー支援（国際支援）を受けている点から継続監視が必要。新規感染者数や地理的拡大に関する情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola. Repubblica Democratica del Congo: 648 decessi su un totale di 1.830 casi confermati
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. Democratic Republic of the Congo: 648 deaths out of a total of 1,830 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: On 11 July 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,830 laboratory-confirmed cases and 648 deaths. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is the seventeenth Ebola epidemic in the country and is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or antiviral treatment. Ebola virus disease presents as a hemorrhagic fever and has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades. The most lethal DRC outbreak occurred from 2018 to 2020, with about 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths. No details on imported or exported cases are provided, and laboratory confirmation remains central to counting cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱。コンゴ民主共和国：確定症例1,830例中648人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率35%超のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクで大規模拡大中、ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬なし。IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による第17次アウトブレイクで、既に1,830例・648死亡と大規模化。国境を越えた拡大の有無は記事内に情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo eleva a 648 el número de muertos y a 1.830 los casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the death toll to 648 and 1,830 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: as of 10 July, 648 deaths and 1,830 confirmed cases (case fatality rate 35.4%). About 780 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, with 285 recoveries; contact tracing stands at 78.1%. The outbreak centers on Ituri (epicenter) and the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu, with South Kivu surpassing 42 days without a new confirmed case, signaling potential end in that province. Ituri began the outbreak on 15 May near Uganda and South Sudan, and it has spread to Uganda (20 confirmed cases, 15 imported from the DRC) with 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment (CFR 30-50%). WHO deems the risk high for sub-Saharan Africa, low globally; circulation started about two months before declaration, and the outbreak was declared a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May. This is the third-worst Ebola epidemic and the 17th in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死者数を648人、確定症例数を1,830人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で死者648名・症例1,830件、ウガンダへの国際伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOは17日にPHEICを宣言済みで、ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特異的治療法がない点にも注意。

article.articleHeadline: 46-Year-Old Dies of COVID-19 in Andhra Pradesh's Kadapa, Contact Tracing Begins
article.articleSummary: 46-year-old man from Masapeta, Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, India, died after four days of treatment from COVID-19, marking the first COVID-19 death in Kadapa in four years. He presented with severe breathlessness and persistent cough; history of alcohol addiction. Initial management with high-dose antibiotics yielded no improvement. Chest imaging revealed extensive bilateral lung damage consistent with pneumonia, and CT scanning confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection. In response, Kadapa District authorities sanitised the affected area and launched tracing of primary and secondary contacts with containment protocols in place. Health officials urged vigilance and prompt medical attention for respiratory symptoms and adherence to public health advisories. The case underscores ongoing containment efforts in Kadapa following infection confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州カダパで46歳男性がCOVID-19で死亡、接触者追跡開始
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19による単発の死亡例であり、既に地域当局が接触者追跡・封じ込め対応を行っている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に流行性疾患として定着しており、単発の死亡例（基礎疾患：アルコール依存症）であるため、フルリスク評価の対象とはならない。地域として4年ぶりの死亡例という点はローカルニュースとしての意味合いのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Chăn nuôi duy trì tăng trưởng trước áp lực dịch bệnh gia tăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Livestock farming maintains growth amid rising disease pressure.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's livestock sector maintains growth amid disease pressure in 2026. African swine fever outbreaks reach 697 across 28 provinces, up about 60% year-on-year. Avian influenza outbreaks occur in 15 provinces, rising 3.8-fold. Lumpy skin disease outbreaks and cattle infections decline, though rabies remains in several localities, demanding ongoing surveillance. The pig herd grew about 2.2%, supporting pork output of roughly 2.86 million tonnes in six months, with notable gains in Lam Dong (5.5%), Ho Chi Minh City (4.5%), Dong Nai (4.2%), Phu Tho (3.8%), and Bac Ninh (3.1%). Poultry sectors show robust growth: total fowl stock up 3.1% by end-June; live poultry meat output about 1.3 million tonnes (+5.6%), and eggs ~10.8 billion (+2.6%). To ensure supply, authorities urge vaccination, biosecurity, transport/slaughter/trade monitoring, vaccine stocking, routine disinfection, and strict control of prohibited substances and antibiotics; promote traceability and safe, connected value chains.

triage.headline_ja: 疫病圧力の増大の中で畜産業は成長を維持
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱・鳥インフルエンザなど家畜疾病の発生数が大幅増加（鳥インフルは3.8倍）しているが、人への感染や重症例の報告はなく、記事は主に畜産業の経済動向を扱っているため、直接的なヒト公衆衛生シグナルとしての情報は不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は家畜疾病（ASF、鳥インフルエンザ、LSD、狂犬病）の発生状況を背景とした畜産業の経済成長報告であり、ヒトへの感染例は言及されていない。鳥インフルエンザの発生数が3.8倍に急増している点は、今後のヒトへのスピルオーバーリスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى أكثر من 1700 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in the number of confirmed Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to more than 1,700 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,792 confirmed Ebola virus infections and 625 deaths, according to health authorities. Ebola is a highly dangerous virus that causes an acute illness with potential fatal outcomes. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids from an infected person or from a deceased individual who had the disease. The figures come from statistical data released by the country’s health authorities, reflecting an ongoing Ebola outbreak within the DRC and signaling a substantial mortality burden. The report underscores the continued public health challenge posed by the outbreak and highlights the need for sustained surveillance, infection prevention, and response measures in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルス確定感染者数が1,700人超に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行が1,792例・625死亡と大規模化しており、致死率も高く公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラ流行の継続報告であり新規性はないが、症例数・死亡者数の規模から継続監視及びリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sankuru : plus de 30 morts à Lusambo, le gouvernement sonne l'alerte face à une épidémie de rage canine - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sankuru: More than 30 dead in Lusambo as the government sounds the alarm over a canine rabies outbreak - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Canine rabies outbreak in Lusambo, Sankuru Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, has killed more than 30 people. Reported at the government’s 94th Council of Ministers meeting in Kinshasa, the alert underscores urgent intervention to contain the deadly disease. Government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya stated the Lusambo outbreak requires immediate health and veterinary actions and poses a major risk to local populations. Authorities plan to intensify prevention and control, including launching the second phase of the epizootic vaccination campaign and maintaining national animal vaccination programs to protect remaining livestock, limit human transmission, and safeguard rural livelihoods. Rabies is a viral infection typically transmitted to humans via dog bites or saliva from infected animals and is almost always fatal once symptoms appear. The article calls for heightened awareness, animal vaccination, and prompt care for exposed people to prevent further spread in Sankuru.

triage.headline_ja: サンクル州:ルサンボで30人以上死亡、政府が犬狂犬病の流行に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCサンクル州ルサンボで犬狂犬病により30人以上が死亡し、政府が閣議で緊急対応を表明するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるため、IHR基準を2つ満たしPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染しないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、致死率がほぼ100%であり大量死亡例が報告されている点、政府が国レベルで緊急対応を発表している点から重大なシグナルとして扱う。続報でワクチン接種状況や追加死亡者数の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 46-Year-Old Dies Of Covid-19 In Andhra Man's Kadapa; Contact Tracing Initiated
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 death in Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh: A 46-year-old man from Masapeta area died four days after high-dose antibiotic treatment failed to control severe breathlessness and cough. An X-ray showed both lungs were completely damaged, leading to pneumonia. A CT chest confirmed Covid-19 infection after symptoms persisted. Kadapa District Medical & Health Officer Ravi Babu stated containment measures, including sanitisation and tracing of primary and secondary contacts of the deceased, were initiated. The patient was reportedly an alcoholic and admitted to a local hospital for severe breathlessness and cough. Public health officials are pursuing contact tracing to prevent further transmission as of 11 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州カダパで46歳男性がCOVID-19で死亡、接触者追跡を開始
triage.triage_reason: 個別の死亡例報告であり、現時点でクラスター化や急拡大の証拠はないが、COVID-19であることと接触者追跡が開始されている点から継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 基礎疾患（アルコール多飲）を有する個別症例で、重症化し死亡。地域保健当局は接触者追跡を実施中だが、クラスターや広範な感染拡大の情報はない。続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: 1830 κρούσματα του ιού Έμπολα στο Κονγκό, στους 648 οι θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1830 Ebola virus cases in Congo, with 648 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing the 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. As of 11 July 2026, authorities report 1,830 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 648 deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever and has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades. The most deadly outbreak in the DRC occurred during 2018–2020, with roughly 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain circulating in the DRC lacks approved preventive or curative options, posing ongoing public health challenges as surveillance and containment efforts continue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルス感染症1830例、死者648人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が進行中で、有効なワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo株により1830例・648人死亡という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo株による大規模流行であり、致死率も高いため優先度の高いシグナルと判断。続報でヒト-ヒト感染の広がりや国際的拡大リスクの詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'Korku filmi gibi': Beyin yiyen amip salgını dünyaya yayılıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Like a horror movie': Brain-eating amoeba outbreak spreading worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba causing primary amebic meningoencephalitis (PAM), is spreading beyond traditional warm-water sites. An 11-year-old American, Jordan, died after exposure during a Costa Rica vacation, his illness beginning with headache and vomiting and progressing to seizures and severe brain swelling. 488 cases were reported from 1962–2023, with about 97% fatal, initially concentrated in the U.S. South, Pakistan, and Australia. In the last two decades, cases have surfaced in Italy and Belgium, and recently in cooler areas like Minnesota. Slovakia recorded its first confirmed case in 2023; Taiwan had a fatal case in 2023; a U.S. child was infected at a contaminated water play area that year. India reported more than 200 cases in Kerala in 2025—the largest outbreak on record. Climate warming is expanding habitats; children around age 12 are most at risk. Early diagnosis and treatment offer limited survival, though improved detection may raise counts.

triage.headline_ja: 「まるでホラー映画」：脳を食べるアメーバの感染が世界的に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」の2つが該当し、特にインド・ケララ州で過去最大規模（200例超）のNaegleria fowleri感染が2025年に報告されている点が注目される。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界各地（米国、パキスタン、オーストラリア、イタリア、ベルギー、スロバキア、台湾等）でのNaegleria fowleri感染拡大を概観する内容だが、対象国リストに該当するのはインド（ケララ州）のみ。ケララ州の2025年アウトブレイクは過去最大規模（200例超）で致死率も高いため注視が必要。ヒト-ヒト感染はないため、国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクは低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo rises to 648
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 648 people and left 1,830 confirmed cases. Kinshasa health authorities said the latest figures, covering the past 24 hours, reflect ongoing transmission. The government has expanded the list of affected provinces to include Tshopo and Haut-Uele in the country's north and northeast. The World Health Organization warned that the actual scale could be two to four times higher than official counts, and noted that in some areas four out of five new infections are not linked to known cases. The report underscores surveillance gaps and the difficulty of tracing transmission across regional outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数648人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者648人、確認症例1830人）で複数州に拡大し、WHOは実際の規模が公式統計の2〜4倍に達する可能性を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: WHOは感染者数が公式統計より大幅に過小評価されている可能性を指摘し、既知の感染者と関連しない新規感染が多数を占めるなど、サーベイランス体制の脆弱性と地域を跨いだ感染追跡の困難さが強調されている。感染拡大地域（Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Kinshasa）にまたがる深刻な流行状況。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून में सबसे ज्यादा फैलती हैं ये बीमारियां, ऐसे करें बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These diseases spread the most during the monsoon season; take these precautions.
article.articleSummary: India’s monsoon season elevates dengue and malaria as standing water in pots, coolers, old tires, and street potholes boosts mosquito breeding by up to 40%. Dengue, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes that bite mainly during the day, presents with sudden high fever, behind-the-eye pain, and severe joint pains; malaria, spread by Anopheles mosquitoes, causes fever with chills. Typhoid and gastroenteritis rise due to contaminated drinking water and food, with typhoid (Salmonella Typhi) causing persistent fever and abdominal pain, and gastroenteritis causing vomiting, diarrhea, and cramps. Viral fever and flu become common with changing weather and respiratory spread. Prevention: stop water stagnation around homes (plant tray and cooler siting, debris removal), boil or filter drinking water, avoid street foods, eat fresh hot meals, wear long sleeves, and apply mosquito repellent. NDTV outlines these monsoon health risks in India as of July 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期に最も流行する病気とその予防法
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の異常発生や集団感染事例の報告ではないため、シグナルとして扱う根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 本記事はモンスーン季節に伴う一般的な感染症予防の啓発記事であり、具体的な発生事例・症例数・地域の報告を含まないため、対象国リストに該当する具体的な発生イベントとしては verified_locations を空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Pradesh Reports Two COVID-19 Deaths After Four Years; Cases Rise
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, Andhra Pradesh reports two COVID-19 deaths after four years, with two infections in Kadapa from different localities. Both patients had two vaccine doses, and one had a booster, underscoring that vaccination reduces severe disease risk but breakthrough infections can occur. The first fatality was a 60-year-old who died June 28 during treatment at CMC Vellore after referral from SVIMS, Tirupati; RT-PCR confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection. The second was a 43-year-old who tested positive and died during treatment. Both had complex medical conditions. These cases appear against a backdrop of rising COVID-19 activity in the state, illustrating that serious outcomes can occur even with vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州、4年ぶりにCOVID-19による死亡2例を報告、感染者数増加
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19による死亡例は基礎疾患を有する患者に限られ、現時点で大規模な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はないが、州内での感染増加傾向が見られるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 死亡例はいずれも基礎疾患を有する高齢者・既往症患者であり、COVID-19自体の重症化リスクは低いと考えられる。ただし州内での感染者数増加が報告されており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: গুজরাতে ফের চাঁদীপুরা ভাইরাসের আতঙ্ক, তিন শিশুর মৃত্যু, কী রোগ ছড়াচ্ছে?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gujarat again, Chandipura virus scare; three children have died; what disease is spreading?
article.articleSummary: Chandipura vesiculovirus, a member of the Rhabdoviridae family, is causing a fresh outbreak in Gujarat, India, with three child deaths and rising cases as of July 11, 2026. The virus, first identified in Chandipura village, Maharashtra (1965), shows higher activity in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh. It is not spread by sneezing or coughing; transmission occurs via sandflies and can also spread through fly-borne contamination from feces. In children it causes Acute Encephalitis Syndrome, with high fever, severe brain inflammation, dizziness, vomiting, seizures, loss of consciousness, and possible paralysis; disease can progress rapidly, with death in 24–48 hours in severe cases. No specific antiviral or vaccine exists; treatment is supportive. Preventive measures include vector control during the monsoon, avoiding exposed street foods, keeping surroundings clean, eliminating standing water, wearing long sleeves, and using bed nets; seek rapid medical care for fever or seizures.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州で再びチャンディプラウイルスの恐怖、子供3人死亡；どのような病気が広がっているのか？
triage.triage_reason: 小児の急性脳炎症候群による死亡例が複数報告され、致死率が高く進行が急速であることから重症度基準を満たし、媒介動物（サシチョウバエ）による継続的曝露と流行の可能性がある。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスは1965年にマハラシュトラ州で初めて確認され、以降グジャラート州を含む複数州でモンスーン期に季節的に発生する既知のウイルスである。今回も同様のパターンだが、小児死亡例の発生と急速な進行から注視が必要。国際的拡大やWHO通知の兆候は現時点で見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Beyin Yiyen Amip Kabusu: 11 Yaşındaki Jordan Tatil Dönüşü Hayatını Kaybetti, Uzmanlar Artan Vakalara Karşı Uyarıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brain-Eating Amoeba Nightmare: 11-Year-Old Jordan Dies on Return from Vacation, Experts Warn of Rising Cases
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri infection causes primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) when the amoeba enters via the nose in warm freshwater, often in hot springs, lakes, or pools. An 11-year-old from Florida died after a Costa Rica vacation, seven and a half days after swimming in a natural spa near their hotel; initial meningitis-like symptoms progressed to brain swelling and death in intensive care. PAM is nearly always fatal; global cases number under 500 since first detection, with about 97% mortality. India reported over 200 cases last year—the largest outbreak on record. In the past two decades, cases have appeared in Italy and Belgium, and more recently in Minnesota and other colder regions; Slovakia reported its first confirmed case last year; Taiwan saw a death in 2023. Children around age 12 are most affected. Warmer lake temperatures may expand the parasite’s range, though improved testing boosts detection.

triage.headline_ja: 脳を食べるアメーバの悪夢：休暇から帰国した11歳のジョーダン君が死亡、専門家は増加する症例に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 主要な事例は対象国外（コスタリカでの旅行後死亡）であり、インドの症例は昨年の既報データの引用に過ぎず新規イベントではないため、フルRRAへの移行は時期尚早と判断。ヒト-ヒト感染がなく国際的拡大リスクは低いが、症例増加傾向の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はコスタリカ旅行後にフロリダの児童が死亡した事例（対象国外）であり、インドの200件超の症例は『昨年』の既報として言及されているのみで、新規の発生報告ではない。Naegleria fowleriはヒト-ヒト感染がなく、温水環境への曝露による散発例であるため、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、症例地理的拡大の傾向は今後の動向として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: إصابة أمريكي بفيروس "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American infected with the Ebola virus in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen working for an international humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo has a laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus infection, identified as the Bundibugyo strain, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). The patient’s infection was confirmed in Congo, and the CDC has launched urgent, wide-scale medical coordination with the patient’s organization, U.S. agencies, and local and international partners to provide care and to rapidly identify and monitor close contacts at high risk to implement strict preventive measures to prevent spread. Government figures cited by Reuters indicate that Ebola in the Congo has caused 648 deaths among 1,830 confirmed cases. The article notes the outbreak is ongoing, with authorities tracing contacts and containment steps following the laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行は致死率が高く（648/1830）、米国人感染者の発生により国際的拡大リスクが顕在化しているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし国際的な人的往来による拡大リスクとして特記すべき事案。CDCが積極的にコンタクトトレーシングを実施中。

article.articleHeadline: MSF Ebola training in Kenya prepares doctors for 'intense' job
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the fastest-growing since mid-May, with at least 600 deaths among 1,759 confirmed cases. Health workers comprise 112 of the cases, with 35 deaths. Factors include extreme poverty, armed groups, and misinformation that hampers treatment and may lead to attacks on health workers. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) has established a training centre in Kenya, equipped with beds, mannequins, a mock laboratory, and PPE, to ready doctors, nurses, and clinicians for deployments to the DRC or other at‑risk regional countries. The initiative follows MSF’s rehabilitation of an Ebola Treatment Center in Munigi on June 2, 2026, highlighting the ongoing outbreak’s scale and the critical need for skilled frontline staff.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、ケニアでエボラ対応訓練を実施し、医師を『過酷な』任務に備えさせる
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は1,759例・600人死亡と5月中旬以降で最も急速に拡大しており、医療従事者への感染も多数発生。IHR基準に複数該当し、国際支援体制（MSFのケニア訓練拠点設立）も進行中であることからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にフィリピン(Northern Mindanao)が含まれているが、記事本文はDRCのエボラ流行とケニアでの訓練活動が主題であり、フィリピンでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。ケニアも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع وفيات فيروس "إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 648 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus death toll in Congo rises to 648.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 648 deaths and 1,830 confirmed infections. The latest figures, reported over the past 24 hours, show the outbreak extending to Chopo and Haut-Uele provinces in the north and northeast. The World Health Organization has previously indicated the true scale could be two to four times higher than official counts, noting that in some areas about 80% of new infections are not linked to known cases. Chinese health experts have arrived in Kampala, Uganda, to assist response efforts; Beijing has previously dispatched two expert teams to the DRC. The new delegation engaged with Ugandan authorities, WHO’s Ebola Incident Management Team, and Africa CDC to provide guidance and support for containment, with China pledging continued assistance as needed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルスによる死者数、648人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（死者648人、感染1,830人）で複数州に拡大、WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性を指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampala）、中国（Beijing）は支援活動に関連する記述であり、感染発生地ではないため対象国リストに含めない。ウガンダは非対象国のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: फरीदाबाद में बढ़ा डेंगू का खतरा, लार्वा मिलने पर 50 से अधिक लोगों को नोटिस जारी - faridabad dengue cases rise health dept issues notices prevention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue risk increases in Faridabad; Health Department issues notices to over 50 people after larvae were found.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Faridabad district, Haryana, faces rising dengue and malaria risk. The health department has confirmed four additional dengue cases and two malaria cases, with monsoon-related standing water and cooler-water containers fostering larvae. In response, authorities have issued notices to over 50 residents whose homes harbor larvae and launched house-to-house anti-larva campaigns, plus fogging in sensitive areas. Blood tests are being conducted for every fever patient to detect malaria or dengue. Asha workers and health staff are conducting surveys and urging cleaning of water-holding sites such as coolers, pots, tires, and tanks.
