Preventive measures include eliminating standing water, wearing full-sleeve clothing, using bed nets, avoiding self-medication for fever, and seeking prompt medical care if symptoms like high fever, severe body pains, vomiting, or bleeding appear.

triage.headline_ja: ファリダバードでデング熱の危険性が増大、幼虫発見により50人以上に通知書発行
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリア発生であり、地方当局による通常の対応（防疫活動、通知発行）が実施されている。規模は小さく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節に伴う典型的なデング熱・マラリアの発生であり、地方保健当局が通常の防疫措置（幼虫駆除、燻蒸、血液検査）を実施中。症例数は少数（デング4例、マラリア2例）で、地域レベルの季節性イベントとして経過観察の対象にも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: MSF Ebola training in Kenya prepares doctors for 'intense' job
article.articleSummary: MSF has opened an Ebola training centre in Kenya to prepare clinicians for deployments to the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak has rapidly expanded since being declared in mid-May, with at least 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases, including 112 health workers (35 fatalities). The Kenya facility, fitted with beds, mannequins, a mock laboratory and PPE, trains doctors, nurses and clinicians in outbreak response, community engagement, safe funerals and reducing stigma for recovered patients. Training began mid-June and runs through August (potentially longer), targeting about 100 participants per month, initially MSF staff but also Kenyan Ministry of Health officials and staff from other NGOs. Trainees, such as Cisse Papa Ndiaga, a Senegalese MSF physician preparing for DRC deployment, gain PPE experience; Diana Corben emphasizes empathy and understanding for communities amid fear, misinformation, and violence in the region.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、ケニアでエボラ研修を実施し『過酷な』任務に医師を備えさせる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（600人死亡、1759症例確定、医療従事者112人感染）は深刻な公衆衛生イベントであり、IHR基準複数該当・国際支援体制（MSFトレーニング）が構築されている。
triage.notes: 記事自体はケニアでのMSF研修施設に関する内容だが、背景にあるDRCのエボラ流行（5月中旬宣言以降急速拡大、600人死亡、112医療従事者感染）が本質的な公衆衛生シグナルである。ケニア・セネガルは研修拠点・派遣元であり実際の発生国ではないため除外。既に既知の大規模流行として継続的リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : le renforcement de contrôle des déplacements face au risque d'importation - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: Strengthening Movement Controls in Light of the Risk of Importation - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease risk prompts strengthened community movement controls in Muzi-Pela, Bunia, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Authorities register all arrivals from Ebola-affected Djugu and other zones, with Muzi-Pela housing about 90% of Djugu nationals, including displaced persons. Daily entries from Lopa, Mongbwalu, Nizi and nearby areas are recorded to identify people with suspicious signs and to relay information to response teams. On average, more than 50 new arrivals are registered weekly. Led by 19 avenue chiefs, this surveillance aims to detect potential cases early and interrupt transmission chains as part of the Ebola response. Local market-avenue leadership emphasizes community sensitization on barrier measures and prompt reporting of suspected cases or unusual deaths. The effort, supported by the Judith Suminwa Foundation and the Prime Minister, seeks sustained community collaboration to prevent importation and spread of Ebola in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ出血熱:輸入リスクを踏まえた移動管理の強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の感染拡大リスクが継続しており、影響地域からの人口移動による感染拡大（輸入)リスクに対応した移動管理強化が実施されている。IHR基準に複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブニア（イトゥリ州）における、ジュグ地域からのエボラ感染者流入リスクに対する地域監視強化についての内容。首相府傘下の財団が支援しており、政府レベルでの関与が確認される。既存のDRCエボラアウトブレイクの継続的対応の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus In Gujarat Kills Three Children: All About The Rare Brain Infection, Symptoms And Preventive Measures
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus (CHPV) has caused three child deaths in Gujarat, in Sabarkantha and Panchmahal districts, prompting high-alert status during the monsoon. The rare but potentially fatal agent causes Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES); three confirmed or suspected CHPV infections are under intensified surveillance, with door-to-door checks and laboratory testing ongoing. Children under 15, especially those under 10, are most vulnerable due to developing immunity and outdoor exposure. Symptoms appear suddenly and can progress within hours to high fever, severe headache, vomiting, muscle pain, irritability, seizures, and loss of consciousness as CNS involvement develops. Transmission occurs mainly via bites of infected sandflies; no documented human-to-human transmission. No antiviral or vaccine exists; management is supportive (IV fluids, fever/seizure control, oxygen, neurological monitoring). Prevention focuses on reducing sandfly bites and breeding sites: nets, repellents, protective clothing, sanitation, drains, fogging, and early medical care for febrile/neuro symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスにより子ども3人死亡：まれな脳感染症の症状と予防策について
triage.triage_reason: 小児3名の死亡を伴う稀な急性脳炎症候群（チャンディプラウイルス）の発生であり、深刻性と異常性の両基準に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: サシチョウバエ媒介で人-人感染は報告されていないが、モンスーン期の媒介虫増加により地域内での継続的な曝露リスクがある。グジャラート州（ADM1）は対象国リストに含まれないため国レベルのIndiaのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases climb to over 1,800 in DR Congo as virus spreads to 4th province
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,800 confirmed cases, reaching 1,830 with 648 deaths since it began on May 15. About 780 patients are under treatment, and 284 have recovered. The outbreak has been concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with transmission spreading to a fourth province, Haut-Uele, after seven fatal cases in the Wamba health zone. Donors and partners have pledged $910 million to support the response in Congo and neighboring Uganda, which has 20 cases. Africa CDC has deployed multidisciplinary expert teams to priority zones, covering 83% of cases, as part of a decentralized response. The World Health Organization classified the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例が1,800人を超え、ウイルスは第4の州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラアウトブレイクで、症例数1,830人・死亡648人、第4州への拡大とウガンダへの国際的拡散が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20症例確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは2026年5月17日にBundibugyo株エボラをPHEICに指定済み。

article.articleHeadline: Уже второй гражданин США заразился смертельной лихорадкой Эбола в ДР Конго - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A second American has contracted deadly Ebola fever in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: July 11, 2026: A second American has contracted Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), working for a humanitarian organization. The patient is infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of the Ebola types. This follows the first American case earlier this year, a 39-year-old man who recovered in Germany. The U.S. CDC, the patient’s employer, and other federal agencies, along with health authorities and partners in the DRC, are coordinating to prevent further transmission by identifying and assessing contacts at risk. Context: the DRC Ebola outbreak has previously resulted in about 492 deaths. The report cites Reuters and CDC information to document ongoing containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴで2人目の米国人がエボラ出血熱に感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで継続発生し、米国人感染者(2人目)が確認され国際的な人的往来を通じた拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへ。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは感染者の渡航先・治療国であり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。既に492人の死者が出ている継続的アウトブレイクで、外国人労働者への感染は国際的関心を高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil is releasing millions of genetically modified mosquitoes to fight one of its worst dengue outbreaks in years
article.articleSummary: Brazil releases millions of genetically modified male Aedes aegypti mosquitoes to curb dengue amid one of its worst outbreaks in years. PAHO reports more than 1,000,000 dengue cases in the first two months of 2026, up over 200% from the same period last year, with Rio de Janeiro recording over 42,000 cases and declaring a public health emergency. Oxitec’s modified males carry a gene causing female offspring to die before adulthood, reducing the disease-carrying mosquito population; the company notes local suppression can reach as much as 90% where deployed. Eggs in boxes hatch in about ten days, releasing adults to mate. Suzano in São Paulo state is among cities using this approach, alongside other measures like Wolbachia. Safety concerns exist, but there is no evidence this poses risks to humans; long-term effects remain unknown. Dengue pressure rises during Brazil’s rainy season (October–May).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、記録的なデング熱流行に対抗するため遺伝子組換え蚊数百万匹を放出
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで前年比200%増となる100万件超のデング症例が報告され、リオデジャネイロが公衆衛生非常事態を宣言するなど深刻な影響が見られるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: PAHOによる報告と公衆衛生非常事態宣言があり、季節性(雨季)要因も影響。遺伝子組換え蚊(Oxitec社)による媒介対策が進行中だが、長期的な安全性・効果は未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Еще один американец заразился Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American has contracted Ebola.
article.articleSummary: A United States citizen has contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking another American infected in the outbreak, according to Reuters. In the DRC, 1,830 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded, up 32 in the last day, with a case-fatality rate of 34.9%. The first U.S. patient in this outbreak, a 39-year-old man, was flown in May to a German hospital and has since recovered. Details on the current patient are not provided. Ebola typically begins with high fever, weakness, and muscle pains, followed by diarrhea, abdominal pain, and a dry cough causing dehydration. About half of patients develop a hemorrhagic rash and bleeding from gums or nose, with potential liver and kidney failure. Incubation is 2 to 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: またもやアメリカ人がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,830例確認・致死率34.9%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、米国人感染者が国境を越えて発生していることから国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは感染者の搬送先であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。DRCでの流行拡大が主題。

article.articleHeadline: চার বছর পর ফের কোভিডে দু'জনের মৃত্যু! কতটা উদ্বেগের, কী বলছেন বিশেষজ্ঞরা?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two deaths from COVID-19 again after four years! How concerning is it, what do experts say?
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths reported in Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, four years after previous fatalities, as four more residents test positive by RT-PCR. The four new infections are from different areas; three are asymptomatic or mild and isolating at home, while one with mild breathlessness has been hospitalized in a COVID facility. All four had two vaccine doses; one had a booster. Experts say vaccination substantially lowers risk of severe disease and death, though immunity can wane and new variants can cause breakthrough infections. The fatalities involve a 60-year-old man transferred from Tirupati SVIMS Hospital to Vellore CMC and who died during treatment (infection confirmed posthumously), and a 43-year-old man who died while under COVID treatment. High-risk groups include diabetes, heart disease, kidney disease, COPD, cancer, obesity, or immunocompromise. Health authorities report no evidence of widespread transmission yet and urge vigilance, masks in crowds if needed, home isolation for symptoms, protecting the elderly, ventilation, hygiene, and prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 4年ぶりにCOVID-19で2人死亡！どれほど懸念すべきか、専門家の見解は？
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な死亡例と少数の新規感染が報告されているが、当局は広範な感染拡大の証拠はないとしており、現時点では限定的な事例と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 4年ぶりの死亡例だが基礎疾患を有する高リスク者であり、当局は広範な流行の兆候はないと述べている。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ஆந்திராவில் கொரோனா பாதிப்பு - மத்திய அரசு எச்சரிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 infection in Andhra Pradesh - Central government warns
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infection has been detected in Kadapa district, Andhra Pradesh, triggering a centralized response. A special ambulance facility will be established to ensure strict adherence to COVID-19 guidelines. Following the case, samples from affected individuals must be collected and tested immediately. The Andhra Pradesh state health department has alerted all district officials and issued emergency orders to intensify preparedness, testing, and prevention measures across the state. The directive also provides clear guidelines to district medical and health officers, and to heads of government medical colleges. Under central guidelines, patients presenting with fever or severe respiratory illness must be monitored in all government and private hospitals, with samples collected from symptomatic patients and tested promptly to confirm infection and enable swift public health action.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でCOVID-19感染確認 - 中央政府が警告
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患であるCOVID-19の散発的検出に対する行政対応であり、IHR基準の複数該当は確認できないが、地域での監視強化が指示されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、単発の症例検出に対する行政の予防的対応の記事。重症度や規模に関する具体的情報は記事内に不足している。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго лихорадкой Эбола заразился ещё один гражданин США
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another U.S. citizen contracted Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Ebola virus disease is confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, representing a second U.S. citizen infected during the current outbreak. The infection was confirmed in an employee of a humanitarian organization; identity and current status were not disclosed. The DR Congo daily bulletin lists 1,830 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, up 32 in the last 24 hours, with a case fatality rate of 34.9%. The first American patient, a 39-year-old man, was evacuated in May 2026 to Germany for treatment and recovered. The new case highlights ongoing transmission risk; the World Health Organization maintains monitoring and support for local authorities, and humanitarian groups are increasing safety measures for staff. No details on infection source or transmission chain are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱に米国市民がもう1人感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(1,830例、致死率34.9%)が継続中で、外国人(米国市民)への感染が発生し国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは感染者の搬送・治療先であり、実際の発生地はDR Congoのみのためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع الإصابات بفيروس إيبولا إلى 1830 منها 648 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola cases rise to 1,830, of which 648 have died.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, according to the latest government tally through Thursday. Officials expanded the officially affected areas to include Chubo and Haut-Uele in the north and northeast. The U.S. CDC reported a American working for a humanitarian organization in the DRC has tested positive for Ebola, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with authorities coordinating to limit spread and trace contacts. WHO cautions the true scale may be 2–4 times higher than reported, and in some areas four out of five new infections are not linked to known cases. About 90% of cases remain in Ituri, with transmission reaching North Kivu, South Kivu, and Chubo. The outbreak, declared mid-May, involves Bundibugyo virus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラウイルス感染者数が1,830人に増加、うち648人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,830例・死亡648例（致死率約35%）に達し、感染地域が拡大、米国人職員の感染確認や有効なワクチン・治療法が存在しないことから国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 米国CDCが自国民の感染例を報告し国際関与が示唆されるが、渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事に明記なし。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスに対する承認済みワクチン・治療法は存在せず、WHOは真の感染規模が公式報告の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘している。Ghana・United Statesは記事本文上の主題国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 無國界醫生肯亞設模擬中心　培訓醫護迎戰剛果伊波拉疫情 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders Establishes a Simulation Center in Kenya to Train Healthcare Workers to Tackle the Congo Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading rapidly, with at least 600 deaths and 1,759 confirmed cases, including 112 healthcare workers among the infected and 35 among them dead. To strengthen frontline response, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) has set up a simulation training center in the Nairobi metropolitan area, Kenya. The facility features beds, mannequins, a simulated laboratory and full PPE, training doctors, nurses and clinicians heading to DRC or other high-risk neighbors. Senegalese MSF community health worker Cisse Papa Ndiaga says PPE changes everything and training also covers community engagement, safe burials and reducing survivor stigma. Diana Corben, MSF physician with a Central African Republic mission team, stresses community understanding and empathy, noting simulations help workers gauge limits under real-field stress. Opened mid-June, the center runs through August, training about 100 people per month, including MSF staff, Kenyan Ministry of Health officials and other NGOs.

triage.headline_ja: 無國界醫生肯亞設模擬中心　培訓醫護迎戰剛果伊波拉疫情
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが急速に拡大し、死者600人以上・確定症例1,759件（医療従事者112人感染、35人死亡）と重篤な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準複数該当と国際支援（MSF）の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行そのものが主題であり、ケニアはMSFのトレーニング拠点に過ぎず流行地ではないため対象国から除外。CARやセネガルも同様に対象国リスト外または流行地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: В ДРК число инфицированных Эболой увеличилось до 1 830
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the number of people infected with Ebola has risen to 1,830.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have reached 1,830, up 32 in 24 hours, with 648 deaths (up 23), yielding a case fatality rate of 35.4%. About 780 patients remain under observation in hospitals and medical isolation, up 16, while contact tracing coverage sits at 78.1%. In South Kivu province, there have been no new confirmed Ebola cases for 42 consecutive days, bringing the current outbreak closer to an official declaration of end in that area. The flare-up began on May 15 in the eastern DRC and neighboring Uganda, with the epicenter located in Ituri province, where transmission is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ感染者数が1,830人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例1,830人、死亡648人、致死率35.4%）が継続中で、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ含む）もあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には未記載。南キブ州では42日間新規症例なしで終息宣言に近づいているが、イトゥリ州では感染継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: comment quatre malades ont rejoint Kisangani depuis l'Ituri sans être détectés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: how four patients reached Kisangani from Ituri without being detected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is now spreading across five provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, plus Tshopo and Haut-Uélé. In Kisangani (Tshopo), four people from Nia-Nia in Ituri tested positive, including two deaths; a sixth case in Haut-Uélé is also linked to Nia-Nia, with about five cases there overall. The Kisangani cases comprise two women who died in Nia-Nia and were transported at night to Kisangani, a patient who escaped from a treatment center at PK50 and was later found, and a police officer from Nia-Nia. A local health center that received the corpses raised the alert after positive tests. One survivor is reportedly in a treatment center not yet fully normed. The INSP’s 8 July report showed Ituri accounts for 91% of confirmed cases and 85.6% of deaths; authorities have increased checkpoint controls to restrict movement between affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国、イトゥリ州からキサンガニへ検知されずに移動した4人の患者について
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病がコンゴ民主共和国の5州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、チョポ、オート・ウエレ）に拡大しており、検知されないまま感染者が移動し死亡例も発生。IHR基準を複数満たし、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 検知されない感染者の州間移動、複数州への拡大、検問所設置による移動制限などがみられ、既存のエボラ流行がさらに悪化している可能性が高い。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Aumenta para 648 mortos e para 1.830 casos confirmados na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Death toll rises to 648 and 1,830 confirmed cases in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola death toll rises to 648 and 1,830 confirmed cases in Democratic Republic of Congo. As of 11 July 2026, 23 more deaths and 38 new infections were reported since the previous update. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with a case fatality rate of 35.4%. About 780 patients are isolated or hospitalized and 285 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 78.1%. South Kivu has surpassed 42 days without a new confirmed case, a threshold for ending outbreak in that province per WHO rules. Ituri declared on 15 May; the outbreak has spread to Uganda (20 cases; 15 imported from DRC, including 2 deaths). The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO deems the risk high in Sub-Saharan Africa and low globally; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で死者648人、確定症例1,830人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行がDRCで継続し、ウガンダへの国境を越えた拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。致死率35.4%、WHOはサブサハラアフリカでリスク高、世界的には低いと評価。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行。

article.articleHeadline: Des dispositifs de prévention contre Ebola volés et vandalisés au
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola prevention measures stolen and vandalized at
article.articleSummary: At Butembo Central Market in North Kivu, Ebola prevention equipment—water tanks and handwashing/disinfection devices installed at market entrances weeks earlier—was stolen or vandalized by unidentified individuals. Local authorities, led by Gérard Kakule Kayihembako, head of the urban office of the National Economy, conducted an inspection with market managers and urged traders and shoppers to safeguard these public health installations. Plans to deploy new devices in the coming days were announced to bolster Ebola prevention. The market, a major hub attracting thousands daily and travelers from Beni (North Kivu) and Bunia (Ituri), underscores the need for barrier measures: regular handwashing, use of disinfection devices, and applying disinfectant after handling money. Authorities call on the public to report sabotage to aid containment and maintain prevention efforts against Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州ブテンボでエボラ予防設備が盗難・破壊される
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重大疾患に関連する記事だが、本記事は市場での予防設備の盗難・破壊という運用上の問題を報じており、実際の感染者数や新規症例に関する情報がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ症例報告ではなく、市場における予防インフラ（給水・消毒設備）の盗難・破壊事案を扱っている。市場はベニやブニアからの往来者も多く、感染拡大の懸念があるため、今後の症例動向や当局の対応を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola déclarée au Haut-Uélé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak declared in Upper Uele
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared across Upper Uele province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on July 10, 2026, after the National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB) confirmed seven deaths positive for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain in Wamba health zone, with alerts in Pawa, Boma Mangbetu, and Isiro. Governor Jean Bakomito Gambu announced the declaration and urged calm and vigilance, advising anyone with high fever, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, extreme fatigue, or bleeding to seek immediate medical care. Mandatory controls include rapid reporting of suspected cases, ban on contact with patients or suspected corpses, regular handwashing, physical distancing, reduced gatherings, and strengthened border controls at province entry points. Churches and traditional healers are barred from handling Ebola-suspected individuals. Deaths must be buried safely under health team supervision. The provincial outbreak response committee, with central government and technical/financial partners, is mobilized to contain spread, while residents are urged to cooperate with medical teams.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州でエボラ出血熱の流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行がDRCで正式宣言され、複数の死亡例と地域拡大の可能性があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 州知事による公式流行宣言、INRBによる7名の死亡確認（ブンディブギョ株陽性）、複数の保健区（Wamba, Pawa, Boma Mangbetu, Isiro）での警戒。国境管理強化や埋葬管理などの対策が既に発動されており、中央政府・技術/資金パートナーが動員済み。フルリスク評価が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: DIY Catat 25 Kasus Kusta, Kenali Gejala dan Cara Mencegahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special Region of Yogyakarta records 25 leprosy cases, learn the symptoms and how to prevent them.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Mycobacterium leprae) continues to burden Indonesia, with the Special Region of Yogyakarta (DIY) reporting 25 new cases through the second quarter of 2026. Globally, nearly 200,000 new cases occur each year, and Indonesia remains among the top three countries by case load alongside India and Brazil, accounting for about 71.9% of global cases; Indonesia logged about 15,000 new cases in 2023. In DIY, early symptoms to watch include skin patches that are numb or discolored, thickened peripheral nerves, numbness in hands or feet, muscle weakness, and non-healing wounds. Transmission typically requires close, prolonged contact with untreated patients; casual interactions such as handshakes or sharing utensils are unlikely to spread the disease. MDT provides free treatment for 6–12 months. Stigma remains a barrier; authorities are strengthening active surveillance, early case finding, and public education, including collaboration with Kominfo to improve health literacy.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタ特別州でハンセン病25例を確認、症状と予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は治療法が確立された既知の疾患であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で、緊急性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア国内の啓発・公衆衛生教育目的の内容であり、インドとブラジルは症例数比較の文脈で言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. citizen working in Congo tests positive for Ebola; outbreak still spreading largely undetected, says WHO official
article.articleSummary: U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, confirmed by the CDC on July 10, 2026. The outbreak, declared in mid-May, has infected 1,792 people and killed 625, per government data through July 9. About 90% of cases are in Ituri province, especially Bunia, with health zones Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu and Nyakunde showing intense transmission. North Kivu and other provinces have seen spread beyond the epicenter. Four in five new cases have no known link to previous patients, suggesting the true scale could be 2–4 times larger than confirmed. Bundibugyo may cause milder symptoms, potentially delaying care and prolonging transmission; about 70% of the first 400 deaths occurred outside treatment centres. The response includes training 21,000 community health workers for house-to-house surveillance and contact identification.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで活動する米国人がエボラ陽性反応、WHO当局者は「アウトブレイクは検出されないまま拡大し続けている」と発言
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが1,792人感染・625人死亡と大規模化し、米国人感染者も確認された。WHO当局者が「大部分が検出されずに拡大している」と指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 米国人感染者は米国内ではなくDRCでの就労中に感染したものであり、米国内での発生ではないためUnited Statesは除外。Rwandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: comment quatre malades ont rejoint Kisangani depuis l'Ituri sans être détectés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: how four patients reached Kisangani from Ituri without being detected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands from Ituri to Kisangani and Haut-Uele. Four Kisangani cases originate from Nia-Nia, Ituri near Tshopo; two women died in Nia-Nia; their bodies were brought to Kisangani at night; a local health center alerted after positive tests. A third case escaped from a PK50 treatment center about ten days earlier and was found alive in Kisangani. The fourth case is a police officer from Nia-Nia now in Kisangani. Contact tracing is under way. The minister notes an ambiguity about the treatment center status, with two survivors reportedly treated in a center not yet formally standardized. In Haut-Uele, linked to Nia-Nia, about five cases are estimated, including community deaths; no active hospitalizations were reported. The INSP (July 8) showed Ituri accounting for 91% of confirmed cases and 85.6% of deaths; Tshopo and Haut-Uele were added as affected provinces by July 10.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：4人の患者がイトゥリ州から検知されずキサンガニに到達した経緯
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がイトゥリ州から未検知のままキサンガニおよびオートウエレ州へ拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと管理体制の不備が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 検知されないままの患者移動、治療センターからの逃走、治療施設の標準化に関する曖昧さなど、サーベイランスと管理体制の欠陥が示唆されており、感染拡大のリスクが高い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Dispositivo detecta anticorpos da gripe aviária em 6 minutos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Device detects avian influenza antibodies in 6 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers unveiled a microfluidic electronic tongue capable of detecting antibodies against H5N1 avian influenza in about 6 minutes. The device employs a multiplex of sensors and renewable-source proteins, with artificial intelligence interpreting electrical signals to indicate immune response to H5N1. In tests, it demonstrated high detection capability and about 99% accuracy in differentiating H5N1-positive samples from those associated with other common avian diseases, with no false positives reported. The platform, described in the April ACS Applied Nano Materials paper, could be deployed in veterinary clinics, poultry farms, and health-surveillance centers, and may be adaptable to other pathogens, including human health applications. Coordinated by Osvaldo Novais de Oliveira Junior (IFSC-USP), the work involved Embrapa Instrumentação, UF Amazonas, IFSP, and international partners, with FAPESP funding. Early detection is crucial to control outbreaks and limit trade disruptions for poultry producers.

triage.headline_ja: デバイスが6分で鳥インフルエンザ抗体を検出
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例の報告ではなく、抗体検出デバイスの研究開発に関する技術記事であるため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの研究機関による診断技術（マイクロ流体電子舌）の開発発表であり、実際のH5N1発生や症例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Lebensgefährliche Krankheit: Weiterer US-Bürger infiziert sich im Kongo mit Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Life-threatening disease: Another U.S. citizen contracts Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two U.S. citizens have been infected during the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak, with a second case confirmed in a U.S. humanitarian worker in the Congo. The patient tested positive for the Bundibugyo virus variant. The CDC is coordinating with the humanitarian organization and Congolese health authorities to conduct contact tracing and risk assessment to prevent further transmission. Previously, a U.S. physician who contracted the virus in eastern Congo was treated in Germany and discharged after recovery at Berlin Charité. By late June, the outbreak had 1,830 laboratory-confirmed infections and 648 deaths. The Bundibugyo virus has no licensed vaccine or specific therapy, complicating containment. The situation has international concern, including a European case in France of a humanitarian doctor returning from eastern Congo, isolated on arrival and discharged in early July after negative tests and no symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 生命を脅かす病気：コンゴでさらに米国人がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（1,830症例、648死亡）が国際的拡大（米国人・欧州人感染者）を伴い、ワクチン・治療法未確立のBundibugyo variantであるため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツ・フランスでの症例はいずれもDRCでの感染者が帰国・搬送された事例であり、発生地域自体はDRCのみ。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo variantである点が管理可能性上のリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: افزایش مبتلایان به ابولا در جمهوری دموکراتیک کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen past 1,800 as the outbreak expands to a fourth province in the north-eastern region. Health ministry data show a total of 1,830 confirmed cases since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, with 648 deaths. About 780 patients are currently under treatment, and 284 have recovered. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. Officials noted that after seven deaths were confirmed in the Wasambo region, transmission has spread to a new province in the north-eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者が増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例が1,800件を超え、致死率も高く第4州へ拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は約35%と高く、複数州への拡大が続いており、国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: El 12 de Octubre prueba en ratones una vacuna oral contra una variante del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12 de Octubre tests an oral vaccine against an Ebola variant in mice.
article.articleSummary: Madrid’s 12 de Octubre Public Hospital shows an oral vaccine against Ebola Zaire variant is viable in mice, using virus-like particles with no genetic material to induce immunity. Oral delivery could overcome cold chain and healthcare workforce needs inherent to injectables. In two funded studies (Community of Madrid, European Union, Instituto de Salud Carlos III), vaccinated mice had a 67% survival rate; a single dose generated neutralizing antibodies against the Ebola glycoprotein, with a three-dose regimen providing stronger responses. Vaccinated animals also exhibited slower disease progression, less weight loss, and significantly lower viral loads in blood and organs (spleen, liver, lungs). The approach remains preclinical and not yet for humans, targeting Zaire ebolavirus, while the current central African outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of July 8, DRC reported 1,792 cases and 625 deaths; Uganda 20 cases and 2 deaths, with Ituri most affected.

triage.headline_ja: 12月10日、ネズミを使ったエボラウイルス変異株に対する経口ワクチンの試験
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は予防開発段階（マウスモデルでの前臨床試験）であり、現在のアウトブレイクは異なるエボラ変異株（Bundibugyo）が原因。進行中の疾患イベントではなく、ワクチン開発研究報告として分類される。
triage.notes: 記事の中心内容は、マドリッドの12月10日公立病院によるZaire ebolavirus向けの経口ワクチンのマウス試験であり、研究成果報告である。背景情報としてDRCおよびウガンダでのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行が言及されているが、記事の主題ではない。アウトブレイク管理や疾患拡大を扱うシグナルではなく、ワクチン開発の技術的進展報告であるため、PICKUP対象外と判定した。DRCが verified_locations に含まれるのは、背景情報としてのアウトブレイク言及のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Un citoyen américain infecté par le virus Ebola en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American citizen infected with the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On July 11, 2026, the CDC confirmed a case of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient is an American citizen employed by an international humanitarian organization active in the DRC. Laboratory analyses identified infection with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, a rare lineage. Public health authorities have launched urgent, large-scale coordination with the humanitarian organization, other U.S. federal agencies, and local and international partners in the DRC to provide medical care and to trace and monitor contacts at high risk of exposure. Strict preventive measures are being implemented to prevent further transmission within the region and to rapidly contain the outbreak in the affected area, while ongoing surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染した米国人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（希少なBundibugyo株）の確定症例で、米国人が感染し国際的な対応が行われており、公衆衛生上の重大性と国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 米国はSOP対象国リストに含まれないため、感染者が米国人であってもverified_locationsには含めない。発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: MSF Ebola training in Kenya prepares doctors for 'intense' job - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the fastest-growing since detection in mid-May, with 1,759 confirmed cases, including 112 health workers, and 35 deaths; total fatalities exceed 600. MSF has opened a training center at Ongata Rongai, near Nairobi, Kenya, to bolster regional response by preparing doctors, nurses, and clinicians for deployment to DRC or other at-risk areas. The facility, equipped with beds, mannequins, a mock lab, and PPE, began mid-June and aims to train about 100 people per month through August and beyond. Core focus includes PPE safety, safe funerals, and community engagement to counter fear and stigma, while teaching responders to balance empathy with personal limits in an intensely challenging environment. Initially MSF staff are training; Kenyan Ministry of Health officials and other NGOs will participate. One trainee, Ndiaga from Senegal, says he is less scared, though not fully ready.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでのMSFエボラ研修、医師たちに『過酷な』任務への備えを
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は5月中旬の検出以来最速の拡大を見せ、1,759症例・600人以上の死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（既存の大規模流行）であり、ケニアは地域対応のためのMSF研修拠点にすぎず発生国ではない。ケニア・セネガルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : des mesures barrières préconisées contre Ebola au détriment des rites traditionnels (autorités coutumières) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Barrier measures recommended against Ebola at the expense of traditional rites (traditional authorities) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Traditional leaders in the peripheral areas of Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, advocate observing barrier measures against Ebola at the expense of traditional rites. Mwami Makofi Bukuka, substitute traditional chief of Bapakombe Bakondo in the Beni territory near the city of Beni, told ACP that eradicating Ebola requires community mobilization and strict adherence to preventive measures, not ritual practices. The chiefs have launched a sensitization campaign urging the population to respect barrier measures and not to oppose response teams. Bukuka regrets social media messages from within the Beni health zone suggesting rites could eradicate the disease. He urged people to seek care from health professionals, noting that early management improves recovery prospects. The stance emphasizes public health measures and collaboration with modern health services over traditional rites.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：伝統的儀式よりもエボラ対策のバリア対策を推奨（伝統的権威者）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRC北キブ州で対応活動が継続中であることが示唆されているため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきである。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例数や発生規模の詳細を含んでいないが、エボラの継続的な地域感染対策（伝統儀式の禁止呼びかけ等）が行われていることから、既存または進行中のアウトブレイク状況が示唆される。フルリスク評価での最新疫学データ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बहराइच में खसरा का खतरा, बच्चों में ज्यादा असर, जानें लक्षण, बचाव और इलाज के तरीके
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles risk in Bahraich, greater impact on children; learn the symptoms, prevention, and treatment methods.
article.articleSummary: Measles risk in Bahraich, as of 11 July 2026, with children bearing the heavier burden, highlights gaps in awareness and timely care. Pediatrician Dr. Arvind Shukla of Bahraich Medical College explains that measles can be treated and prevented, provided early consultation and proper hygiene. The illness is highly contagious and spreads through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes. Early symptoms include high fever, red eyes, cold, and cough, followed by small red flat rashes that begin on the face and neck and spread to the body. Delayed care increases risk of pneumonia or brain involvement, prolonging recovery. Prevention hinges on routine vaccination for children, good sanitation, and isolating the patient if possible. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics or home remedies; seek guidance from a health center. Continuation of breastfeeding and light, easily-digested meals support recovery.

triage.headline_ja: バハライチで麻疹のリスク、子どもへの影響が大きい――症状・予防・治療法を知る
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は小児科医による麻疹の症状・予防・治療に関する一般的な啓発情報であり、具体的な発生件数や集団発生の報告はなく、異常性や緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数や集団感染の報告を含まず、麻疹に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての実体的な情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Beni: mobilisation des chefs de bases dans la sensibilisation des administrés contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: mobilization of base chiefs in raising residents' awareness about Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, 11 July 2026: Ebola response mobilization intensified as base chiefs in Ngongolio, Mulekera commune, urged residents to engage against youths resisting responders. Ngongolio chief Julien Kapanga warned that community relays beaten in the presence of a base chief face legal consequences. He noted a cell chief is jailed in Kangbayi for aiding the beating of a woman and a man in Mambango, and called for participation in the response to avoid arrest for failing to support it. Ngongolio—a resistance stronghold—requires strict administration to allow police and response teams to operate with backing from base chiefs. The article highlights ongoing sensitization and enforcement actions against obstructions to the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：住民へのエボラ対策啓発活動における基地責任者の動員 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の対応活動が継続中であり、コミュニティの抵抗により対応が妨げられているため、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念と国際的関心が存在する。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ対応活動における地域社会の抵抗と啓発活動に焦点を当てており、新規感染者数や致死率などの疫学データは含まれていない。継続的なアウトブレイク対応の一環として、フルリスク評価での症例数・地理的拡大の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Второй американец заразился Эболой в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The second American infected with Ebola in the DRC
article.articleSummary: July 11, 2026: The Democratic Republic of Congo reports a second American citizen infected with Ebola amid the ongoing outbreak. The article notes no details on the second patient’s identity or condition. Previously, the first American infected during this outbreak was a 39-year-old man who contracted Ebola in May; he was evacuated from the DRC to Germany for treatment and recovered. In the DRC, laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases total 1,830, with 32 new cases reported in the last 24 hours. The case fatality rate is 34.9%. The report highlights ongoing transmission within the DRC and the exportation of at least one infected person to Germany for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア国営メディア報道：DRCで2人目の米国人がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は死亡率34.9%と深刻で、既に国際的な感染者搬送（ドイツへの避難）が発生しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける進行中のエボラ流行と、米国人感染者の国外搬送（ドイツ）に焦点を当てている。米国・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का 'साइलेंट' प्रहार, सरकारी आंकड़ों से 4 गुना अधिक फैल सकता है संक्रमण, WHO ने दी चेतावनी -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola's 'silent' strike in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: infection could spread four times as high as official figures, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, WHO warns that Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is far more extensive than official counts. The Ituri region's Bunia area reports about 80% of new infections have no known link to a prior case, indicating covert community transmission. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is causing relatively mild symptoms, prompting home care and delay in seeking treatment; about 70% of Ebola deaths occur outside treatment centers. WHO Emergency Director Chikwe Ihekweazu notes delayed engagement with health facilities increases onward transmission risk. To counter this, authorities are expanding surveillance with 21,000 trained community health workers conducting door-to-door case finding. The outbreak has spread from North Kivu to South Kivu and Tshopo Province, complicating containment, and Bunia testing shows a high positivity rate—about every second test positive—sparking intensified testing at health centers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの『サイレント』拡大、政府統計の4倍に達する恐れ、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染が公式統計の4倍に達する可能性を警告しており、複数州への拡大・地域社会内での隠れた伝播が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 発生地域として挙げられたTshopo、South Kivu、Ituri、Bunia はいずれもDRC国内の州・都市であり、国単位ではDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による軽症化と受診遅延が地域内伝播を助長している点が特徴的。

article.articleHeadline: Kes Ebola cecah lebih 1,800 di DR Congo, virus merebak ke wilayah keempat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases top 1,800 in DR Congo as the virus spreads to the fourth region.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 1,800, totaling 1,830 cases with 648 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The virus has spread to a fourth region in the northeastern part of the country, indicating expanding transmission in eastern DR Congo. The figures come from a Ministry of Health situation update and were reported by Reuters and Anadolu Agency on July 11, 2026. The report highlights the ongoing Eastern Congo Ebola outbreak, with continued case finding, contact tracing, and public health response efforts as authorities scale surveillance and isolation measures. No further details on laboratory confirmation beyond the totals are provided in the article. The update underscores the sustained public health challenge in the region and the potential for further spread within the northeastern corridor and across borders if control measures weaken.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ症例が1,800人を超え、ウイルスは第4の地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数が1,830人・死者648人に達し、第4地域へ拡大するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際拡大のリスクが認められるため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 既知のコンゴ東部エボラ流行の継続報道。致死率は約35%と高く、地域拡大が続いているため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا في الكونجو إلى 1830 حالة مؤكدة بينها 648 وفاة.. وتسجيل إصابة أمريكي - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 1,830 confirmed cases, including 648 deaths... and an American has been infected - Libya 24 News
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, with numbers updated through Thursday. Government and health authorities continue routine surveillance and weekly reporting of new infections and fatalities within the ongoing outbreak. In a parallel development, the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirmed that an American aid worker, employed by a humanitarian organization, has contracted Ebola Bundibugyo while in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The CDC is coordinating with the organization, U.S. federal agencies, and Congolese partners to support containment, prevent further transmission, and identify and manage quarantined or exposed contacts. Efforts remain focused on monitoring, contact tracing, and timely public health interventions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者が1,830人（うち死者648人）に増加…米国人感染者も確認 - Libya 24 News
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱で1,830例・648死亡という大規模流行が継続中であり、さらに米国人渡航者への感染・国際的拡大が確認されたためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大の根拠として重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: Bắc Hà triển khai khẩn cấp các biện pháp phòng, chống dịch lở mồm long móng trên đàn gia súc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bac Ha implements urgent measures to prevent and control foot-and-mouth disease in the livestock herd.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) alarms Bac Ha as positive samples are found at Bac Ha Livestock Market. To curb spread, the Bac Ha Commune People's Committee suspends livestock trading, collection, and inter-market transport at the market from 11 July 2026 until the outbreak is controlled. A Disease Prevention and Control Steering Committee is to be formed, with surveys of susceptible animals (buffalo, cattle, pigs, goats) and a tally of vaccine needs for emergency vaccination. Mobile inspection teams will operate; police will enforce movement controls and sanction illegal transport, trading, or slaughter of diseased or unknown-origin animals. The market and high-risk areas will be disinfected; farmers will be promoted to adopt biosafety practices. Public awareness will be intensified via broadcasting and loudspeakers at the market, and farmers will be urged to sign commitments not to hide disease, while surveillance continues."}

triage.headline_ja: バクハー郡、家畜における口蹄疫の予防・対策のため緊急措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（口蹄疫）であり人への健康影響は報告されておらず、地域当局による通常の家畜衛生管理措置の範囲内である。

article.articleHeadline: Rritet në mbi 1.800 numri i rasteve me Ebola në RD të Kongos, virusi përhapet në provincën e katërt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the DR Congo rises to over 1,800, as the virus spreads to the fourth province.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,830 confirmed Ebola cases and 648 deaths since the outbreak began on 15 May. The epidemic has reached a fourth northeastern province, Haut-Uele, after seven fatal cases in the Wamba health zone, with the outbreak still centered in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. About 780 patients are receiving treatment, and 284 have recovered. Donors and partners pledged about $910 million to support responses in Congo and neighboring Uganda, which has 20 cases. Africa CDC has deployed multidisciplinary expert teams to priority health zones—representing roughly 83% of cases—as part of a decentralized response emphasizing community engagement, strengthened surveillance, and rapid funding. The Bundibugyo strain prompted WHO on 17 May to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, two days after the outbreak was announced.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数が1,800人を超え、ウイルスは4番目の州に拡大

triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Tanganyika : l'épidémie de choléra contenue à Kabimba grâce à la
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tanganyika: the cholera epidemic contained in Kabimba thanks to the.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Kabimba, Kalemie Territory, Tanganyika, is now under control as of July 9, 2026. The first case was reported July 4; 16 cases have been recorded, with three patients still under treatment and the others discharged. Investigations tie the outbreak to consumption of untreated water from Lake Tanganyika, Kabimba’s main drinking-water source. Authorities urge enhanced hygiene, water treatment, boiling water when disinfectants aren’t available, and improved sanitation to prevent resurgence. The Red Cross and CONCERN assisted with disinfection of affected homes. With continued medical care and humanitarian support, the situation is contained, though vigilance and public-awareness activities continue to avert further spread.

triage.headline_ja: タンガニーカ:適切な対応によりカビンバでのコレラ流行は制御下に
triage.triage_reason: コレラ流行はすでに制御下にあり症例数も16件と小規模だが、コンゴ民主共和国での継続的なコレラ発生として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 米国・カリフォルニアは発生地域として誤って付与されており、記事内容とは無関係のため除外。既に制御下にあるが水系感染源のため再燃リスクは残る。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uele : des dispositifs sanitaires installés aux postes de contrôle face à Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele: Public health measures installed at checkpoints in response to Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease response in Isiro, capital of Haut-Uele in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, with handwashing stations and temperature checks installed at entry/exit points. The National Border Hygiene Program (PNHF) deployed teams at points of entry, exit, and strategic locations such as churches and markets, using chlorinated-water handwashing devices and thermo-flash thermometers, and enforcing barrier measures. Following Ituri province’s May 15, 2026 Ebola announcement, Haut-Uele issued an alert and conducted province-wide mapping to guide response. Officials coordinated with the provincial Health Division and other Ebola-control structures to contain spread. The article highlights these measures as a proactive effort to stop Ebola transmission, without providing case or fatality counts.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州:エボラ対策として検問所に衛生設備を設置 - ACP

triage.notes: 記事は症例数・死亡者数を報告していないが、既知のエボラアウトブレイク（イトゥリ州、2026年5月15日宣言）への対応として隣接オートウエレ州での予防措置を報じている。既存のアウトブレイクの継続的モニタリングとしてフルRRAが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri/Ebola : près de 15 décès communautaires suspects enregistrés chaque jour à Bafwabango | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri/Ebola: nearly 15 suspected community deaths recorded daily in Bafwabango | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, Ebola response remains strongly disrupted in the Nia-Nia health zone, Mambasa territory, Ituri, after a June 30 fire at the Bafwabango Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) and at the Juhudi referral center. Dr. Joseph Pemanakue, the zone’s medical chief, reports about 15 suspected community deaths daily in the PK51 health area. The epidemic curve in Nia-Nia continues to rise, with 36 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in the health zone. Officials attribute the worsening situation to the suspension of outbreak-response activities, undermining patient care and fueling transmission within communities. The destruction of the Bafwabango CTE and the Juhudi center has halted Ebola control operations in this section of Mambasa, hindering contact tracing, isolation, and deployment of countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ/エボラ:バフワバンゴで毎日約15人の疑い例による地域社会での死亡が記録される | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療センターの焼失により対応活動が停止し、地域社会での疑い死亡例が急増、検査確定36例と流行曲線が上昇しているため深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 治療センター焼失によりコンタクトトレーシングや隔離等の対応活動が停止しており、感染拡大の制御が困難な状況。検査確定36例に加え、多数の疑い死亡例(1日15人)が報告されており、実際の感染規模はより大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa brasileira identifica proteínas que podem ampliar proteção de vacinas contra malária | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian research identifies proteins that could broaden the protection provided by malaria vaccines
article.articleSummary: Malaria vaccine research from Federal University of Minas Gerais (CTVacinas), led by Camila Barbosa and Luna de Lacerda, published in Nature, identifies 453 peptides from 166 Plasmodium vivax proteins as novel vaccine candidates. Using immunopeptidomics, the team shows reticulocytes can present parasite antigens via HLA class I, enabling CD8+ T cell responses and challenging long-held assumptions. The targets are primarily internal proteins—ribosomal proteins, histones, and ETRAMPs—that mutate slowly, offering stable vaccine targets. About 71% of these proteins are conserved across Plasmodium species and 75% are expressed in life cycle stages (mosquito, liver, blood, hypnozoites). Validation in P. vivax and P. falciparum patient samples, non-human primates, and mice reveals robust CD8+ T cell responses; two antigens confer protection in animals. Analyses included samples from Brazil, Mali, and the United States, highlighting potential for universal malaria vaccines. Notably, it is the first Nature paper from a study conducted by Brazilian women.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの研究、マラリアワクチンの防御効果を広げる可能性のあるタンパク質を特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリアワクチン開発に関する基礎研究成果の報道であり、感染症の発生・流行事例ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン研究の学術成果報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生地域ではないため、Brazil・Mali・United Statesはいずれもverified_locationsに含めない（対象国リストにMali・United Statesは含まれず、Brazilも発生事例ではなく研究対象地域としての言及のため除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Çin: Ebola Salgınıyla Mücadeleye Destek İçin Uganda'ya Sağlık Ekibi Gönderdik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China: We Sent a Medical Team to Uganda to Support the Fight Against the Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: China's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning announced that, at Uganda's invitation, a new team of Chinese health experts has flown to Kampala to support and guide Ebola outbreak response efforts. The mission follows two teams previously sent to the Democratic Republic of Congo that earned broad praise. In Kampala, the new delegation met with local health authorities and medical research institutions and engaged with the World Health Organization and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention’s Ebola Incident Management Support Team to coordinate response activities. Mao stated that China, based on the on-the-ground situation and Africa's needs, stands ready to provide further support within its capabilities to help bring the outbreak under control. The remarks emphasize ongoing China–Africa collaboration in Ebola control and outbreak management.

triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行に対し中国が医療支援チームを派遣、WHOやアフリカCDCと連携するなど国際的な対応が進行しており、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事案と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 'Uma refeição nas férias me deixou com 38 parasitas no cérebro'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Meal on Vacation Left Me with 38 Parasites in My Brain
article.articleSummary: Lowri Denman, a 42-year-old from Wales, developed neurocysticercosis after a 2007 trip to India, likely ingesting Taenia solium eggs from a pork tapeworm carrier in areas with poor sanitation. She learned in 2010 she carried the tapeworm; a year later she began severe headaches, and in 2011 her first seizure. Brain imaging later showed 38 cysts in her brain, leading to a neurocysticercosis diagnosis—the severe form where cysts affect the brain or spinal cord. She was hospitalized for two weeks and treated with antiparasitics and steroids; though symptoms improved for years, she later experienced major brain swelling with confusion, numbness, and psychosis, forcing her to leave work. After years of care, the parasites calcified, and she returned to work in 2022. The UK reports few such cases; globally, neurocysticercosis is estimated to affect up to 8.3 million people and is a major cause of epilepsy.

triage.headline_ja: 「休暇中の食事が原因で脳に38匹の寄生虫が」
triage.triage_reason: 2007年のインド旅行に起因する単一個人の過去の症例報告であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2007年にインドで感染した英国人女性の個人的な闘病記であり、現在発生中の感染症イベントではない。インドでの新規発生や集団感染を示す情報はないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS espère quatre vaccins contre la souche Bundibugyo d'ici trois mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO hopes for four vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain within three months.
article.articleSummary: Four candidate vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain could be available in about three months, WHO said in Bunia on July 10, as the outbreak continues. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; Ervebo protects only the Zaïre strain. The response relies on detection, contact tracing, and safe, dignified burials. A clinical trial named PARTNERS, started July 2, is evaluating MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, but no therapy is yet validated. As of July 9, the tally is 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu (case fatality ~35%), with Ituri the epicenter (25 of 36 zones affected; Boga near Uganda). North Kivu has 11 zones under priority surveillance; Kisangani and Wamba have confirmed cases; South Kivu has 42 days with no new cases, possibly ending there. Health Minister Roger Kamba visited Bunia July 8 to address provider concerns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHOはブンディブギョ株に対する4種類のワクチンを3か月以内に確保できると期待
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常な株、国際拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当する進行中の大規模エボラ流行であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にItaly(Lombardia)とUganda(Republic of Uganda)が含まれるが、記事本文はDRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）での流行のみを扱っており、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。Bogaの座標がイタリアのLombardiaに誤って紐付けられている可能性がある（BluedotのGeoデータ誤り）。致死率約35%と非常に高く、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株であることから重大なリスクシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشى إيبولا أكبر بضعفين لـ 4 أضعاف من البيانات الرسمية - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak is two to four times larger than official data.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be two to four times larger than official counts. A WHO official said 80% of new confirmed Ebola cases have no known link to current patients, in Bunia, Ituri, amid a northeast outbreak that has reached 1,792 cases and 625 deaths. While most new cases come from contact lists in less-affected areas like North Kivu, WHO estimates the outbreak may be 2–4 times larger than confirmed cases. About 90% of cases remain in Ituri, particularly in Bunia, Mongbwalu, and Nyakunde, with spread also to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Chobo. Nearly half tested in Bunia were positive, signaling intense community transmission. Preliminary evidence suggests Bundibugyo Ebola virus may cause milder symptoms, delaying care. 70% of the first 400 deaths occurred outside treatment centers. Authorities are training 21,000 community health workers for home visits to identify suspected cases and encourage care-seeking.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ出血熱の流行は公式データの2~4倍の規模である可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行が公式報告数の2~4倍規模である可能性があり、感染経路不明な症例が8割に上るなど地域社会内での持続的な伝播が示唆されるため。
triage.notes: Angola(Cuanza Norte Province)がBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事本文中で言及がなくDRC国内(Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu)の流行に限定されているため除外した。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる軽症化・受診遅延の可能性も指摘されており、実態把握の困難さがリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: US Citizen Tests Positive for Ebola in Africa: CDC
article.articleSummary: An American citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo virus, a form of Ebola, according to the CDC on July 10. CDC is coordinating with the employing organization, U.S. federal agencies, DRC public health authorities, and partners to prevent further transmission via contact tracing and risk assessments to identify high‑risk contacts. Details such as the organization’s name, the patient’s condition, and whether they will remain in Congo were not disclosed. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak was detected in May and has reached 1,830 cases and 648 deaths in the DRC as of July 10; Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. An American doctor, Dr. Peter Stafford, who worked for Serge earlier in the outbreak, tested positive and recovered after treatment in Germany; his family and another Serge doctor were exposed and monitored in Europe but did not test positive. U.S. plans for a Kenya quarantine center were halted by a Kenyan court order; the United States maintains multiple quarantine facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がアフリカでエボラ出血熱陽性反応:CDC
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行（1,830症例、648死亡）に伴い米国人職員が陽性となり、ウガンダへの拡大や国際的な医療対応（ドイツでの治療）も発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States, Germany, Kenya, Ugandaが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダも流行地域だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国人感染者やドイツでの治療、ケニアでの検疫施設計画などは国際的拡大の証左として記録。

article.articleHeadline: Criança é picada por morcego em creche de Betim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Child bitten by a bat at a Betim daycare.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure in Betim, Minas Gerais, Brazil: A 3-year-old child was bitten on the foot by a bat hidden inside a shoe at a daycare in Petrovale, after the animal presumably entered the footwear. The child received rabies post-exposure prophylaxis and was discharged with instructions to complete the vaccine doses in Betim; the incident occurred on Monday, July 6, 2026. A family member killed the bat, which had contact with seven cats at the residence. The child sought care July 7 at UPA Teresópolis, then was referred to Hospital João XXIII in Belo Horizonte for observation. The bat was collected by the Zoonoses unit on July 7; a sample was sent to a reference laboratory for rabies testing, with priority requested; results were not yet available at reporting time. The seven cats were vaccinated as a precaution. Health authorities urged avoiding handling bats and seeking medical care immediately after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ベチンの託児所でコウモリに噛まれた子供
triage.triage_reason: 単発の狂犬病曝露事例であり、適切な曝露後予防措置が講じられ管理されている。異常な流行や公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は認められない。
