article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Sud-Kivu, première province à toucher au but avec 42 jours sans nouveau cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: South Kivu, first province to reach the target with 42 days without a new case.
article.articleSummary: South Kivu becomes the first Congolese province to reach 42 days without a new confirmed Ebola case, a threshold used by the World Health Organization to declare the end of an outbreak. As of July 9, across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, 1,830 confirmed cases have been recorded; South Kivu accounts for only three cases and one death, all in Miti-Murhesa health zone, Kabare territory. The milestone followed rapid case management; on June 19 two patients were discharged and reintegrated into their community in Miti-Murhesa after treatment, with a survivor describing fever and severe headaches. The health ministry expects to withdraw South Kivu from the response, but risk remains: Ituri and North Kivu continue transmission, and cross-border movement could reintroduce the virus. A single new case could reset the 42-day clock. Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. Ituri remains the epicenter; response challenges include insecurity and funding gaps.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：南キブ州、新規症例なしで42日を達成した最初の州に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（累計1,830症例）に関する続報であり、イトゥリ州・北キブ州では感染が継続、国境を越えた再燃リスクや資金・治安面の課題があるためフルRRAでの継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 南キブ州は42日間新規症例なしで終息基準に近づいているが、イトゥリ州・北キブ州では感染継続中であり、ワクチン・承認治療薬がないBundibugyo株のため引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia wymyka się spod kontroli. Skala może być dwa do czterech razy większa niż oficjalne dane
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic is getting out of control. The scale may be two to four times larger than the official figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, may be two to four times larger than official figures, per WHO emergency director Chikwe Ihekweazu, based on transmission models and rising positives. About 80% of newly confirmed cases are outside established contact lists, signaling widespread transmission; in lower-incidence areas, most infections stem from known patients. Ituri accounts for roughly 90% of cases; cases have reached North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele and Uganda. In Bunia, roughly half of those tested are positive. About 70% of deaths occur among those not treated in facilities. Declared May 15; the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976, after the 2025-ending previous outbreak. Incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, headache; progression can include bleeding and multi-organ failure. Transmission via direct contact with blood, secretions, or excreta; no vaccine exists; care is supportive.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が制御不能に。規模は公式データの2〜4倍の可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が公式統計を大幅に超える規模である可能性を指摘し、感染経路不明の症例が80%に達するなど制御不能な拡大兆候があり、ウガンダへの越境も確認されているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの症例波及が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン未確立、致死率高く、接触者追跡が困難な状況で拡大が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : près de deux mois de riposte et une courbe qui refuse de fléchir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Nearly two months into the response and a curve that refuses to flatten.
article.articleSummary: Nearly two months into the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the curve remains unflattened. As of July 9, INSP reports 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, with about 780 patients still in isolation or hospitalized. The WHO notes an average of 38 new confirmed cases per day over two weeks, a high plateau with no clear decline. The outbreak has spread beyond Ituri to North Kivu and South Kivu, and to Tshopo (Kisangani) and Haut-Uele (Wamba with imported cases). Testing expanded from roughly 30 daily tests in Kinshasa to over 2,000 daily analyses after opening ten provincial laboratories; DHIS2 consolidation can temporarily inflate counts. Ground operations face treatment-center saturation, ambulance shortages in Ituri, and funding and security constraints amid conflict and displacement. Bundibugyo Ebola has no vaccine or approved treatment; control relies on detection, isolation, and contact tracing, with South Kivu nearing decline, unlike Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:対応開始から約2ヶ月、下降しない流行曲線
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,830例・死亡648例に達し、複数州に拡大かつ高止まりの流行曲線が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、ワクチン・承認治療法がなく、検出・隔離・接触者追跡に依存。Ituri州から北キブ・南キブ、Tshopo、Haut-Ueleへ拡大。治療センターの飽和、救急搬送不足、資金・治安上の制約が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Un travailleur humanitaire américain testé positif à Ebola en RDC, selon le CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American humanitarian worker tested positive for Ebola in the DRC, according to the CDC.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, an American humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, confirmed by the CDC. In a statement to Reuters, the CDC said it is coordinating with the employing organization, other U.S. agencies, and partners in the DRC to identify high-risk contacts and prevent transmission. The patient’s identity, sex, organization, and precise work location in the DRC have not been disclosed. The case occurs amid an ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, with the World Health Organization reporting expansion driven by population movement. The CDC did not announce additional measures for the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人人道支援活動家がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ陽性、CDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の進行中の流行の中で米国人人道支援者の感染が確認され、国際的な人的移動を伴う拡大リスクがあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC東部での既存のブンディブギョ・エボラ流行の拡大が背景にある。

article.articleHeadline: СИТУАЦИЯТА Е ТЕЖКА: Броят на жертвите на ебола в Конго достигна 648!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The situation is dire: The number of Ebola victims in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 648!
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, according to Reuters citing the DRC Ministry of Communications. The death toll has risen from 625, and five eastern regions of the DRC are now affected. An additional note in the report states the outbreak has killed 80 people. The UN Development Programme warns the worst‑case scenario could cost African economies about $3.6 billion, with impacts extending beyond the Congo to neighboring countries. The article provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. Figures are current as of July 11, 2026. Keywords: Ebola, Democratic Republic of the Congo, outbreak, eastern regions, economic impact.

triage.headline_ja: 状況は深刻：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が648人に達した！
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で1,830人の確定症例、648人の死亡が確認されており、複数地域に拡大し国際的な経済影響も指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は約35%と高く、5つの東部地域に拡大。国連開発計画はアフリカ経済への最大36億ドルの損失を警告しており、近隣国への波及も懸念される。症状・検査確認・感染源等の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Wading through floodwater, Mumbai woman develops painful red bumps and fever: What is leptospirosis?
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, a water-borne bacterial infection caused by Leptospira, is rising in Mumbai and neighbouring districts after heavy rainfall and floodwater. Two cases described: a Navi Mumbai fitness coach and an 11-year-old girl in Wadala, who developed fever followed by painful red bumps on the hands, fingers and feet after flood exposure. Diagnosis relies on exposure history and laboratory tests; PCR can detect Leptospira in the first week, Rapid IgM and ELISA IgM from about day five, with the Microscopic Agglutination Test (MAT) as the gold-standard confirmation. Transmission occurs through skin cuts from urine-contaminated floodwater of animals such as rodents, cattle, dogs and cats (often called rat fever or flood fever). Early antibiotic treatment yields good recovery; delays can lead to severe illness. Preventive advice includes waterproof footwear, thorough foot washing, antiseptic care for wounds, rodent control, safe water, and prophylactic doxycycline in high-risk groups unless contraindicated. Moderate to severe cases require hospitalization and IV antibiotics; some may need ventilatory support.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水の水の中を歩いたムンバイの女性、痛みを伴う赤い発疹と発熱を発症:レプトスピラ症とは何か?
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期のムンバイで例年見られる季節性レプトスピラ症の個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められないが、洪水による曝露継続と流行しやすさの観点から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイの2症例（個人）を紹介する啓発記事で、季節性の洪水関連レプトスピラ症であり、大規模なアウトブレイクを示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: African scientists build Ebola defences
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a rare Ebola strain, drives the latest outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province’s Bunia near Uganda and South Sudan. As of 9 July, DRC’s Ministry of Health reports 1,792 confirmed BVD cases and 625 deaths; 764 patients are in hospital isolation, with 295 recovered, and over 10,000 contacts monitored. In neighboring Uganda, 20 confirmed cases and two deaths are reported, linked to transmission originating in the DRC. The outbreak is the 17th Ebola event declared in DRC, with an Africa-led response under Africa CDC Director-General Dr Jean Kaseya, alongside WHO and DRC authorities, emphasizing cross-border coordination. June’s Public Health Emergency of Continental Security (PHECS) declaration underscores continental leadership: one coordination team, one plan and one budget. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの科学者たちがエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ型エボラ（BVD）の大規模流行が発生し、死者625名・確定症例1,792例、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、大陸規模の公衆衛生緊急事態（PHECS）が宣言されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Africa CDCおよびWHOによる大陸主導の対応（PHECS宣言）が行われており、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Communities at the heart of the DRC response to the Ebola epidemic
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia near Uganda and South Sudan. As of 9 July, 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 related deaths; 764 patients in isolation and 295 recovered since WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine. Response extends beyond clinics: hundreds of community health workers and religious leaders roam door-to-door to counter misinformation, explain transmission and symptoms, and urge immediate reporting of suspected cases. Aristote Banga describes daily outreach amid rumours that Ebola exists or that treatment is unavailable. Imam Sheikh Shukrani Byaruma notes training faith leaders to disseminate reliable prevention messages. Officials emphasize building trust through existing provincial and community health systems rather than parallel emergency structures for sustainable outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行対応の中心にあるコミュニティ
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行（1,792例、625死亡）であり、国際的拡大リスクと重症度が高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは地理的近接として言及されているが、記事上で確定症例の発生は述べられていないためverified_locationsには含めない。Bundibugyo株にはワクチンが存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : à Boga, la 25e zone touchée rouvre le front transfrontalier avec l'Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: in Boga, the 25th affected zone reopens the cross-border front with Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak expands to Boga in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, becoming the 25th health zone affected after the confirmation of a first case—a farmer who had contact with a patient from Bunia. Boga borders Uganda, intensifying cross-border transmission risk. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain circulating in Ituri and western Uganda has triggered a joint response; as of early July, WHO and Africa CDC report over 1,400 confirmed cases and about 350 deaths across the two countries, with more than 90% in Ituri. Uganda reports roughly 20 confirmed cases and about 2 deaths. Response includes border temperature checks and handwashing, with intensified surveillance. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May; Africa CDC followed. Anthropologists assist in Uganda to reduce fear and stigma. In Boga, rapid measures—screening, isolation and contact tracing—are set to prevent a cross-border tipping point; there is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ボガで25番目の被害地域が発生、ウガンダとの国境をまたぐ前線が再燃
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が25番目の保健地域に拡大し、ウガンダとの国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが高まっている。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みで、1400例以上・350人以上の死者が報告されており、国際的関心と対応の緊急性が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。イタリア・ロンバルディア州は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事の主題とは無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ইনফ্লুয়েঞ্জা থেকে হেপাটাইটিস, বর্ষায় কী কী সংক্রামক রোগ থেকে ছোটদের সাবধানে রাখতে হবে?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From influenza to hepatitis, which infectious diseases should we be careful about for children during the monsoon season?
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, the monsoon elevates infection risk for children beyond common fever and cold. Mosquito-borne diseases intensify, with dengue, malaria, and chikungunya highlighted. Water- and food-borne illnesses spreading in flood conditions include hepatitis A and E, and typhoid, linked to contaminated water, street foods, and drinks; typhoid cases are rising, notably among 6–14-year-olds, presenting with prolonged fever, severe headache, muscle pains, rash, diarrhea, and cramps. Leptospirosis, caused by bacterial infection from rodent/animal waste in floodwater, remains a fatal risk in several regions. Viral febrile and respiratory infections also proliferate: adenovirus and rhinovirus cause sore throat and nasal symptoms, while influenza A is highly contagious; influenza D, an RNA virus related to coronaviruses, is also circulating. Emphasis on hygiene, safe water/food, and early medical attention for affected children.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザから肝炎まで、雨季に子どもを守るための感染症ガイド
triage.triage_reason: 毎年恒例の季節性感染症に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性（雨季）の一般的な感染症予防啓発記事であり、具体的な発生数や地域的アウトブレイクのデータは含まれていない。バングラ語圏（西ベンガル州など）向けの一般的健康情報記事と推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Trust Becomes Stronger Than Fear": On the Frontlines of DRC's 17th Ebola Outbreak, Aid Workers Battle a Second Epidemic -- Doubt | Best African News Online
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak hits North Kivu and Ituri as funding cuts hollow the response and a collapsing health system struggles to protect communities. CARE and partners have reached over 210,000 people with prevention messages and deployed 533 trained community health workers across 47 health areas in 14 health zones, but this reach covers only a small fraction of the millions at risk. Frontline responders describe a dual crisis: the virus and a deep erosion of trust, with residents in Mugunga (Goma) and Hero Mandibe (Ituri) reporting suspicion that aid workers are making money again. Women and girls bear the steepest barriers to care, protection from violence, and mental health support. An imported case saw a woman infected arrive in Goma from Ituri, prompting isolation and reinforced Sake entry screenings.

triage.headline_ja: 「恐怖よりも強い信頼」：コンゴ民主共和国第17次エボラ流行の最前線で、援助従事者は「疑念」という第二の感染症と闘う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ・イツリ州で継続中の第17次エボラ流行であり、資金不足による対応体制の崩壊とゴマへの輸入症例発生により国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの北キブ・イツリ州における第17次エボラ流行を主題としており、ゴマへの輸入症例（イツリ州から）が報告されている。ブルンジ（Muyinga Province）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文ではDRC国内の流行のみが焦点であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。資金削減による対応能力低下が強調されており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 1830 حالة بينها 648 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 1,830, with 648 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, according to government data released on July 11, 2026. The World Health Organization warns that the true size of the outbreak may be two to four times higher than official counts due to challenges in tracing transmission chains. Approximately 80% of new infections are not linked to known cases, signaling sustained community transmission, particularly in Ituri Province. Lab results from Bunia city show high positivity rates, reflecting ongoing spread even as some areas make progress in outbreak control. The situation underscores persistent transmission within local communities and the need for intensified surveillance and containment efforts in affected districts, especially Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が1,830人に上昇、うち648人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で大規模流行しており、致死率が高く、80%の新規感染が感染経路不明で持続的な地域内伝播を示しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは公式集計の2〜4倍の実際の感染規模の可能性を指摘しており、感染経路追跡の困難さから過小評価の懸念がある。イトゥリ州での持続的な地域内伝播が特に懸念される。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: மகரகமவில் டெங்கு நுளம்பு பெருகும் வகையில் வளாகங்களைப் வைத்திருந்தவர்களுக்கு அபராதம்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fines for those who kept premises in a way that dengue mosquitoes proliferate during Makaram!
article.articleSummary: In Makaram, the Gangodawila Magistrate’s Court fined a group of homeowners a total of 2.1 million Sri Lankan rupees for keeping premises that facilitated dengue mosquito breeding. The ruling, described by the Makara Health Department’s Administrative Public Health Inspector as the largest single-day dengue-related penalties to date, followed recent inspections as part of the district’s dengue abatement program. The decision signals ongoing dengue control efforts, with further programs expected. Officials urged residents to maintain clean surroundings and adopt preventive measures to curb dengue transmission, noting that continued inspections and penalties will target violations enabling Aedes mosquito proliferation in residential premises.

triage.headline_ja: マカラムでデング蚊が繁殖しやすい状態の敷地を放置していた住民に罰金！
triage.triage_reason: スリランカ・マカラムでのデング蚊対策違反に対する罰金という国内行政措置の通常ニュースであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にインド（Andhra Pradesh）が含まれているが、記事本文はスリランカのマカラム（Gangodawila）地区のデング蚊対策罰金に関する内容であり、インドについての言及はない。スリランカは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Difteria: entenda sobre a doença que reapareceu no Brasil e em outros países
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diphtheria: Learn about the disease that has reemerged in Brazil and in other countries.
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria reemerges in Brazil and other countries, with PAHO noting that more than half of confirmed cases this year involve individuals who are unvaccinated or have unknown vaccination status. Vaccination coverage against diphtheria remains below ideal levels across the Americas. The disease is caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae and spreads through respiratory droplets. It is characterized by a thick gray pseudomembrane on the throat and tonsils, which can obstruct the airways. If untreated, it can cause severe respiratory distress and damage to the heart and nervous system, with a risk of death. Unvaccinated people or those with incomplete immunization are at greatest risk. The report highlights the ongoing risk and the critical importance of maintaining adequate diphtheria vaccination to curb spread in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ジフテリア：ブラジルおよび他国で再興した疾患について理解する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルを含む複数国でジフテリアが再興し、未接種者を中心に重症化・死亡リスクがあるため、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当が確認された。
triage.notes: 発生地域にカナリア諸島・スペインが含まれるが、記事はブラジルを中心とした再興を主題としており、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Fresh ASF cases in Charaideo, ban on pig transport, pork sale
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) has been detected again in pigs at Hatibondha Pather under Mahmora revenue circle in Charaideo district, Assam, prompting district magistrate Neha Yadav to issue prohibitory orders under BNSS Section 163. Lab tests confirmed infection after the district animal husbandry and veterinary officer reported the results; Charaideo recorded its first ASF case on June 13, with officials saying the latest detections aim to curb spread to adjoining areas. The order bans transport of live pigs and pork products within Mahmora, and prohibits sale, slaughter, or purchase of pigs in the area. Pig owners must report pig deaths promptly; carcasses must be buried deeply per biosecurity rules. Movement of pig feed requires prior veterinary permission. Violations carry action under BNS Section 223. ASF is contagious to pigs, not humans, and early reporting and biosecurity are key.

triage.headline_ja: チャライデオ県で新たなASF確認、豚の輸送・豚肉販売を禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は豚のみに感染するヒト非感染症であり、地域当局により輸送禁止等の防疫措置が既に講じられ局地的に管理されているため、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない家畜疾病であり、地域行政による移動制限・報告義務等の措置がすでに実施されている。公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低いが、畜産・経済への影響として継続監視の対象となり得る。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola toll continues to rise, outbreak the third worst
article.articleSummary: As of July 10, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo report 648 deaths and 1,830 confirmed cases (case fatality rate 35.4%), with 780 in hospital isolation and 285 recoveries; contact tracing at 78.1%. The outbreak centers in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with South Kivu nearing 42 days without a new case, a threshold for ending per WHO. Ituri declared the outbreak on May 15, and the epidemic has spread to Uganda, which has 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak, with a 30–50% fatality rate and no authorised vaccine or specific treatment. WHO lists sub-Saharan Africa risk as high, globally low; virus began circulating ~two months before confirmation and was declared a PHEIC on May 17. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. This is the third-worst Ebola epidemic, after 2014–2016 West Africa and 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱による死者数が増加し続け、史上3番目に深刻な流行に
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、死者648名・致死率35.4%、国境を越えてウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。PHEIC宣言済みで史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行として国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: NMMC Intensifies Anti-Mosquito Drive At 270 Construction Sites To Curb Dengue And Malaria During Monsoon
article.articleSummary: NMMC intensifies anti-mosquito drive to curb dengue and malaria during the monsoon with a weekly anti-larval campaign at 270 construction sites across Navi Mumbai, mapped under 26 Urban Primary Health Centres. The sites house 14,390 workers: 152 sites with up to 50 workers, 45 with 51–100, 40 more than 100, and 33 excavation-only sites. Measures include regular health camps, granular larvicide treatment, and anti-larval powder sprayed in residential shelters of 3,560 workers over three months, with guppy fish released in stagnant water bodies; guppies have already been introduced at 265 sites. Health officials conduct follow-up inspections after every anti-larval treatment to verify reduced mosquito breeding. Officials urge builders and citizens to eliminate stagnant water and maintain cleanliness to prevent dengue and malaria. See statements from Mayor Sujata Suraj Patil and Municipal Commissioner Dr. Kailas Shinde urging community support.

triage.headline_ja: NMMC、モンスーン期のデング熱・マラリア抑制のため270の建設現場で防蚊対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のルーティンな予防対策に関する記事であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 自治体（NMMC）による毎年恒例の防蚊・防マラリア対策活動の報道であり、具体的な症例数急増や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Research progress and trends of Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in children: a bibliometric and visualization analysis (1990s to post-COVID-19 era)
article.articleSummary: Post-COVID-19 era accelerates research on pediatric Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (MPP): a bibliometric analysis of 1992–2025 Web of Science literature comprising 2357 articles by 11,318 authors from 2714 institutions across 94 countries. China and the United States are the leading sources; Soochow University and Capital Medical University are the most active institutions. Publications surged during and after the COVID-19 pandemic, with the top 10 co-cited references including four research articles and six reviews. Over 34 years, the focus shifted from community-acquired pneumonia and general pediatric pulmonary disease to MPP. Current hotspots include epidemiology, diagnostics, macrolide resistance, refractory MPP, and co-infections; COVID-19-related citation bursts are noted. The study highlights the need for stronger global collaboration and more epidemiological studies to address MPP challenges amid evolving infectious threats.

triage.headline_ja: 小児マイコプラズマ肺炎に関する研究の進展と動向：計量書誌学的・可視化分析（1990年代からポストCOVID-19時代まで）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、小児マイコプラズマ肺炎に関する研究動向を分析した計量書誌学的レビュー論文であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性やシグナルとしての要素はない。
triage.notes: 学術的な文献分析（ビブリオメトリクス研究）であり、特定の国での感染症発生事例を報告するものではないため、地域検証の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Province du Kwilu dotée d'un plan d'action opérationnel de surveillance des maladies émergentes - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwilu Province equipped with an operational action plan for the surveillance of emerging diseases - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kwilu Province in southwest Democratic Republic of the Congo has been equipped with an Operational Action Plan (PAO) for the surveillance of emerging and re-emerging diseases, unveiled at a Kikwit workshop organized by INRB under its One Health initiative and funded by the Canadian International Development Research Centre (CRDI). The PAO maps the province’s epidemiological situation, identifies diseases and risks, and details multisectoral technical strategies for detection, protection, case management, surveillance, and risk communication. Dr. Donat Kumakuma stated the plan will bolster multisectoral public health coordination and strengthen responses to infectious diseases of zoonotic and environmental origin. Dr. Roly Paku of the DOPERAUS project called the plan a practical tool for surveillance and response. Participants deemed the workshop beneficial. Kwilu was historically an epicenter for pasteurellosis, canine rabies, and Ebola virus as of July 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: クウィル州、新興感染症サーベイランスのための実施行動計画を整備 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実際の感染症発生ではなく、サーベイランス体制強化のための行動計画策定に関する行政的な報告であり、緊急性のあるアウトブレイクの兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去にクウィル州がパスツレラ症、犬狂犬病、エボラウイルスの発生地であったと言及しているが、これは歴史的背景の説明であり、現在進行中の発生事例ではない。行動計画発表という行政ニュースのため、対象国リストの現行アウトブレイクとしては該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola Salgını İlan Edilen Eyalet Sayısı Dörde Çıktı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola outbreak-declared provinces in Congo has risen to four.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to four provinces. In Haut-Uele province, northeast, seven people have died, and authorities have declared an outbreak across the province. Nationwide, 1,792 laboratory-confirmed cases and 625 deaths have been reported, with 295 recoveries, concentrated in the three most affected provinces. In Ituri province’s capital Bunia, a health worker disinfects after an Ebola-related death on 9 July 2026. Officials say the outbreak remains in a very active phase and has not yet peaked. As of 9 July 2026, four provinces are affected. The report provides no details on infection sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行宣言州が4州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で4州に拡大し、1,792例確認・625人死亡と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は約35%（625/1792）と高く、流行は依然活発でピークに達していないとされる。感染源や輸出入例の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية يودي بحياة 625 شخصاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo kills 625 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues as of July 11, 2026, with 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths. There are 764 patients currently isolated or hospitalized, and 295 recovered. The outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. Health Minister Roger Kamba warned the outbreak is still highly active and peak timing cannot be predicted, citing dense populations, high human mobility, and community engagement challenges. The epidemic began on May 15 after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported in Ituri, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The current outbreak is linked to a rare Bundibugyo virus strain, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行、死者625人に達す
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行(1,792症例、625死亡)で、治療法・ワクチン未承認の稀なBundibugyo株が原因であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudanが含まれているが、これは1976年の初発見地への言及であり、現在の流行はDRC国内（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu）に限定されているためSudanは除外。WHOはすでに5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Formation Ebola à Nairobi : Soignants Prêts pour l'Épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola training in Nairobi: Healthcare workers ready for the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In Nairobi, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) runs intensive Ebola preparedness training for health workers likely to respond to an outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak, declared May 15, has caused around 600 deaths, underscoring Ebola’s high contagion through fluids from patients and deceased individuals. In the DRC, 112 healthcare worker infections have been confirmed, with 35 deaths. The Nairobi center has trained about 100 MSF staff and is hosting personnel from Kenya’s Ministry of Health and other NGOs. Training emphasizes technical and psychological readiness, including donning PPE (yellow suit, rubber boots, apron, hood with collar, mask, goggles, two pairs of gloves) and working in pairs, with dressing times logged. Doffing involves paired decontamination with spray; simulations cover fever, vomiting, moving a deceased patient, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: ナイロビでのエボラ研修：医療従事者がアウトブレイクに備える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにより約600人が死亡し、医療従事者112人が感染・35人死亡するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国北東部で発生しているエボラアウトブレイクであり、ナイロビは近隣国として医療従事者への予防訓練を実施している場所に過ぎないため、ケニアは発生地域として含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Au Kenya, des soignants se forment aux dangers d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, healthcare workers are training to face the dangers of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: MSF is training Kenyan healthcare teams in Nairobi to confront Ebola linked to an outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Declared May 15, the outbreak has caused about 600 deaths and over 1,700 confirmed cases in DRC, with 112 infected healthcare workers and 35 deaths among them. The Nairobi MSF center has trained about 100 staff and will host personnel from Kenya's Ministry of Health and other NGOs; more are expected. The program emphasizes managing stress and strict PPE protocols—yellow suit, hood, mask, goggles, gloves—with one hour per shift due to heat. Drills cover fever and vomiting scenarios, safe handling of cadavers, and community outreach to encourage testing and safe burials. Bunia in DRC is the outbreak's epicenter; deployment allows no room for error.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで医療従事者がエボラ出血熱の危険に対応するための訓練を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは約600人の死者・1700件超の確定症例を伴い、医療従事者の感染・死亡も多数発生している深刻な公衆衛生事象であり、国際的な支援体制（MSFによる周辺国での訓練）が組まれている。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア（ナイロビ）でのMSFによる医療従事者向けエボラ対応訓練を報じているが、実際のアウトブレイクはDRC北東部（ブニア震源地）で発生中。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。既知の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報告であり、続報・地域拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Alarma mundial en el Congo: el brote de ébola ya causó 648 muertes y 1.830 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global alarm in the Congo: the Ebola outbreak has already caused 648 deaths and 1,830 cases.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola has 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, a case fatality rate of 34.1%, as of July 11, 2026. About 764 patients remain in isolation or hospitalization; 295 have recovered, and contact tracing is 78.6% effective in the affected areas. The outbreak is concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (the epicenter), North Kivu, and South Kivu, with two cases detected in Kisangani, Tshopo. It was officially declared on May 15 in Ituri and has spread to Uganda, which reports 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from the DRC) and 2 deaths. The responsible strain is Bundibugyo, with a typical fatality between 30% and 50%, and there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. This is the third-worst Ebola outbreak and the seventeenth in the DRC. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ世界的警戒:エボラ出血熱の流行で648人死亡、1,830症例に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（致死率34.1%）が発生し、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点、DRC史上3番目に深刻なアウトブレイクである点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les prestataires de première ligne, " premiers protecteurs de la population " (ministre de la Santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: frontline health workers, "the first protectors of the population" (Minister of Health) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, frontline health workers in Bunia are described as the population’s first protectors by Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba. He urged unity among responders—clinical teams, dignified and secure burial squads, and water, sanitation and hygiene personnel—to ensure patient care first and prevent containment failures. In response to protests over more than a month of unpaid bonuses and pay disparities, Kamba announced a shift to direct government payments via biometric cards to eliminate intermediaries and fraudulent beneficiary lists, promising transparent, direct compensation. The visit coincided with social unrest; authorities emphasize collective action, safe and dignified burials, and strengthened payment systems to sustain the Ebola response and protect frontline workers.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ出血熱：最前線の医療従事者は「住民の最初の守護者」（保健大臣）— ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報道であり、致死率の高い疾患であること、対応従事者への未払い問題による抗議活動など対応体制の脆弱性が示唆されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は最前線対応者への未払い賞与を巡る抗議活動と、政府によるバイオメトリックカードを用いた直接支払いへの移行方針に焦点を当てている。アウトブレイクの規模・症例数・死亡者数などの詳細情報は本サマリーには含まれておらず、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen in Congo tests positive for Ebola virus: US CDC
article.articleSummary: US citizen working for a humanitarian organisation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, the US CDC said. The CDC is collaborating with the patient’s employer, other federal agencies and partners in the DRC to prevent further transmission and identify high-risk contacts. Government data indicate the current outbreak in the DRC includes 1,830 confirmed Ebola cases with 648 deaths, as reported in a situation update published late Friday and representing totals through Thursday. The ongoing outbreak is being monitored, with laboratory confirmation noted for the Bundibugyo strain; details on infection source are not provided. Additional details on imported/exported status were not provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの米国人がエボラウイルス陽性反応：米CDC
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが継続しており(1,830症例、648死亡)、米国人感染者も確認され国際的拡大の懸念があるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: Risque d'aggravation de la situation humanitaire, avertit l'Unicef
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: Risk of a Worsening Humanitarian Situation, UNICEF Warns.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 1,792 cases and 625 deaths, according to official figures published July 9, 2026. Declared on May 15 as the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country, it is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment; a clinical trial evaluating two therapies has recently begun. The epicentre is Ituri province in the North-East, where health systems are overstretched. UNICEF warns that the humanitarian situation could worsen if the Ebola response crowds out other essential health services. Pre-outbreak, roughly 130 births per month occurred in Ituri health facilities; now around 30 monthly. Erosion of trust between communities and health centers compounds the crisis, with ongoing concerns about cholera, polio, and maternal care alongside Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：人道状況の悪化リスクをユニセフが警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が拡大中（1,792症例、625死亡）で、ワクチン・承認治療薬がないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行かつ保健システムが逼迫しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約35%と高く、ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行。UNICEFはエボラ対応が他の必須医療サービス（出産・コレラ・ポリオ対応等）を圧迫するリスクを警告しており、複合的な人道危機に発展する懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa usa IA para analisar risco de dengue por bairro em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study uses AI to analyze dengue risk by neighborhood in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: AI-driven project by Instituto Pasteur de São Paulo creates high-resolution dengue transmission risk maps for the city of São Paulo at neighborhood and block scales. It merges climate data (temperature, humidity) with urban socio-environmental indicators—urban heat islands; access to treated water; sewage collection efficiency; and public service coverage—to explain why neighboring areas with similar climates exhibit divergent dengue incidence. The initiative also uses social listening on digital platforms to gauge public and health professionals’ perceptions of dengue vaccine efficacy and safety, aiming to identify collective behavior trends and confidence levels that could affect vaccination uptake, without analyzing individuals. Led by Mauro César Cafundó de Morais, head of the Laboratory of Climate and Health at IPSP (Institute Pasteur of Paris and the University of São Paulo co-founders), with national and international partners. The information originated from Agência de Notícias do Governo do Estado de São Paulo, July 2026; current reference July 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: AIを使ってサンパウロの地区別デング熱リスクを分析する研究

article.articleHeadline: USF Bandeirantes faz ação especial para orientar sobre hepatites virais | São Gonçalo | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USF Bandeirantes conducts a special outreach to educate about viral hepatitis | São Gonçalo | O Dia
article.articleSummary: São Gonçalo’s USF Bandeirantes joined the municipal Ist/Aids and Viral Hepatitis program as part of the July Yellow campaign. On Thursday, staff educated patients about viral hepatitis prevention and self-care and offered rapid tests for hepatitis B and C, syphilis, and HIV. The campaign runs throughout July to raise awareness of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of sexually transmitted infections, with World Hepatitis Day on July 28. Tests are available without a doctor’s referral at all basic health units Monday–Friday, 8:00–16:00. Viral hepatitis are liver inflammations caused by the hepatitis A, B, and C viruses and are often asymptomatic, underscoring the importance of testing. Vaccination: hepatitis A vaccine in childhood and for HIV PrEP users aged 15+; hepatitis B vaccine in three doses for adults. Hepatitis C has treatment and cure. Treatment for infected residents is provided at Gonçalense Referral Clinic for Chronic and Transmissible Diseases (Parada 40) and PAM Coelho.

article.articleHeadline: Second US citizen contracts Ebola in Congo amid deadly outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak reports 1,830 laboratory-confirmed infections and 648 deaths. The Bundibugyo variant is spreading rapidly and is hard to contain due to the lack of an approved vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola is a life-threatening viral disease transmitted through direct contact and contact with bodily fluids; the outbreak began in May in the DRC. A second US citizen, employed by a humanitarian organization in the DRC, has tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant, with gender not disclosed. The CDC is supporting contact tracing and risk assessment alongside Congolese health authorities and partners. Previously, a doctor working in eastern Congo was treated in Berlin, and a French humanitarian doctor who returned from eastern Congo also tested positive and recovered in hospital, illustrating imported/exported cases linked to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで致死的なアウトブレイクの中、2人目の米国人がエボラに感染

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases top 1,800 as outbreak spreads to 4th Congo province
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,830 confirmed infections (as of 11 July 2026), with 648 deaths, 780 patients in treatment and 284 recoveries. Declared May 15, the outbreak is mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, but expanded into Haut-Uele’s Wamba health zone, marking a fourth province affected. Uganda reports 20 Ebola cases. Donors and partners pledged about $910 million to support Congo and neighboring Uganda. Africa CDC deployed multidisciplinary teams to priority zones accounting for roughly 83% of confirmed infections. WHO designated the Bundibugyo strain outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Among 1,759 cases prior to the latest update, 112 involved health workers, including 35 deaths. MSF opened a Nairobi-area Ebola training facility to prepare frontline responders, operating mid-June through August with capacity to train about 100 responders per month.

There are 764 patients in isolation or hospital, 295 recoveries, and contact tracing effectiveness at 78.6%. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri (the epicenter) and in North Kivu and South Kivu, with two additional cases detected in Kisangani, Tshopo province. article.articleHeadline: ABP LIVE Doc Talk Can Monsoon Trigger Brain Infections? Neurologists Explain Rare But Dangerous Risks
article.articleSummary: During the monsoon, while dengue, malaria and seasonal flu rise, rare but life-threatening brain infections—viral encephalitis and meningitis—may surge. Heavy rainfall, waterlogging, poor sanitation, contaminated water and expanded mosquito breeding activate viruses such as Japanese Encephalitis, which can progress from fever to encephalitis or inflame brain/spinal membranes causing meningitis. Symptoms demanding urgent care include high fever, severe headache, confusion or seizures, neck stiffness, vomiting, photophobia, and altered consciousness. Diagnosis relies on neurological examination plus MRI/CT, lumbar puncture, blood tests, viral PCR, and, in selected cases, EEG. Early detection and treatment reduce permanent neurological damage. Prevention includes protecting against mosquito bites, safe water and hygiene, vaccination for Japanese Encephalitis where advised, and prompt care for new neurological symptoms—emphasized by Gurugram's Dr. Praveen Gupta.

triage.headline_ja: ABPライブ ドクタートーク:モンスーンは脳感染症を引き起こすか?神経内科医が稀だが危険なリスクを解説
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例報告ではなく、モンスーン期の脳感染症リスクに関する一般的な医療解説・啓発記事であり、具体的なアウトブレイクや症例数の急増は示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の医療啓発コンテンツであり、具体的な感染者数・アウトブレイク発生地域・時期についての実データが含まれていない。Gurgaon/Haryana/Indiaは医師の所在地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域としての報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: पीपीटीसीटी कक्ष से गर्भवती और नवजात को मिल रही एचआईवी संक्रमण से सुरक्षा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protection against HIV infection for pregnant women and newborns provided through the PPTCT room.
article.articleSummary: At Fatehpur District Women’s Hospital, the PPTCT (Prevention of Parent-to-Child Transmission) room helps protect pregnant women and their newborns from HIV infection. Through the PPTCT program, pregnant women receive confidential counseling, free HIV testing, and essential health services. HIV screening is integrated into routine antenatal care. If a woman tests HIV-positive, she is immediately linked to an ART (antiretroviral therapy) center and started on treatment, with ongoing oversight by specialist doctors. Safe institutional delivery is arranged to keep the risk of mother-to-child transmission as low as possible. The initiative emphasizes early diagnosis, treatment, and medically supervised births to safeguard mothers and infants against HIV within Fatehpur, India.

triage.headline_ja: PPTCTルームを通じて妊婦と新生児にHIV感染からの保護を提供
triage.triage_reason: 既存のHIV母子感染予防プログラムに関する定例的な報道であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: PPTCTプログラムの通常運用に関する地方紙報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Penyakit Berbahaya akibat Gigitan Nyamuk di Rumah, Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Dangerous Diseases Caused by Mosquito Bites at Home, Beware
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya, transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, causes high fever and rash with severe joint pain; no specific vaccine is available currently. Yellow Fever, spread by Aedes and Haemagogus, can cause liver injury with jaundice; vaccination is crucial for people in high-risk areas. Malaria, a Plasmodium infection via female Anopheles mosquitoes, can lead to complications like kidney failure if not treated with artemisinin-based drugs; WHO has approved Mosquirix as an added preventive measure. Filariasis (elephantiasis), caused by filarial worms transmitted by Culex and Mansonia mosquitoes, results in chronic swelling of limbs or genitals if untreated. Zika virus, also spread by Aedes, is typically mild in adults but poses a serious risk for pregnant women due to potential fetal microcephaly. Prevention centers on 3M actions—drain standing water, seal water containers, and recycle waste—plus environmental cleanliness and targeted fogging when mosquito populations rise.

triage.headline_ja: 自宅の蚊に刺されて起こる5つの危険な病気に注意
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、蚊媒介感染症全般に関する一般的な啓発・予防情報記事であり、具体的な流行や異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の発生事例を報じるものではなく、家庭内での蚊媒介感染症（マラリア、チクングニア、黄熱病、ジカ熱、フィラリア症）に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であるため、具体的な国での発生事例としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : création d'une cellule provinciale de veille Ebola pour renforcer prévention et riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Creation of a Provincial Ebola Surveillance Unit to Strengthen Prevention and Response - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Tshopo province, northeast DRC, a provincial Ebola Surveillance Cell has been established to strengthen prevention and response to Ebola Virus Disease (EVD). The governor’s order creates the 'Cellule provinciale de veille Ebola' as a multisectoral body for strategic leadership, prevention against introduction, and surveillance/control of EVD. Guided by the Interior Minister and the National Preparedness Plan, and amid increased cross-border movement with Ituri via road, river and air, the Cell will oversee surveillance, early warning, entry-point protection, resource mobilization, risk communication, and community engagement, and will issue recommendations to the provincial government. Chaired by the governor, it includes government, security services, public administrations, civil society, private sector, Red Cross, UN agencies, and technical/financial partners, with technical commissions. Four imported EVD cases from Nia-Nia (Ituri), including two deaths, have been recorded; two patients are treated at Kisangani’s Cinquantenaire Ebola Treatment Center.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:エボラ予防・対応強化のための州エボラ監視ユニット設立 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州でイトゥリ州(Nia-Nia)からの輸入エボラ症例4件（うち死亡2例）が確認され、州当局が緊急に監視体制を強化していることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州Nia-Niaからの輸入症例が起点となっており、州境を跨ぐ人の移動増加により更なる拡大リスクが懸念される。国連機関・技術/資金パートナーが関与しており、国際支援の枠組みが既に稼働中。

article.articleHeadline: Αμερικανός πολίτης στη ΛΔ Κονγκό διεγνώσθη θετικός στον ιό του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American citizen in the DRC diagnosed positive for the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, an American citizen employed by a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced. The patient’s status was confirmed via testing, and the CDC stated it is collaborating with the employing organization, other federal agencies, and partners in the DRC to prevent further transmission and to identify high-risk contacts. The announcement underscores the public health response to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the ongoing coordination between U.S. authorities and Congolese partners to contain potential spread.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス陽性と診断
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の症例確認であり、致死率の高い疾患で国際的拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 米国人患者はDRCで感染したとみられ、米国はあくまで国籍・雇用元。米国内での感染発生ではないため米国はverified_locationsに含めない。CDCとDRC当局が接触者追跡等で連携している旨が記載されており、続報（感染拡大状況、致死率、接触者数等）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará intensifica ações contra a dengue após aumento de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará Intensifies Actions to Combat Dengue After an Increase in Cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Ceará, Brazil, as of July 2026, prompts the state Health Secretariat (Sesa) to intensify epidemiological surveillance and municipal support, focusing on Norte, Litoral Leste and Vale do Jaguaribe where notifications have risen. Measures include stronger laboratory diagnosis via Lacen and expanded RT-PCR testing to confirm dengue and enable genomic surveillance, with serotype 2 currently predominant this year (unlike earlier years when serotype 1 led). Vector control includes targeted indoor spraying and, when needed, Ultra Low Volume (fumacê) vehicles; training for Basic Health Unit staff on rapid case notification and adherence to Ministry of Health clinical protocols. IntegraSUS provides updated epidemiological data for decisions; early alert letters are sent to less affected municipalities to encourage preventive action. Community participation is essential—weekly checks of backyards, standing water, containers and other breeding sites; seek care for suspected dengue with high fever, retro-orbital pain, body and joint pains, and rash.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州、症例増加を受けデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は南米で季節的に発生する既知の感染症であり、州レベルでの対策強化にとどまるが、血清型変化や症例増加は経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: セアラ州内での症例増加と血清型2の優勢化に伴う地方レベルの対応強化。国レベル・国際的な重大性の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: MSF Ebola training in Kenya prepares doctors for 'intense' job
article.articleSummary: MSF has opened an Ebola training facility on the outskirts of Nairobi, Kenya, to prepare doctors, nurses, and clinicians for deployments to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) or to regional countries at risk from the outbreak. The DRC Ebola outbreak is described as the fastest-growing in Africa, with at least 648 deaths since it was declared in mid-May and 1,830 confirmed cases reported by the DRC ministry of communication. The simulation center includes beds, mannequins, a mock laboratory and protective gear, and trains about 100 people per month through August and possibly beyond. Training covers community engagement, safe funeral practices, reducing stigma for recovered patients, and managing interactions with communities when PPE-clad staff arrive. Participants include MSF staff, Kenyan Ministry of Health officials, and staff from other NGOs; trainees say PPE makes deployment feel more intense but more manageable after training.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、ケニアでエボラ対応訓練を実施し医師らを『過酷な』任務に備える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（死者648人、確定症例1,830例、アフリカ最速拡大）に関する記事であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのMSF訓練施設だが、実際のエボラ流行地はDRCであるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Weiterer US-Bürger infiziert sich im Kongo mit Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another American citizen is infected with Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two US citizens have been infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak, both linked to Bundibugyo virus. A second US national working for a humanitarian organization in Congo tested positive in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, with Bundibugyo virus confirmed; contact tracing and risk assessment are under way to prevent further spread. The earlier US physician infected in eastern Congo was treated in Berlin's Charité hospital and discharged after recovery. In late June, Europe also detected the virus in France, where a humanitarian NGO doctor returning from eastern Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo virus, was isolated on arrival, and released in early July after negative tests and no symptoms. Since May, lab-confirmed infections have reached 1,830 with 648 deaths. Ebola remains highly transmissible via direct contact and bodily fluids; there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo virus. Authorities continue case finding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでさらに米国人がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクが継続し、致死率の高い感染症患者が国際的に(米国人、フランス人)発生・移動しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 累計症例1,830例、死亡648例で致死率約35%と高い。既に米国・フランスへの越境感染例が報告されており、ワクチン・特異的治療法が確立していないブンディブギョウイルス種であることから、フルリスク評価が必要。ドイツ・米国・フランスは症例の治療・帰国先であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC, WHO chiefs to visit DRC's Ebola epicenter to accelerate response
article.articleSummary: On 11 July 2026, Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya and WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced a joint mission to Bunia, Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, epicenter of the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. The visit, scheduled for July 18–19, aims to meet national authorities, frontline health workers, affected communities, and response partners to accelerate the response, strengthen coordination, and mobilize support to stop transmission and protect lives. The mission follows a Geneva meeting on urgent action needed on the ground. Kaseya urged faster diagnosis, rigorous contact tracing, expanded treatment and isolation capacity, and increased supplies, underscoring that speed saves lives in Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCとWHOのトップ、対応加速のためコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）のDRC・ウガンダでのアウトブレイクに対し、Africa CDCとWHOのトップが現地訪問し対応加速を図るなど国際的関心と対応の緊急性が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも関連国として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主題であることは明確。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश आई बीमारियां लाई
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rains bring illnesses
article.articleSummary: Bareilly, July 11, 2026 — following heavy rains, district and private hospitals report a surge of patients with viral fever, throat and chest infections, and skin conditions, along with increased cold and flu symptoms in children. Doctors attribute the spike to abrupt weather changes and higher humidity that reactivate viruses. Skin problems include fungal infections, allergies, itching, and ringworm; pediatric cases show cold, cough, fever, vomiting, and diarrhea as immunity wanes in this season. Pathology labs across the region are seeing crowds for blood tests, CBC, dengue, malaria, and other investigations. Preventive guidance emphasizes hygiene, avoiding open or stale foods, drinking clean boiled or filtered water, and drying clothes promptly after getting wet. Seek medical advice for fever, persistent cough, vomiting/diarrhea, or skin infections rather than self-medicating. Field workers are advised to take extra health precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 雨が病気をもたらした
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の雨期に伴う一般的な感染症（ウイルス性発熱・皮膚疾患・小児の風邪症状等）の増加を報じる内容で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性の気候変動に伴う一般的な感染症報告であり、デング熱・マラリアの検査需要増加は言及されているが具体的な症例数や異常な増加は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Health department asks MGMMCH to probe malaria surge in East Singhbhum
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, East Singhbhum, Jharkhand, reports a malaria surge with 1,731 cases and 6 deaths from June 29–July 10, comprising 1,361 Plasmodium falciparum and 326 Plasmodium vivax. The state health department has directed Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Medical College and Hospital (MGMMCH) in Jamshedpur to conduct a comprehensive probe. A preventive and social medicine team will visit villages with high case loads, interact with residents, and assess living conditions, lifestyles, and preventive measures. The team will also review all malaria-related deaths in the past fortnight to determine exact causes and any possible medical negligence. MGMMCH seeks detailed records from East Singhbhum civil surgeon Dr Sahir Pall on cases, treatment, and containment steps. The investigation is expected to wrap up soon. Separately, in Potka block, CHC medical officer Dr Rajani Mahakaud has been suspended, with 11 doctors served showcause notices.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、東シンガブームでのマラリア急増についてMGMMCHに調査を指示
triage.triage_reason: 1,731症例・6死亡という急増が報告され、州保健局が調査を指示するなど深刻性・異常性が認められるため、IHR基準を2項目満たす。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの風土病であるが、短期間での急激な症例増加と複数死亡、医療過誤疑いによる医師の停職・訓告処分など行政対応の強化が見られる。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、国内公衆衛生対応の妥当性を確認するため続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo has tested positive for Ebola, the CDC said, with authorities coordinating to identify close contacts and prevent transmission. Outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded in Africa, with 1,830 confirmed cases in Congo and 648 deaths; cases have also been confirmed in neighboring Uganda. In the first week, an American doctor tested positive and was transferred to Germany for treatment. Earlier, U.S. officials said exposed Americans abroad would be sent to a facility in Kenya, but the project was suspended after a Kenyan court order. Congolese authorities declared a fresh outbreak on May 15; the disease is caused by Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. Containment is hampered by a funding gap, attacks on health centers and ongoing eastern Congo conflict. Clinical trials for treatment began last week.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がコンゴでエボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大のエボラ流行が継続中で、死者648名・確定症例1830例、近隣ウガンダへの拡大や米国人感染者も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 米国、ドイツ、ケニア、ウガンダは感染者の搬送・対応先や隣接感染確認国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダでの感染確認は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo supera las 600 muertes y avanza sin control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 600 deaths and advances uncontrollably.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 600 deaths with 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths, up 33 cases and 25 deaths from the prior report. Ituri province remains the epicenter with 1,631 cases and 535 deaths across 25 of 36 health zones, while transmission has reached North Kivu and there are suspected cases in Tshopo and Haut-Uele, signaling geographic expansion. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no licensed vaccines or approved strain-specific treatments, whereas vaccines and therapies developed in the last decade target Zaire ebolavirus. WHO and partners are accelerating evaluation of experimental candidates. Confirmed in May 2026 in the DRC and Uganda, with May 16 declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Insecurity, weak health infrastructure, and distrust hinder containment; the true size could be 2–4 times official counts, with many cases lacking known links.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が死者600人を超え、制御不能に拡大
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが宣言されたエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)の大規模流行で、死者600人超・地理的拡大・ワクチン/治療薬未承認という深刻性と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに無し。実際の主要発生地はDRC(イトゥリ州、北キブ州、ツショピ州、オートウエレ州)。既にPHEIC宣言済みのため継続監視が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 全球公衛警報！剛果爆發隱形伊波拉、蘇丹霍亂因戰火加劇 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Public Health Alert! Congo outbreak of invisible Ebola and Sudan cholera worsened as fighting intensifies.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo shows ‘invisible transmission,’ with up to 80% of new cases lacking a traceable source. Official counts are 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths, but WHO cautions actual infections could be two to four times higher. The CDC confirms a U.S. citizen aiding a humanitarian organization has contracted Ebola. In Sudan, a cholera outbreak since late June has caused at least 114 deaths and over 1,300 infections, worsened by the rainy season, displacement, and disrupted medical care, with Darfur and Kordofan regions highlighted as high-risk. Globally, avian influenza H5N1 persists: backyard poultry outbreaks in Oriental Mindoro, Philippines, and detection in wild seabirds along southern Australia raise concerns about cross-border, cross-species spread and potential human infection.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な公衆衛生警報！コンゴで見えないエボラ流行拡大、スーダンでは戦闘激化によりコレラが深刻化
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は確認症例1,792例・死亡625例に達し、新規症例の最大80%で感染経路不明という異常な『見えない伝播』が報告され、米国人感染者も確認されるなど国際的拡大の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: スーダンのコレラ流行およびオーストラリアの野鳥H5N1検出は記事の主要トピックだが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。フィリピンでは裏庭養鶏場でのH5N1発生が報告されているが、規模・重症度の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: He took the life of an 11-year-old child! It enters the body through the nostrils, and cases are increasing worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, infections are increasing worldwide as climate warming expands warm freshwater habitats. A Costa Rica case involved 11-year-old Jordan Smelski, vacationing with his family; after time on water slides near a natural hot spring he developed a headache, vomiting, then hallucinations and died seven days later. He died from primary amebic meningoencephalitis (PAM), an infection of brain tissue acquired when the amoeba enters via the nostrils during water activities. The amoeba resides in warm lakes, hot springs, and neglected pools. Globally, more than 200 cases were detected in India last year, with fewer than 500 cases overall historically; experts expect more cases as the organism appears in colder regions. Reports include Slovakia’s first case in 2023, plus cases in Taiwan’s indoor surf facility and northern US states such as Minnesota, as well as cases in Belgium and Italy. Mortality is around 97%.

triage.headline_ja: 11歳の子供の命を奪った！鼻孔から侵入し、世界的に症例が増加している
triage.triage_reason: ネグレリア・フォーレリ（脳食いアメーバ）による原発性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎は致死率が高いが、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく個別の環境曝露事例であり、インドの症例数は「昨年」の集計に基づく概況記事で、現時点での新規発生シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動による温暖淡水域拡大に伴うネグレリア・フォーレリ感染症の世界的増加傾向を概説する特集記事。インドで昨年200例超と記載されているが、具体的な発生時期や地域詳細は不明。他の言及国（コスタリカ、スロバキア、台湾、米国、ベルギー、イタリア）は対象国リスト外のため除外。継続的な報道動向の監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Nguyên: Ghi nhận 259 ca mắc và nghi mắc sởi, chưa có trường hợp tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thai Nguyen: 259 measles cases and suspected measles cases recorded; no deaths reported yet.
article.articleSummary: Thai Nguyen Province, Vietnam, reports 259 measles cases and suspected measles cases from the start of 2026 through 11 July 2026. There have been no measles-related deaths to date. The Thai Nguyen Department of Health notes that the number of cases has fallen by about 10% compared with the same period in 2025, indicating a positive trend in the local measles situation. The report does not provide breakdowns by age, vaccination status, or laboratory confirmation, and does not mention any imported or exported cases. The information was published on 11 July 2026 at 21:05 by journalist Tran Anh for Nha bao va Cong luan. The summary focuses on surveillance counts and trend within the province, with no additional regional context supplied.

triage.headline_ja: タイグエン省：麻疹・麻疹疑い259例を記録、死亡例なし
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向にあり、死亡例もないため深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないが、麻疹は感染力が強く継続的な監視が必要なためWATCHとする。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による定期的なサーベイランス報告であり、前年比で症例数は減少傾向。年齢層・ワクチン接種状況・検査確定の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: West Bengal conducts filariasis drug drive in 10 districts, targets elimination by 2030
article.articleSummary: West Bengal launches a Mass Drug Administration (MDA) against lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis) in 10 districts with aim to eliminate by 2030. Free Diethylcarbamazine (DEC) and Albendazole are distributed to eligible residents across 59 blocks/municipalities in Kalimpong, Alipurduar, Jalpaiguri, Uttar Dinajpur, Murshidabad, Birbhum, Paschim Bardhaman, Purulia, Bankura and Howrah; coverage target is at least 85% of the eligible population, excluding children under two, pregnant women, and critically ill. As of 2026, West Bengal reports 30,371 lymphoedema and 5,804 hydrocele patients; 2025 saw 2,370 hydrocele surgeries. Infections often remain asymptomatic for six to eight years but are transmitted via mosquitoes; diagnostic tests are reportedly possible only after 10 p.m. Officials emphasize awareness and Centre–state policy alignment. India accounts for ~40% of the global burden, with about 21.72 crore at risk across 348 districts in 20 States/UTs.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州、フィラリア症撲滅に向け10県で投薬キャンペーンを実施、2030年までの根絶を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病に対する計画的な集団投薬(MDA)キャンペーンであり、新規発生や異常な流行を示すものではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: リンパ系フィラリア症は蚊媒介の慢性疾患で、インドは既存の国家プログラム(NFEP)の下で2030年根絶目標に向けた定例的なMDAを実施している。新規アウトブレイクではなく既存の公衆衛生対策の一環。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva a 648 el número de muertos y a 1.830 los casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises the death toll to 648 and the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 1,830.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 648 deaths and 1,830 confirmed Ebola cases since the outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The case fatality rate is 35.4%, with 780 hospitalized and 285 recovered; the outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine exists. South Kivu has recorded 42 consecutive days without new cases, meeting WHO criteria to end the outbreak in that region. Nevertheless, cross-border spread has reached Uganda with 20 infections. The World Health Organization designates the event as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) and notes it ranks as the third-worst Ebola outbreak in history to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者648人、確定症例1,830人に増加
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICに指定した大規模エボラ流行で、致死率35.4%、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOがPHEICと宣言し、史上3番目に深刻なエボラ流行と位置付けられている点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: Confirman contagio de ciudadano estadounidense con ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American citizen infected with Ebola confirmed in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola has been confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient, employed by an international humanitarian organization operating in Congo, tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant. US CDC is coordinating an urgent medical response with the employer, other federal agencies, and local and international partners to ensure care. Measures include identifying and isolating close contacts at higher risk and implementing precautions to curb transmission. The Bundibugyo outbreak is currently affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, per CDC and WHO. The Congolese government reports up to Friday 648 deaths and 1,830 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスに感染した米国人が確認される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行（648名死亡、1830症例確認）が米国人職員にも感染し、ウガンダにも拡大している国際的公衆衛生事象であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国とウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが、米国は対象国リスト外、ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。CDCとWHOが対応にあたっており、既にフルRRAの対象となる重大な国際感染症イベントである。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. citizen working for humanitarian organization in Congo tests positive for Ebola, CDC says
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola virus infection in a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo, with the CDC coordinating to identify close contacts and curb transmission alongside the employer, U.S. agencies, public health authorities, and Congolese partners. The Congo outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has no approved vaccine or treatment and is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in Africa, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths; cases have also been reported in Uganda. Earlier, an American doctor infected in Congo recovered after treatment in Germany and returned to the U.S. in June. The outbreak was declared May 15. Clinical trials for a treatment began last week. Ongoing eastern Congo conflict spurs displacement, mistrust, attacks on health centers, and PPE shortages, hampering the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで人道支援団体に勤務する米国人がエボラ陽性、CDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)アウトブレイクは1,830症例・648死亡に達し、アフリカで最も急速に拡大している事例。米国人の感染確認、ウガンダへの拡大、ワクチン・治療法未承認、紛争による対応困難などIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たし、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国・ウガンダ・ドイツでの症例報告があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが主要な発生地域として確認される。ワクチン・治療法未承認、致死率約35%（648/1830）、東部コンゴの紛争が対応を阻害している点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: ARTE Journal - 11/07/2026 - La propagation du virus Ebola s'accélère en RDC - Regarder l'émission complète
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ARTE Journal - 11/07/2026 - The spread of the Ebola virus is accelerating in the DRC - Watch the full program
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating, with new foci identified in the eastern region. Authorities say they are acting with force against the Ebola epidemic. Since mid-May 2026, 625 people have died from Ebola in the DRC, indicating expanding transmission and a growing outbreak in eastern provinces. The briefing notes that there are no details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or clinical outcomes. There is no information on imported or exported cases. The report underscores escalating spread and the need for intensified control measures in the eastern DRC as of July 11, 2026, according to ARTE Journal.

triage.headline_ja: ARTEジャーナル - 2026年7月11日 - コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの感染拡大が加速
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR附属書2の即時通知対象疾患であり、DRC東部での感染拡大加速と多数の死者(625人)報告があるため、重篤性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの観点からフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 検査確認、感染源、臨床転帰、輸入・輸出症例に関する詳細情報は記事中に記載なし。続報でのラボ確認情報等の追跡が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo has tested positive for Ebola, with the CDC coordinating with the employer, US agencies, public health authorities, and Congolese partners to prevent transmission and identify close contacts. Africa CDC says the Congo outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on the continent, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths; cases have also been confirmed in Uganda. Earlier this week, an American doctor in Congo tested positive and was transferred to Germany for treatment. Plans to relocate exposed Americans to a facility in Kenya were suspended after a Kenyan court order. Congolese authorities declared a fresh outbreak on May 15; the WHO notes the virus had been transmitting for weeks without official detection. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. Containment is hampered by a funding gap, attacks on health centers, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict; treatment trials began last week.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がコンゴでエボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでの急速に拡大するエボラ流行（1,830症例、648死亡）で米国人・ウガンダへの感染確認、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョウイルス株であり、国際的拡大と渡航関連リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例確認は記事に記載されているが、記事の主題はコンゴでの流行であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。米国・ドイツ・ケニアは渡航関連の記述のみで発生国ではない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョウイルス株であり、資金不足・医療施設への攻撃・紛争により封じ込めが困難な状況。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Filipina Laporkan Wabah Flu Burung H5N1 di Unggas Rumahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Philippines Reports H5N1 Avian Influenza Outbreak in Backyard Poultry
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza has been detected in a backyard poultry flock in Capalan, Oriental Mindoro, Philippines. The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) reported the finding on Friday, July 10. The flock, comprising 39 birds, was culled to prevent further spread to other farms and areas. Philippine authorities are actively monitoring Oriental Mindoro to prevent geographic expansion and to safeguard the poultry industry. H5N1 is a highly pathogenic influenza A virus that can cause rapid mortality in birds; the report notes the virus has killed millions of poultry globally in recent years, disrupting food supplies and raising poultry prices. In outbreaks, responses typically include culling and strict surveillance of affected zones to minimize transmission. Authorities continue to monitor the situation and implement control measures as needed.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン、家禽（裏庭飼育）でH5N1鳥インフルエンザの発生を報告
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（裏庭飼育、39羽）でのH5N1発生であり、人間感染の報告はなく、殺処分等の対応済みで規模も限定的だが、H5N1は継続監視が必要な病原体であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 人間への感染報告はなく、影響カテゴリも動物のみ。フィリピン当局とWOAHが監視・対応中で、感染拡大防止のため殺処分済み。人畜共通感染症であるH5N1は継続的なモニタリング対象。

article.articleHeadline: Sobe para 648 o número de mortos por Ébola na RDC - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the DRC rises to 648 - O País - The truth as news
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports 648 Ebola deaths and 1,830 confirmed cases per the latest health ministry update, reflecting 23 new deaths and 38 new infections since the last balance. Case fatality is 35.4%. Approximately 780 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation, with 285 recoveries. Contact tracing coverage stands at 78.1% of contacts, aimed at interrupting transmission. The outbreak is concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; in South Kivu, authorities note 42 consecutive days without new confirmed cases, a WHO criterion for declaring transmission-free in a region. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the third-largest in history, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak and the 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の死者数が648人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者・感染者数が継続的に増加しており、致死率も高く、史上3番目の規模の流行であるため公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストになく、記事本文でも言及なし。南キブ州では42日間新規症例なしとの朗報もあるが、全体では死者・感染者が増加傾向にあり注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: تدابير للوقاية من فيروس إنفلونزا هونغ كونغ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measures to prevent infection with the Hong Kong influenza virus.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong influenza virus outbreak in Bali, Indonesia, among expatriates and tourists including Russians, is discussed by Russian virologist Victoria Shirbakova. It is not a new strain but part of the seasonal influenza A cycle, subtype known. High humidity, heat, population density, and ongoing tourism and travel in Asia are cited as factors enabling transmission. Emphasizes adherence to standard preventive measures; incubation can be relatively long; viruses may survive on steel/plastic for days and up to 24 hours on cardboard; aerosols can linger in enclosed spaces for 15–30 minutes. Early treatment is critical because the influenza virus is RNA-based with a replication cycle ~10 hours, and delays permit large viral replication. Antivirals Favipiravir and Molnupiravir inhibit RNA-dependent RNA polymerase, helping curb spread. Supportive care includes antipyretics, decongestants, cough suppressants, fluids, rest, and avoiding exertion.

triage.headline_ja: 香港インフルエンザウイルス感染予防対策
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA型の一部であり新規株ではないと明記されており、通常の予防措置対応が可能なため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人専門家によるバリ島（インドネシア）での『香港インフルエンザ』流行に関する解説記事で、季節性インフルエンザAサイクルの一部であり新規株ではないと明言されている。香港・中国・ロシアはコメント元・言及国であり発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 6月全國新冠病毒新增確診7.9萬例 其中重症病例130例、死亡1例 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In June, nationwide newly confirmed COVID-19 cases totaled 79,000, of which 130 were severe and 1 person died.
article.articleSummary: China's Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported June COVID-19 activity: 79,000 new infections nationwide across 31 provinces and Xinjiang, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (due to underlying disease). All 3,741 local genome sequences from June 1–30 were Omicron, dominated by NB.1.8.1 and its sublineages; no new variant signaled higher risk. Beijing You An Hospital's Li Tongzeng said cases rose as population immunity wanes; summer indoor cooling and reduced ventilation aid transmission. Symptoms are mostly mild upper-respiratory: fever, sore throat, cough, runny nose; some diarrhea; pneumonia and severe disease remain uncommon. High-risk groups (elderly, chronic disease, immunocompromised) should seek care early and receive antiviral therapy after diagnosis if symptoms occur. From June 29–July 5, ARI surveillance showed activity of influenza, rhinovirus, enterovirus, parainfluenza, and human metapneumovirus; influenza low overall, B-type predominant in the south; rhinovirus down, enterovirus up. Emphasize masking and ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の全国新型コロナウイルス新規感染確認7.9万例、うち重症例130例・死亡1例
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な増加を伝える定例のサーベイランス報告であり、新規変異株の出現や重症化率の上昇など異常な兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性の呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告。新変異株による高リスクの兆候なしと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Ebola Accelerates; U.N. Adopts Landmark NTD Resolution
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates: as of July 9, 2026, 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths (case fatality 34.1%); 764 patients in isolation or hospital treatment. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. Five provinces are affected; Kisangani, capital of Tshopo, reports a new suspected case with no link to Ituri, signaling a possible separate transmission chain. Response funding includes CERF $60 million and World Bank $46 million; diagnostics expansion with 10 Radi-One platforms and 40,000 tests, plus 94 platforms and 30,000 tests forthcoming. Frontline Ebola workers in Ituri protested unpaid wages. Bunia airport closure disrupts response. U.N. HR Council adopted Resolution 62/27 on Neglected Tropical Diseases, sponsored by Malawi, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Kenya, Morocco and Tanzania, directing OHCHR to report on human rights aspects by 2027. HIV infections rise 77% in North Africa and the Middle East (2010–2025), regional prevalence ~0.1%.

triage.headline_ja: 週間保健アップデート | エボラ感染拡大が加速；国連が顧みられない熱帯病に関する画期的決議を採択
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが加速し、致死率34.1%、5州に拡大、ウガンダにも波及し、キサンガニでは別系統の感染連鎖が疑われるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告(20例・2死亡)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ガンビア、ブルキナファソ、ケニア、モロッコ、マラウイ、タンザニアはNTD決議のスポンサー国として言及されているのみで、当該疾患の発生国ではないため除外した。Bunia空港閉鎖は対応活動の障害であり、正式な渡航・貿易制限措置とは異なるため travel_trade_restriction は不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Rajesh Sharma Hospitalised After Alleged Insect Bite: Here's When An Infection Becomes Serious
article.articleSummary: Rajesh Sharma, veteran Bollywood and Bengali actor, was hospitalised after a severe infection following an insect bite during the shoot of a Prabhas film.
