The bite was initially dismissed as minor, but within hours he developed intense leg pain and, on returning to Kolkata, a high fever led to hospital admission. The article notes that most insect bites from mosquitoes, ants, bees or other insects cause only temporary discomfort, but bacteria entering the wound or bites from venomous insects or spiders can trigger serious infections. Warning signs include increasing redness, swelling, persistent pain, pus, fever, red streaks, swollen lymph nodes, chills, or rapidly worsening swelling; breathing difficulty or facial swelling may indicate a severe allergic reaction requiring emergency care. Preventive steps include washing the area with soap and water and avoiding scratching; doctors may prescribe antibiotic creams or oral medications as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 俳優ラジェシュ・シャルマ、虫刺されによる感染症で入院――感染症が重症化するタイミングとは
triage.triage_reason: 特定個人（俳優）の虫刺され後の感染症に関する一般的健康情報記事であり、公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクや異常事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 個人の医療事例であり感染症アウトブレイクではないため、対象国リストに該当する公衆衛生イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak still spreading largely undetected, WHO says
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread largely undetected, according to WHO. In parts of the DRC, four of every five new Ebola cases have no known link to existing patients, indicating substantial hidden transmission. The WHO warns that the true scale of the outbreak could be two to four times larger than official data suggest. The report highlights surveillance gaps and the challenge of identifying transmission chains. No specific case counts or death totals are provided in the article. This underscores the risk of ongoing community spread and the urgency of strengthening surveillance. Published July 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行、依然として大部分が探知されずに拡大していると WHO が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで検知されないまま拡大しており、サーベイランスの不備とヒトーヒト感染の継続が示唆されるため、IHR・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。WHOは実際の規模が公式データの2〜4倍である可能性を指摘しており、サーベイランス強化の緊急性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: إصابة مواطن أمريكي ثانٍ بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو في ظل تفشٍ قاتل للمرض - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second American citizen infected with the Ebola virus in the Congo amid a deadly outbreak of the disease - Al-Shorouk Gate
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, a second American citizen infected with Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid a severe outbreak. The patient, working for a humanitarian organization in the DRC, tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, which is spreading rapidly in the region, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in Atlanta. The CDC is supporting contact tracing and risk assessment in coordination with the humanitarian NGO, Congolese health authorities, and partners to curb further transmission. Ebola is a life-threatening viral disease transmitted by direct contact and exposure to body fluids. The Congolese government reports 1,830 laboratory-confirmed cases since the latest outbreak began in May, with 648 deaths. No patient details, symptoms, or infection source beyond this are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの致命的なエボラ流行の中、米国市民2人目がエボラウイルスに感染 - アル・シュルーク・ゲート
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（1,830例確認、648人死亡）に加え、米国人感染者が2人目確認されたことで国際的拡大の懸念が強く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 米国やアトランタ（CDC所在地）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。感染源となっているのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Un deuxième travailleur humanitaire états-unien infecté par Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - A second American humanitarian worker infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control, with 1,830 laboratory-confirmed cases and 648 deaths to date. Two notable imported/exported cases have appeared in Europe: an American physician working for a humanitarian NGO who was transferred to Germany for care and has since recovered; and a French physician affiliated with an NGO operating in Congo who boarded in Kinshasa, developed illness mid-flight to Europe, and has also recovered. The outbreak's earliest reports date to mid-May, and by late June Europe saw its first cases, with no subsequent European cases. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo variant involved, though clinical trials for two treatments targeting this rare variant began last week. Ongoing control is hampered by regional insecurity and a strike by Congolese humanitarian workers demanding pay and better conditions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - 米国人人道支援活動家2人目がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で制御不能なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1,830症例、648死亡）が継続しており、欧州への複数の輸出症例が発生。国際的拡大とワクチン・治療法の欠如という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクはBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによるもので、ワクチン・特異的治療法が現時点で存在しない稀な変異株。地域の治安不安とコンゴ人道支援職員のストライキが対応を妨げている。米国・ドイツ・フランスは輸出症例の発生地であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis: The monsoon disease we often mistake for a common fever
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis is a bacterial infection spread by floodwater contaminated with animal urine, causing 59,000 deaths and about 1,000,000 cases worldwide, with a case fatality around 6.85%. Transmission occurs when broken skin or mucous membranes contact contaminated water or soil during monsoon floods. Symptoms resemble other febrile illnesses: fever, headache, muscle pain, so about 90% recover with mild illness, while ~10% develop kidney injury, liver damage, or pulmonary haemorrhage. Diagnosis relies on blood culture (gold standard) early in illness, PCR for early detection, and antibody tests (reliable 6–10 days after onset) but access is limited in resource-poor settings. No human vaccine; prevention focuses on avoiding floodwater and doxycycline prophylaxis for high-risk workers. Climate-change-driven monsoon volatility may intensify transmission. In India, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu account for >85% of annual cases; Mumbai saw outbreaks after heavy rainfall, with 2005 reports of ~1,800 cases and ~10% CFR. 2018–2020 data show fluctuations in Mumbai.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症：一般的な発熱と間違われやすいモンスーン病
triage.triage_reason: 季節性疾患に関する一般的解説記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、過去データや疫学的背景の紹介にとどまるため。
triage.notes: 本記事はレプトスピラ症の一般啓発記事であり、マハーラーシュトラ州・タミルナードゥ州・ムンバイの過去の流行データを引用しているが、直近の新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : interdiction temporaire des rassemblements de masse pour prévenir la propagation d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: temporary ban on mass gatherings to prevent the spread of Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo: The province of Tshopo has imposed a temporary ban on all mass gatherings in venues to curb the spread of Ebola Virus Disease. The measure, announced by Governor Paulin Lendongolia, reflects the need to protect health and prevent introduction and propagation of Ebola across the province, following outbreak declarations in Ituri and North Kivu and aligned with guidance from the Ministry of Public Health and the WHO. The decision follows laboratory confirmation in Kisangani of samples from bodies repatriated from Nia-Nia health zone in Ituri, a border area with Tshopo, underscoring cross-border transmission risk amid ongoing movement and trade. Implementation is assigned to security and local authorities, including Kisangani's mayor and commune leaders. Tshopo currently has two Ebola patients treated at the epidemic treatment center at Cinquantenaire Hospital, Kisangani, per Health Minister Dr Simon Bokongo.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州:エボラ拡散防止のため大規模集会を一時禁止 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の複数州（イツリ、北キブ、ツショポ）への拡大が確認され、国境を越えた感染伝播リスクと公衆衛生対応（集会禁止令）が実施されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 既知のDRCエボラアウトブレイク（イツリ、北キブ）がツショポ州へ拡大している事案。ツショポ州キサンガニでの検査確認例（イツリのニアニア保健地区からの遺体搬送者）があり、国境を越えた伝播が懸念される。既存のRRA対象アウトブレイクの続報として重要度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : les déplacés de Vube et Wamba appelés à la vigilance contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele: the displaced from Vube and Wamba urged to be vigilant against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Upper Uele, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, faced an Ebola virus disease alert as authorities sensitize about 4,079 displaced people—490 households in Wamba territory and 300 households at the Vube site in Mayogo-Magbai chiefdom. On July 11, 2026, officials announced the Ebola outbreak and urged vigilance and strict adherence to infection-prevention measures. Residents were advised to avoid gatherings and regularly wash hands, with facilities to be installed to support protection of themselves and others. Displaced populations received relief items including rice, sugar, vegetable oil, soap, mattresses and clothing; Vube hosts a prepared site, while Wamba district lacks a dedicated camp. The mobilization followed security attacks by the ADF, underscoring concurrent health and safety risks in Haut-Uélé.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州:ヴベとワンバの避難民、エボラへの警戒を呼びかけられる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部でエボラ出血熱の発生が確認され、避難民集団という脆弱な人口集団への感染拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ADFによる治安攻撃と重なり避難民が多数発生している地域でのエボラ警戒情報。感染確定症例数や致死率など詳細な疫学情報は記事に記載されておらず、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : inauguration d'un nouveau centre de traitement contenant 56 lits - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: inauguration of a new treatment center housing 56 beds - ACP
article.articleSummary: 56-bed Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) and a dedicated Ebola transit center, located at the Kigonze IDP camp site in Bunia, Ituri, in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, were inaugurated by the Health Minister to bolster patient care for Ebola cases. Constructed with support from International Medical Corps, the facilities are part of a province-wide strategy to expand capacity to respond to the outbreak. The government aims to raise the province’s total Ebola treatment bed capacity to more than 400 beds. Additional ETCs are planned or under construction in the Nizi health zone, the Lopa health area, and Lita, to improve coverage and management of patients across Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ:56床を備えた新治療センターの開設 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエボラアウトブレイクに対する治療能力拡大の報道であり、新規発生や急激な状況変化を示すものではないが、進行中のアウトブレイクとして継続注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラアウトブレイクへの対応として治療センター拡充を報じるもので、新規感染事例数や致死率など疫学的詳細は記載されていない。ルーマニアの地名（Cluj, Lita）は地理的誤認識と考えられ、実際の発生地はDRCイツリ州のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola cases surpass 1,800 as outbreak spreads to fourth province
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 1,800 confirmed cases, totaling 1,830 with 648 deaths as of 2026-07-11. Of those, 780 patients are in treatment and 284 have recovered since the outbreak began on May 15. The virus has spread to a fourth province, Haut-Uele, after seven fatal cases were recorded in the Wamba health zone; previous activity is concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. International donors pledged about $910 million to support response efforts in the DRC and neighboring Uganda, which has 20 cases. Africa CDC has deployed multidisciplinary teams to priority zones representing about 83% of cases under a decentralized strategy. The WHO classified the Bundibugyo Ebola strain as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, underscoring the need for rapid detection, community surveillance, and timely financing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、感染者数1,800人を超え、発生地域が4州目に拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC宣言済みのエボラ出血熱がDRCで4州目に拡大し、死者648人・感染者1,830人に達しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダにも20例の感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはこのエボラ株（Bundibugyo株）を2026年5月17日にPHEICに指定済み。

article.articleHeadline: Minister Directs Strict COVID-19 Control Measures in Kadapa
article.articleSummary: Kadapa district in-charge minister S. Savitha directed authorities to intensify COVID-19 control after eight confirmed cases and two deaths. No new cases were reported beyond the eight, with samples sent to a Pune laboratory to identify the variant and its characteristics. Officials were told to enforce masks in crowded places and hospitals and to boost public awareness of prevention. People with fever and cough should be identified and moved to isolation wards without delay. Sanitation drives and bleaching powder spraying were carried out as precautions. The district collector and DMHO said family members of infected persons should be tested; positives shifted to isolation wards, negatives kept in home isolation for a few days. Ensure adequate medical care in isolation wards and maintain vaccine stocks to meet any rise.

triage.headline_ja: カダパ県担当大臣、COVID-19対策の厳格な実施を指示
triage.triage_reason: インド・アンドラプラデシュ州カダパ県で8例・2死亡の小規模クラスターが報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、地元行政のみで対応可能な状況であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方当局が隔離・検体検査・マスク着用強化などの対策を実施中。国際的な支援要請や渡航制限の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova novo medicamento infantil contra a doença de Chagas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa Approves New Pediatric Drug for Chagas Disease.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa approved Lampit (nifurtimox) for treating Chagas disease in children and adolescents up to 17 years, with newborns weighing at least 2.5 kg eligible. This expands treatment options against Trypanosoma cruzi infection in Brazil. In Pará state, a surge of acute Chagas was reported in 2026, notably in Ananindeua; January–March 2026 confirmed 52 cases and five deaths. Transmission is linked to contaminated foods, especially açaí. Lampit is an antiparasitic against T. cruzi, disrupting parasite survival. Transmission routes include the feces of infected triatomine bugs, contaminated foods, blood transfusions, organ transplants, and mother-to-child during pregnancy or birth. Chagas infection has acute and chronic phases; chronic disease can cause severe heart and digestive complications years later. Pediatric approval should broaden early treatment access and reduce progression risk, particularly for infants diagnosed early.

triage.headline_ja: アンヴィザ（ブラジル衛生当局）、シャーガス病治療の新しい小児用医薬品を承認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パラ州で2026年1〜3月に急性シャーガス病52例・死亡5例が報告され、汚染食品（アサイー）による感染拡大が示唆されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は主に小児用シャーガス病治療薬の承認について報じているが、パラ州での急性シャーガス病の急増（アサイーなど汚染食品による経口感染）が言及されており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cambia tendencia en República Dominicana y casos superan registros de 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue shifts trend in the Dominican Republic, with cases surpassing 2025 records.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in the Dominican Republic reverses a downward trend, with 153 confirmed cases by June 27, 2026—two more than in the same period in 2025. Across the Americas, suspected dengue cases exceed 1.2 million (week 22, 2026), with 337,014 lab-confirmed (about 27%). In DR, 35 cases were confirmed in weeks 22–25, the 10–19 age group most affected and males predominate; DENV-2 is the most frequent serotype. Regional context: 2,294 severe dengue cases and 305 deaths (case fatality 0.025%). Week 22 alone saw 33,405 suspected across 17 countries; 9,249 confirmed, 62 severe, 5 deaths (0.015% fatality). Centroamérica and Mexico reported 1,747 suspected; Costa Rica up 74%. Fifteen countries report circulating dengue serotypes; Brazil, Mexico, and Venezuela report all four serotypes. The Dominican Republic’s shift warrants ongoing epidemiological monitoring, especially among adolescents and young adults.

triage.headline_ja: ドミニカ共和国でデング熱の傾向が転換、症例数が2025年の記録を上回る
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域における季節性・地域流行性感染症であり、症例数増加も既存のサーベイランス範囲内の変動と考えられ、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はドミニカ共和国におけるデング熱の流行傾向であり、対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル・メキシコ・ベネズエラは血清型多様性の地域文脈として言及されているのみで、主要な発生事象としては扱われていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Nia-Nia : les jeunes d'une localité appellent au retour des équipes de riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nia-Nia: Local youths call for the return of rapid response teams - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Nia-Nia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Youths from Bafwabango apologized to health authorities after vandalizing the PK51 Ebola Treatment Center and threatening response teams, requesting the return of rapid-response operations. Despite the center’s closure, response activities continue in Nia-Nia with 26 confirmed Ebola cases in Nia-Nia and 9 in neighboring Wamba, for a total of 35 confirmed cases. Dr. Joseph Pemanakue, medical chief of Nia-Nia health zone, stressed protecting the population through risk communication, surveillance, and patient care, urging community collaboration, rapid reporting of suspected cases, acceptance of preventive measures, and support for field teams to break transmission. The June 30, 2026 violence followed a surge in community deaths (about 15 per day). The youths now call for the return of response teams and health personnel to resume full patient management.

triage.headline_ja: ニア・ニアのエボラ出血熱：地元の若者たちが対応チームの復帰を要請 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で確認35例のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、地域住民の暴力行為により対応活動が一時中断するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: コミュニティによる治療センターの破壊・対応チームへの脅迫が発生していたが、住民側が謝罪し対応チームの復帰を要請している。地域社会の協力確保が今後の感染制御の鍵となる。6月30日以前は1日約15人の死亡が報告されており、severity・prolonged_exposureともに高い懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: السلطات الصحية في الكونغو الديمقراطية تعلن ارتفاع حصيلة ضحايا "إيبولا" إلى 648 وفاة | أهل مصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo announce that the Ebola death toll has risen to 648 | Ahl Masr
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report 648 Ebola-related deaths and 1,830 confirmed cases, updated to include the latest 24 hours of data. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or definitively approved treatment. National teams, with support from the World Health Organization, are expanding epidemiological investigations and contact tracing, while hospital capacity for treatment centers nears 90% occupancy, stressing the health system. International and WHO warnings suggest the true scale may exceed official tallies due to security and logistical challenges in the outbreak zones, especially Ituri and North Kivu provinces. Security gaps hinder access for medical teams, and migration around mining areas may accelerate transmission, prompting continued calls for intensified health and logistical support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の保健当局、エボラ出血熱による死者数が648人に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者648名・症例1,830例という大規模アウトブレイクであり、治療体制の逼迫、ワクチン未承認株、治安面での対応困難など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株によるアウトブレイクで、治療センターの病床使用率が約90%に達し医療体制が逼迫。イツリ州・北キブ州における治安・アクセス問題により実際の規模は公式集計を上回る可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Američan pracujúci v KDR bol pozitívne testovaný na ebolu - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American working in North Korea tested positive for Ebola - SME World
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive for Ebola, with the CDC coordinating with the employee's employer, U.S. authorities, public health agencies, and Congolese partners to prevent further transmission and identify close contacts; no additional details released. Africa CDC says the outbreak in DRC is the fastest-spreading, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, and cases also confirmed in neighboring Uganda. Earlier in the outbreak, an American doctor in DRC tested positive and was transported to Germany for treatment. U.S. plans to move exposed Americans to a Kenyan quarantine facility were halted by a Kenyan court order. The outbreak is concentrated mainly in Ituri Province, with activity in Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists; existing vaccines target Zaire ebolavirus. Two drugs entered clinical trials against Bundibugyo last week.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で活動していたアメリカ人人道支援者がエボラ陽性 - SME World
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(Bundibugyo種)アウトブレイクが1,830例・648死亡と拡大し、ウガンダへの越境や米国人感染者の発生など国際的拡大の兆候があり、ワクチン未整備の異常事態であるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクはBundibugyoエボラウイルスによるもので、既存のZaireエボラ用ワクチンが効かないため対応が困難。ウガンダやドイツ、ケニアへの越境事例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ciudadano estadounidense da positivo a ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Ebola virus, according to the U.S. CDC, as the country fights to contain an outbreak that continues to expand. The CDC says it is coordinating with the patient’s employer, U.S. government agencies, health authorities, and Congolese partners to prevent further transmission and identify close contacts. The agency offered no additional details about the case. The ongoing outbreak in the DRC requires vigilant surveillance, rapid isolation, contact tracing, and infection-control measures to curb spread. No information on symptoms, onset date, exposure source, or travel history was disclosed. Public health authorities emphasize tracing contacts and standard precautions to prevent further transmission. As of July 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでアメリカ人がエボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当する重大疾患であり、拡大中のアウトブレイクの中で外国人(米国人)感染者が確認されたことは国際的拡大リスクを示す。
triage.notes: 米国はリスト対象国外のため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCでの継続的なエボラアウトブレイクの拡大を示す事例であり、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: US citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo; the CDC is coordinating with the person’s employer, US agencies, public health authorities and Congolese partners to prevent transmission and identify close contacts. Africa CDC says the Congo outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on the continent, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, and cases in neighboring Uganda. In the first week, an American doctor in Congo tested positive and was transferred to Germany for treatment. U.S. officials discussed exporting exposed Americans to a Kenyan facility, but the plan was suspended by a Kenyan court order. Congolese authorities declared a fresh outbreak on May 15 after transmission began weeks prior without detection, per the WHO. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved vaccine or treatment, and is hampered by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and eastern Congo conflict. Last week, treatment trials began.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がコンゴでエボラ陽性反応 - アフリカ - 世界
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で急速拡大中の大規模エボラ流行（確定1,830例・死亡648例）に加え、米国人感染者の発生や国際搬送事例があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツ・ケニア・ウガンダは記事に登場するが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。主たる発生地はコンゴ民主共和国であり、ウガンダは二次的言及にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: 美国公民在刚果金感染埃博拉病毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. citizen infected with Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On July 10, the U.S. CDC confirmed a U.S. citizen humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus. The patient is cooperating with employers and partners to prevent further transmission; contact tracing is under way, with no additional symptoms disclosed. Africa CDC reports this as Africa’s fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, with DR Congo reporting 1,830 cases and 648 deaths; Uganda has cases as well. The CDC notes no cases in the United States and a low risk to Americans and travelers. In May, American missionary Dr. Peter Stafford contracted Ebola in DRC and recovered after evacuation to Berlin; his wife and four children were monitored. WHO says the outbreak spread covertly for weeks before detection; Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The U.S. has requested $1.4 billion for response; ongoing eastern DRC conflict fuels displacement, distrust, and PPE shortages. Last month, a humanitarian worker returning from DRC to France was diagnosed with Ebola, France’s first case.

triage.headline_ja: 米国市民がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、DRCでアフリカ史上最速の流行が拡大中で国際的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States, France, Germany, Bundibugyo(Uganda)が含まれるが、これらは渡航者の感染確認地・治療地であり流行発生国ではないため除外。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスであり、東部DRCの紛争が対応を困難にしている点は要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Over 25 jaundice cases reported in Kangra's Bharwana area - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Over 25 jaundice (hepatitis) cases reported in Bhawarna and adjoining Sulah Assembly constituency, Kangra district, Himachal Pradesh, including a significant number of schoolchildren, as of 11 July 2026. Preliminary assessment points to contaminated drinking water as the likely source; water samples are being tested in coordination with the Jal Shakti Department, with authorities planning regular testing, chlorination, and provision of safe potable water. Medical teams have been deployed for continuous monitoring and treatment. Block Medical Officer Dr Naveen Rana said monsoon-season jaundice cases are not unusual, but the surge warrants urgent response, medical camps, and a transparent investigation with findings released to the public. BJP MLA Vipin Singh Parmar urged multi-department action, accountability, and safeguards, including boiled-water advisories for residents.

triage.headline_ja: カングラ郡バルワナ地域で黄疸(肝炎)患者25人以上を報告
triage.triage_reason: インド・ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州の一地域で水系感染による黄疸(A型肝炎疑い)が25例以上発生し学童も含まれるが、地元医師は季節性のものとしており重症度・国際拡大の情報は不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 地元医師は『モンスーン期の黄疸増加は珍しくない』と述べており、季節性の水系感染症の可能性が高い。地方政治家（BJP州議員）が透明性ある調査と対応を要求しており政治的関心はあるが、重症度・死亡者数・感染規模の全容は記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. citizen working for humanitarian organization in Congo tests positive for Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus infection detected in a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC); the individual has tested positive, with the CDC coordinating to prevent transmission and identify close contacts. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Globally, 1,830 confirmed cases have been reported in the DRC with 648 deaths; neighboring Uganda has also reported cases. Congolese authorities declared a fresh Ebola outbreak on May 15 after weeks of undetected transmission, per the World Health Organization. An American doctor contracted Ebola in the outbreak’s first week and was transferred to Germany for treatment. Containment is challenged by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict. Last week, clinical trials for treatment began.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで人道支援団体に勤務する米国人がエボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,830例・648人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ウガンダへの国際的拡大や米国人感染者のドイツ搬送も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 感染は主にDRCで発生。ウガンダでの症例報告や米国人・ドイツへの搬送は国際的拡大の証左だが、これら諸国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法未承認、資金不足、紛争地域での対応困難など管理可能性にも重大な懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Sporadic COVID-19 cases are here to stay, says official after two deaths
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths within 10 days in Andhra Pradesh prompt stepped-up surveillance and hospital readiness. The Kadapa district case involved a 43-year-old man from Kadapa who was admitted with bilateral pneumonia, fever and breathlessness; he died on July 7 after testing positive under Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome protocols. The Rajampeta case involved a 52-year-old man in Annamayya district admitted to CMC Vellore with lung infection, bilateral kidney disease, diabetes and hypertension; he died on June 28. Twenty-eight contacts were traced in Kadapa; three tests were positive, all asymptomatic and under home isolation. In response, the State Health Department formed a Rapid Response Team and a COVID-19 control room, earmarked 10-bed isolation wards, and ordered RT-PCR kits, Remdesivir, PPE and N95 masks. Officials say sporadic infections are to be expected; no panic or travel restrictions, while genome sequencing awaits results to identify the variant.

triage.headline_ja: 散発的なCOVID-19症例は今後も続くと当局者、2件の死亡を受けて発言
triage.triage_reason: 既知のCOVID-19による散発的な死亡例であり、当局も『パニックや渡航制限は不要』と明言。基礎疾患を有する高齢患者の重症化で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 接触者28名中3名陽性だが全員無症状で自宅隔離。地元保健当局は監視体制強化とRRT設置で対応しており、既存の公衆衛生体制内で管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola deja 625 muertos y mantiene en alerta sanitaria a la República Democrática del Congo | TN8.ni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Leaves 625 Dead and Keeps the Democratic Republic of the Congo on a Health Alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens: July 9 data show 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths (case fatality 34.1%), with 764 hospitalized or isolated and 295 recovered. Contact tracing stands at 78.6%, but must be strengthened to curb spread. Declared May 15, it centers in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri as main epicenter; two suspected cases in Tshopo raise concern for spread. The emergency has crossed borders to Uganda, which reports 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, is identified by WHO. WHO maintains the Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with ongoing pressure on health systems, over 100 healthcare workers infected, and intensified surveillance and hospital capacity expansion. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhages.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で625人死亡、衛生警戒態勢続く
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がPHEIC下で拡大し、ウガンダへの越境伝播、医療従事者100人超感染、致死率34.1%と重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOはPHEICを維持中であり、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株が原因。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया अपडेट: अब तक 93275 लोगों की जांच, 14 दिनों में मिले 1826 संक्रमित, पोटका-डुमरिया बने मलेरिया के हॉट स्पॉट - jamshedpur malaria outbreak 1826 cases in 14 days action taken
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria Update: So far 93,275 people tested, 1,826 infections detected in 14 days, Potka-Dumuria has become a malaria hotspot - jamshedpur malaria outbreak 1826 cases in 14 days action taken
article.articleSummary: Malaria and brain malaria (falciparum) surge in East Singhbhum, Jharkhand. Over the last 14 days, 1,826 new malaria infections were detected among 93,275 people tested. Brain malaria cases total 1,441; vivax 338. Block-wise, Potka records 634 cases, followed by Dumuria 421, Musabani 332, Ghatsila 199, and Patamda 100. Treatments are underway at MGM Medical College Hospital, Parsudih Sadar Hospital, and various PHCs. Civil Surgeon Dr. Sahir Pal has ordered disciplinary action for laxity: Patamda CHC Medical Officer Dr. R.K. Singh issued showcause; Potka ANMs Jyoti Kumari and Anjela Minj, and MTS Sunil Tirki also being disciplined. In Kadiyashahi village, Sahiya Lakshmi Sardar was removed from duty for neglecting malaria prevention activities. Authorities emphasize intensified control campaigns during this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア速報：これまでに93,275人を検査、14日間で1,826人の感染確認、ポトカ・ドゥムリアがマラリアのホットスポットに（ジャムシェドプル）
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州東シングブーム地区で脳性マラリアを含む感染急増が確認されているが、既知の風土病の地域的流行であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。重症例増加や当局の懲戒対応など注視すべき点はあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ジャールカンド州東シングブーム地区（ポトカ、ドゥムリア、ムサバニ、ガツィラ、パタムダ）に焦点を当てており、バングラデシュは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及がないため除外した。脳性マラリア(falciparum)1,441例、vivax338例と重症型が多い点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Free anti-leptospirosis drug offered in Manila
article.articleSummary: Manila city government offers free doxycycline at health centers for leptospirosis after floods tied to Typhoon Inday. Health centers are operating solely for leptospirosis-related services; regular check-ups are suspended. Symptoms include fever, body aches, vomiting, jaundice, and other serious complications if untreated. DOH reports a 1% rise in leptospirosis cases to 2,461 in the same period last year. With Typhoon Inday within the Philippine Area of Responsibility, heavy rains and possible flooding are expected; DOH warns of leptospirosis risk for those wading through floodwaters. If wading is unavoidable, wear boots and cover wounds with waterproof bandages. The public is urged to seek care at the nearest local government unit hospital if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: マニラで抗レプトスピラ症薬を無料提供
triage.triage_reason: 台風による洪水後のレプトスピラ症は例年発生する季節性事象であり、症例数増加も1%程度と限定的だが、感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 台風Indayによる洪水後の季節性レプトスピラ症流行で、マニラ市が無料薬剤提供などの対応を実施中。DOHによる症例数増加は前年同期比1%増(2,461件)と大きな異常はないが、洪水継続によるリスクが指摘されており今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Pradesh: RIMS Kadapa On Alert After Fresh Covid-19 Cases
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, five Covid-19 cases were confirmed on 9 July at Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) Kadapa in Andhra Pradesh. Hospitals segregated wards for Covid-19 patients; testing is mandatory for patients with Covid-like symptoms. State health department directed hospitals to strengthen preparedness and keep RT-PCR kits, PPE, masks, sanitisers, and essential Covid medicines ready at all times. In addition, three patients with Covid-like symptoms have been admitted to a special ward and are undergoing treatment. Officials call for maintaining adequate oxygen beds, ventilators, and ambulance facilities to handle any surge. The situation is described as under control, with public urged to remain cautious without panic.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州：RIMSカダパ、新規コロナ症例確認後に警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の少数症例（5例）が確認されたが、状況は制御下にあり、既知の疾患で通常の対応範囲内のため、シグナルとしての新規性・深刻性は低い。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、地域の医療機関が通常の予防的対応（病棟分離、検査強化）を行っている段階。状況は制御下と報告されており、パニックを避けるよう呼びかけている。

article.articleHeadline: Quatro estações da CPTM recebem ação de vacinação contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four CPTM train stations host measles vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Four CPTM train stations in São Paulo host an intensified measles vaccination campaign to broaden population protection and make immunization more accessible in high-traffic areas. The free vaccine is provided without appointment, with individuals required to present a photo ID to health teams. Locations: Comendador Ermelino, Itaim Paulista, São Miguel Paulista (Line 12-Safira), and Guaianases (Line 11-Coral). Campaign dates are Monday, July 13; Wednesday, July 15; and Friday, July 17, from 9:00 to 16:00 local time. Targeting commuters and local residents, the initiative aims to boost measles immunization coverage in the area. The report is dated 2026-07-11.

triage.headline_ja: CPTM鉄道4駅で麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の発生や症例報告ではなく、通常の予防接種キャンペーンに関する広報記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ市内の予防接種キャンペーンの案内であり、麻疹の流行や症例急増を示す内容ではないため、疾患発生地域としてのBrazilは対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: An American citizen infected with the Ebola virus in the DRC
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-11, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announced that a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo virus, a type of Ebola. Laboratory confirmation prompted immediate public health action. CDC is coordinating with the patient’s employing organization, other U.S. federal agencies, public health authorities in the DRC, and partners to prevent further transmission by conducting contact tracing and risk assessments to identify high-risk contacts. The response emphasizes health mobilization and reinforced coordination to prevent spread and to identify individuals who have had contact with the patient. No details on symptoms or additional cases are provided, but authorities are actively monitoring and managing risk within affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 米国籍市民がDRCでエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）はIHR上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な人の移動を伴う症例（米国人）が確認されたため国際的拡大リスクが高く、フルRRAが必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。CDCが関与し国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中であり、症例詳細（症状・追加感染者）は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Un nuevo brote de ébola pone en alerta a todo el mundo: ya supera los 1.800 casos en Congo y deja 648 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola outbreak puts the world on alert: it already exceeds 1,800 cases in the Congo and leaves 648 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, CFR 34.1%, as of July 11, 2026. There are 764 people currently in isolation or hospitalized; 295 recovered and discharged. Contact tracing reaches 78.6% in affected areas, a key measure to curb spread. The outbreak is described as one of the most significant in the country, highlighting ongoing transmission and the continued need for surveillance and public health interventions in affected zones. Authorities continue monitoring and responding to the outbreak as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラ出血熱の流行が世界に警戒をもたらす：コンゴで既に1,800人以上の感染者、648人の死者を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,830例・致死率34.1%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当し、国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率34.1%と非常に高く、1,800例を超える大規模流行。接触者追跡率78.6%で対応中だが、感染拡大が継続しており国際的な支援・監視が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Pelacakan Kontak Erat TB 100 Persen, Erlina Burhan Langkah Tepat Putus Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 100% TB Close Contact Tracing, Erlina Burhan: The Right Step to Stop Transmission
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's TB control shifts to 100% contact tracing of households and close contacts, endorsed by pulmonologist Dr. Erlina Burhan as a decisive step to curb transmission. The Ministry of Health will expand tracing using the Free Health Check Program, portable chest X-ray, and optimized rapid testing to reach undiagnosed cases. Burhan highlights a large gap between estimated TB burden and detected cases: about 1.09 million estimated versus around 850,000 notified. As of 2024, Indonesia accounted for roughly 10% of global TB, with an estimated 1.08 million people ill and about 126,000 deaths. The policy aims to accelerate case finding and treatment, reducing incidence by targeting transmission sources in the surrounding environment rather than focusing solely on diagnosed patients.

triage.headline_ja: TB濃厚接触者追跡100%、エルリナ・ブルハン医師「感染連鎖を断つ的確な一手」
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるTBに関する政策的取り組みの報道であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態ではないため、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: TBはインドネシアで既に高負荷の風土病であり、本記事は政府の対策強化（接触者追跡100%方針）を報じるもので、新規の異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Un nuevo brote de ébola pone en alerta a todo el mundo: ya supera los 1.800 casos en Congo y deja 648 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola outbreak puts the world on alert: it already surpasses 1,800 cases in Congo and leaves 648 dead.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths (case fatality rate 34.1%), marking one of the country’s most severe episodes. Currently, 764 people remain in isolation or hospitalized, with 295 recovered and discharged. Contact tracing covers 78.6% of contacts in affected areas. The outbreak is centered in eastern Ituri Province and North and South Kivu, with Ituri as the main transmission focus since the outbreak was declared on May 15; two cases in Tshopo Province are under investigation. Uganda has reported 20 cases, 15 imported from the DRC, and two deaths. The responsible strain is Bundibugyo Ebola, with an estimated CFR of 30–50%; no vaccine or specific treatment is authorized. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids. This is considered the third-worst Ebola outbreak and the seventeenth documented in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラ出血熱の流行が世界に警戒を呼びかける：コンゴでの感染者数は既に1,800人を超え、648人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,800人以上の感染者・648人の死亡者を伴う大規模なエボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事はDRCが主題であり、ウガンダは越境伝播の文脈で言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: المرض ينتشر بسرعة| إصابة مواطن أمريكي بـ إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The disease is spreading rapidly | An American citizen infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been infected with Ebola, confirmed by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). The agency is coordinating with the patient’s employer and Congolese and U.S. health authorities to trace contacts and prevent further transmission. The current outbreak in the DRC is the fastest growing in Africa, with 1,830 confirmed infections and 648 deaths reported in the DRC, and additional cases in Uganda. The outbreak began on May 15 and is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment; clinical trials for potential therapies have recently begun. Ongoing conflict in eastern DRC is worsening spread and hindering public health response. The infected American works for a humanitarian organization; further details were not disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: 病気が急速に拡大｜コンゴ民主共和国でアメリカ人がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大しており（1,830例、648死亡）、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ紛争地域での対応困難、国際的な人的移動（米国人感染者）も確認されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大も報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国人感染者については米国内での二次感染リスクは記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: J'khand: MGMMCH to probe outbreak as brain malaria toll reaches 10
article.articleSummary: Cerebral malaria outbreak in East Singhbhum district, Jharkhand, has killed 10, including 25-year-old Ritik Singh of Jadugora who died at MGMMCH after transfer from a private facility. Earlier deaths include six minors from Potka Block and individuals at Tata Main Hospital. The state health department has ordered MGMMCH to scientifically investigate the outbreak and its spread, with emphasis on Potka Block; civil surgeon Dr Sahir Pal issued show-cause notices to 11 doctors and an MTS, suspending Potka CHC in-charge Dr Rajni Mahakud and appointing Dr Sushanto Sheet as the new in-charge. An integrated report shows 1,731 malaria patients identified from 77,770 tested between June 29 and July 10: 1,361 brain malaria, 326 general malaria, 44 mixed. Potka logged 591 positives (515 brain, 64 general, 11 mixed); Dumaria 4.68% and Patamda 4.36% had the highest positivity. A total of 34 brain malaria cases were detected on Friday in Potka. Keywords: outbreak, outbreak investigation, Potka, brain malaria, Jharkhand.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州:MGMMCHが調査へ、脳マラリアの死者10人に
triage.triage_reason: ジャールカンド州で脳マラリアの集団発生により10人が死亡し、1,731人の感染が確認されるなど公衆衛生への影響が深刻で、行政による調査・懲戒処分が行われるなど異常性・社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 脳マラリアという通常のマラリアより重篤な病型の集団発生であり、州保健当局が科学的調査を指示、複数医師の停職・訓告処分が行われている点で異常性と行政の高い関心が確認される。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-11, a U.S. citizen employed by a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for the Ebola virus, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The case arises as Congo struggles to contain a swelling Ebola outbreak, with Kinshasa noted as the location. The CDC is coordinating with the individual’s employer, U.S. agencies, public health authorities, and Congolese partners to prevent further transmission and to identify close contacts. The CDC did not provide additional details about the case, including any information on symptoms, onset, or laboratory confirmation in this report. The update emphasizes ongoing containment efforts and the importance of collaboration among international partners in addressing the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 米国市民、コンゴでエボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の拡大するアウトブレイク下で米国人が感染し国際的な人的移動を伴う事案であり、公衆衛生上の深刻性・国際的拡大リスクの観点からフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。コンゴでのエボラアウトブレイクが主題であり、米国人感染者はその文脈で言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: تحت وطأة الخوف والحرارة... طواقم تتدرّب لمواجهة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Under the weight of fear and heat... crews train to confront Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak expands in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 1,700 confirmed infections and about 600 deaths in the outbreak area, a region marked by poverty and armed-group activity. Of the infections, 112 are among healthcare workers, with 35 HCW deaths. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is intensifying training for field teams in Nairobi to prepare for deployment to Bunia, the outbreak’s epicenter, or to neighboring countries. Ten health workers are receiving hands-on instruction on PPE use and outbreak response; MSF has trained roughly 100 staff so far and plans to host trainees from Kenya’s Ministry of Health and other NGOs. Dr. Diana Corbin notes proximity to the Congo border and the need for readiness. Training covers donning/doffing PPE, working in pairs, dehydration risk in heat, and psychological stress, plus community engagement to encourage isolation and testing and to dispel myths. There is “no room for error” in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: 恐怖と暑さの中で...エボラ対応に向け医療チームが訓練
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部で1700人超の感染・約600人の死亡、医療従事者112人感染（35人死亡）という深刻なエボラ流行が拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的な支援体制（MSFによる訓練・周辺国への展開準備）が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ナイロビでのMSFトレーニング活動を主に描写しているが、実際の流行地はDRC北東部（ブニア）であるため、対象国としてDRCのみを採用。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Iguatama orienta moradores sobre dengue e prevenção de acidentes com escorpiões
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Iguatama guides residents on dengue fever and prevention of scorpion stings.
article.articleSummary: Endemias team in Iguatama conducts ongoing dengue fever prevention and scorpion sting risk reduction across schools, neighborhoods, and homes. In schools, activities use child-friendly prevention information; students observe larvae under microscopes, receive educational materials, and learn to identify conditions favorable to mosquitoes and venomous animals. The program bridges school activities with family health practices. Emphasis on eliminating standing water in containers and keeping environments clean is highlighted. During home visits, agents inspect properties, check water storage tanks (caixa d'água), identify potential mosquito breeding sites, and remove materials that can collect water, with daily guidance provided to residents. Recommendations include keeping water tanks covered, eliminating standing-water containers, maintaining clean yards, and taking measures to deter scorpions from homes. Community involvement complements the Endemias work, with regular home checks reducing health risks. Source: Prefeitura de Iguatama, 11 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: イグアタマ、デング熱とサソリ刺傷事故予防について住民に啓発
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発活動に関する記事であり、症例数の急増や異常な公衆衛生事象を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（Endemias team）による定例的なデング熱予防・環境衛生活動の紹介記事であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 2nd U.S. citizen contracts Ebola amid Congo outbreak
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) has reached 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, the fastest-growing outbreak on the continent. A second U.S. citizen working with a humanitarian organization has tested positive for Ebola; the CDC is coordinating contact tracing with Congolese health officials and international partners to identify close contacts and curb transmission. The patient is under care; identifying details were not released. The outbreak was officially declared May 15 after undetected spread, and has also produced cases in Uganda. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; clinical trials are underway. Earlier in the response, a U.S. doctor treated in Germany recovered and returned to the United States after quarantine. Ongoing conflict in eastern Congo complicates response, with displacement, attacks on health facilities, mistrust, and PPE shortages hindering surveillance and vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ流行の最中、2人目の米国市民がエボラ熱に感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,830症例・648死亡に達する急拡大中のエボラ流行があり、ウガンダへの拡大、米国市民の感染、ワクチン未承認などIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例発生や米国・ドイツでの感染者治療も報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・米国・ドイツは含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。東部コンゴの紛争が対応を複雑化させている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Piracema realiza blitz educativa de combate ao Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piracema conducts an educational blitz to combat Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: On 11 July 2026, Piracema conducted an educational blitz to combat Aedes aegypti and prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The initiative distributed leaflets at local shops near the activity site to reach workers, customers, and passersby. It provided guidance on eliminating potential mosquito breeding sites and emphasized actions inside and around homes to reduce standing water and other attractants. The campaign aimed to raise community awareness and encourage preventive measures at residences and businesses. Aedes aegypti is the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, and community participation is crucial for successful control of breeding sites. The effort sought to reinforce that mosquito control depends on residents' actions and to reduce transmission risks within the municipality. Source: Prefeitura de Piracema.

triage.headline_ja: ピラセマ市、ネッタイシマカ対策の啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱等の予防を目的とした通常の啓発・広報活動であり、症例発生報告や公衆衛生上の異常事態は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体による蚊媒介感染症予防のための教育活動を報じたものであり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、本記事は予防啓発活動であり感染症イベントとしての実質的なシグナルはないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ação contra dengue recolhe mais de 30 mil pneus inservíveis | Itaperuna | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campaign Against Dengue Fever Collects Over 30,000 Unserviceable Tires | Itaperuna | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Itaperuna, Rio de Janeiro, is conducting an integrated campaign by the Environment and Health secretariats to combat Aedes aegypti, the dengue, chikungunya, and Zika vectors. More than 30,000 unusable tires have been collected for recycling, filling several trucks and sending 14 loads to São Paulo for processing. The effort aims to remove mosquito breeding sites by clearing tires and other potential containers, with pest-control teams conducting daily environmental surveillance across neighborhoods. Residents are urged to dedicate at least 10 minutes weekly to inspect homes and yards for standing water, keep lids on containers, and properly dispose of tires, trash, and entulho through municipal cleaning services. The campaign emphasizes environmental protection and public health synergy, encouraging community participation to reduce dengue transmission in the municipalities and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策キャンペーンで3万本以上の廃タイヤを回収 | イタペルーナ | O Dia
triage.triage_reason: デング熱等の媒介蚊対策としてのタイヤ回収キャンペーンに関する日常的な公衆衛生活動の報道であり、症例急増や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介感染症予防のための環境衛生キャンペーン（タイヤ回収）に関する内容で、症例数や流行状況についての具体的な言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS faz alerta sobre avanço do maior surto da variante Bundibugyo do Ebola já registrado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns about the progression of the largest outbreak of the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola on record.
article.articleSummary: Despite intense response, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak continues to expand, representing the largest known outbreak of the Bundibugyo variant. The outbreak was officially declared May 15 and, as of July 4, 1,561 cases have been confirmed with 506 deaths and 254 recoveries; more than 10,000 contacts are under active monitoring. There is no vaccine or approved specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Access is hampered by armed conflict in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, hindering case finding and response. WHO teams have visited treatment centers in Bunia, Beni, Butembo, and Katwa, where facilities operate near capacity; ambulances and infrastructure are limited. Diagnostics have surged from ~30 tests per day to over 2,000 daily with 10 decentralized labs. A clinical study is testing MBP134 (monoclonal antibody) and remdesivir, with >1,200 doses allocated. Healthcare workers face pay delays and equipment shortages, risking strikes.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株の史上最大規模の流行拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が拡大中で、致死率が高く、ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在せず、紛争地域でのアクセス制限もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOが最大規模と警告する流行で、致死率約32%(506/1561)。ワクチン・承認治療薬なし、武力紛争によるアクセス制限あり。国際的拡大の明示的言及はないが、大規模流行のため今後の推移を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Ebola outbreak could be four times bigger as American tests positive
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) intensifies as an American humanitarian worker tests positive; CDC coordinating contact tracing with Congolese authorities and the patient’s employer. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; care is primarily supportive while clinical trials proceed. WHO calls this Africa’s fastest-growing Ebola outbreak, with roughly 80% of newly confirmed patients in hardest-hit zones missing from existing contact lists due to conflict, attacks on health facilities, population movement, and weak health infrastructure. The true scale could be 2–4 times larger than official counts. Epicenter remains Ituri Province (Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nyakunde) with cases also in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo; international spread includes Uganda and a previously documented imported case in France. DRC tally: 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths as of Friday; US risk remains low with no cases on U.S. soil. The second American infected is noted; Dr. Peter Stafford recovered after evacuation to Germany. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle aches, sore throat, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and bleeding; transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids; treatment remains supportive (fluids, electrolytes, oxygen).

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラ出血熱の流行が実際には4倍規模である可能性があると発表、アメリカ人感染者も確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大）に該当し、WPRO基準も全項目該当。アフリカで最速拡大中のエボラ流行として社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 感染拡大の主体はDRCのイツリ州を中心とした地域。ウガンダ、フランス、米国、ドイツでの症例は輸入例・接触例であり対象国リストには含まれないため除外。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ型エボラであり、コンタクトトレーシングの約80%が漏れているとの指摘があり、実際の規模は公式集計の2〜4倍の可能性がある重大な流行。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: el brote ya causó 648 muertes y 1.830 casos en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the outbreak has already caused 648 deaths and 1,830 cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 648 deaths and 1,830 cases as of July 11, 2026. The cluster is concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (the epicenter), North Kivu and South Kivu, with two cases under investigation in Kisangani, Tshopo province. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in Ituri, a border region with Uganda and South Sudan, and has spread to neighboring Uganda, where 20 confirmed cases have been reported, including 15 imported from the DRC, with two deaths. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, with a case fatality rate estimated at 30-50%; there is no authorized vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization notes this is the third-worst Ebola outbreak in history and the seventeenth outbreak in the DRC. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing severe fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴでの流行はすでに648人の死者と1,830例の症例を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクがDRCからウガンダへ国際的に拡大しており、致死率が高く公衆衛生への影響が深刻であるため、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよび南スーダンへの越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCが主要な発生国であり、史上3番目に深刻なエボラ流行とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Summer capital logs 41 Covid cases
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-11, Baguio City has recorded 41 confirmed Covid-19 cases for 2026, with a noticeable uptick beginning in May. The circulating virus remains SARS-CoV-2, with all reported infections described as mild. The majority of cases involve healthcare workers and hospital staff rather than the general public. The City Health Services Office, in collaboration with local hospitals, is monitoring the situation and implementing targeted response measures within health facilities, including strengthened infection prevention protocols. Authorities emphasize that city healthcare facilities remain safe and capable of serving the community. Residents are urged to continue basic precautions: wear masks in crowded places, wash hands regularly, and stay home if unwell. The public will receive timely updates as the situation evolves, with a calm and confident communications approach.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の首都で新型コロナウイルス感染症41例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 報告例は全て軽症で、既知の病原体（SARS-CoV-2）による小規模な増加に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 既知のウイルス（SARS-CoV-2）による軽症例の局地的な増加であり、医療従事者が中心。地元保健当局が通常の対応を実施しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: American doctor contracts Ebola as Nanyuki quarantine plan faces fresh scrutiny
article.articleSummary: An American doctor who treated Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the United States for specialized care, renewing scrutiny in Kenya over the Nanyuki quarantine facility. Kenya has not reported a confirmed Ebola case; however, the DRC outbreak keeps it on alert due to extensive trade. A U.S. funding package of Sh1.9 billion ($14.5 million) aims to strengthen Kenya’s detection and response to Ebola, including surveillance, laboratory testing, border screening, emergency response, and community engagement. The program trained 800 lab professionals, strengthened two KEMRI Ebola laboratories, deployed two mobile laboratories, trained 1,700 disease detectives, 120 rapid responders and 160 county personnel; 27 Emergency Operations Centres are active, with 12 more planned. Petitions challenge the Nanyuki facility; government says it isolates suspected cases awaiting lab confirmation and aligns with International Health Regulations. The episode intensifies debate on domestic preparedness versus regional support.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人医師がエボラに感染、ナニュキ検疫施設計画への新たな精査
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクにおいて医療従事者（米国人医師）が感染し本国搬送された事案であり、国際的拡大の懸念と近隣国ケニアでの検疫体制への社会的関心の高まりが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生中のエボラアウトブレイクにおける医療従事者感染と国際搬送、およびケニアの検疫体制への社会的議論。ケニア自体では確定症例は報告されていないため対象国リストのケニアは含まれず、Kenyaは対象国リストに存在しないため除外。米国からの資金支援（1.9億シリング）が投入されており国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: ليبيا تشدد إجراءاتها لمواجهة الحمى القلاعية وسط مخاوف من اتساع الإصابات | ليبيا أوبزيرفر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Libya tightens its measures to combat foot-and-mouth disease amid fears of the spread of infections | Libya Observer
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreaks intensify in Libya as of July 2026. In the west, a confirmed FMD infection in a sheep flock in Amamra, part of Msallata municipality, has led to four deaths and 86 infections. Authorities closed livestock markets and imposed movement restrictions on animals and meat from suspected areas; veterinary teams are conducting active surveillance, collecting samples, with some sent to external laboratories for confirmation. In the east, suspected FMD infections are reported in flocks around Qandoula and Marawa (Bayda), with signs of lameness and oral ulcers; samples are being tested. Zliten reports suspected cases, though officials say no infections there. Markets in Qasr Ben Ghashir, Al-Ghiliat, and Beni Walid are temporarily closed; intensified inspections are ongoing in Suk al-Khamis, Amshihel, Al-Asabiya, and Gharyan. Experts stress vaccination campaigns, biosafety, quarantine for imports, and rapid reporting to curb spread and economic losses.

triage.headline_ja: リビアが口蹄疫の感染拡大への懸念を受け対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫はリビア国内での動物疾病であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する発生は確認されない。またヒトへの公衆衛生影響も報告されていない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれるが、記事本文はリビア国内の口蹄疫流行のみを扱っており、フィリピンでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。動物疾病でありヒトへの感染性・重症度は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra bans 3 toxic beauty creams; experts explains Dengue early symptoms
article.articleSummary: Maharashtra, India’s FDA banned three beauty creams containing mercury and lead to protect kidney and nervous system health. The segment also covers dengue awareness, detailing early symptoms and distinguishing dengue from other viral fevers, with a warning against ibuprofen during dengue due to bleeding risk. For monsoon readiness, guidelines advise a home medicine cabinet with oral rehydration salts and paracetamol, while cautioning against unprescribed antibiotics or steroids. Pharmacists explain why eye drops and reconstituted syrups should be discarded within a month of opening to prevent contamination and potency loss. The program also cites sleep deprivation (under six hours impairs cognitive function) and promotes somatic breathing for stress relief, underscoring sleep and healthy habits as safeguards against long-term cognitive decline. The briefing does not provide dengue case counts or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラーシュトラ州、有害な美容クリーム3種を禁止；専門家がデング熱の初期症状を解説
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の一般的な健康啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数や発生報告がなく、公衆衛生上の新規シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の啓発・健康情報番組であり、症例数や発生地域に関する具体的データは含まれていない。美容クリーム禁止のニュースが主題であり、デング熱は季節的注意喚起の一部として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: A U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo has tested positive for Ebola, the CDC said on 2026-07-11. The Democratic Republic of Congo's outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in Africa, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths; cases have also been reported in Uganda. The CDC is coordinating with the patient’s employer, U.S. agencies, public health authorities and Congolese partners to halt transmission and identify close contacts, but few details were released. The infection is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Congolese authorities declared a fresh outbreak on May 15 after undetected transmission; containment is hampered by funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict. Last week, clinical treatment trials began.

triage.headline_ja: 米国市民、コンゴでエボラ出血熱陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大するエボラ流行（1,830症例、648死亡）に米国人が感染し、ウガンダにも波及。国際的拡大とワクチン・治療薬未承認という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威があるため。
triage.notes: 米国人感染者およびウガンダでの症例報告があるが、対象国リストにウガンダ・米国は含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyoウイルス株によるアウトブレイクで、致死率が高く（約35%）、資金不足・武力紛争により封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura virus: 3 children dead, 6 test positive in Gujarat
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus resurfaces in Gujarat during monsoon, with 3 children dead and six testing positive so far. A three-year-old girl from Sabarkantha died; her sample is being lab-confirmed as a fourth casualty. Two more children aged 1 and 4 were shifted from Kheda to Gandhinagar Civil Hospital with symptoms; reports pending. Health officials say preventive actions include surveillance, intra-residential spray, cleanliness drives, mud-wall filling, and notifying local IMA officials to route suspected cases to tertiary care hospitals based on symptoms. A containment drive, drawing on 2024 data, has been launched across 61 villages in 21 districts; a door-to-door survey is underway and residents are being educated on signs and symptoms. Most cases are concentrated in North Gujarat and the eastern tribal belt. Transmission is mainly by bites of infected sand flies and causes acute encephalitis syndrome with high fever and seizures. Gujarat was among worst-hit states during the 2024 outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス:グジャラート州で子供3人死亡、6人が陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 小児における致死性の急性脳炎症候群（チャンディプラウイルス）が複数地域で発生し、IHR基準を2項目満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介の急性脳炎症候群で、2024年にもグジャラート州で大規模流行があった。今回も北部および東部部族地域で症例が集中し、複数県での封じ込め対策が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Erratic rains, changing mosquito breeding patterns put Hyderabad on dengue alert
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Hyderabad is on dengue alert amid erratic rains and shifting mosquito breeding patterns. Health officials warn intermittent rainfall followed by dry spells creates ideal Aedes aegypti breeding in clean stagnant water, with more sites inside homes than in open areas. Indoor breeding spots include refrigerator drip trays, air cooler tanks, flower pots, overhead water storage containers, and AC condensate pipes. Because Aedes aegypti bites mainly during the day, transmission risk is higher in schools, offices, and other public places. Officials note that about 80% of dengue infections are asymptomatic, enabling hidden spread when mosquitoes bite viremic individuals. Residents are urged to inspect homes weekly, empty and scrub water containers, and eliminate stagnant water. Early medical consultation for fever is advised. Emphasis on household cleanliness, repellents, and daytime protective clothing to curb transmission during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: 不規則な降雨とパターン変化する蚊の繁殖がハイデラバードをデング警戒に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱注意喚起記事であり、異常事態や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容ではない。毎年モンスーン期に見られる典型的な公衆衛生啓発情報。
triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期に発生する季節性デング熱の注意喚起記事。具体的な症例数や死亡者数の記載はなく、公衆衛生当局による予防的な呼びかけが主内容。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : le laboratoire mobile raccourcit les délais de diagnostic à Nizi(médecin chef de zone de santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: The mobile laboratory shortens diagnostic turnaround times in Nizi (chief medical officer of the health zone) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Ebola diagnostics in Ituri's Nizi health zone, Djugu territory, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, can be confirmed or excluded locally with a mobile laboratory. The facility, deployed in Nizi near Bunia (more than 30 kilometers away previously), now delivers diagnostic results between one hour and one hour 30 minutes after a patient arrives at the Ebola Treatment Center. Dr. Jean-Claude Lonzama, the zone medical chief, notes that the mobile lab's proximity eliminates the previous delay of transporting samples to Bunia and accelerates case management. The on-site testing enhances surveillance and outbreak response by bringing diagnostic services closer to affected communities, enabling rapid confirmation of suspected cases and timely adaptation of care.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ:移動式検査室がニジでの診断時間を短縮(保健地区首席医師)-ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行に関する記事であり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク等）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例報告ではなく、既存のエボラ治療センターにおける移動式検査室導入による診断迅速化を報じるものだが、コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ流行の一環であるため、継続的な監視・評価対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : les travaux du centre de transit Ebola avancent normalement à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: work on the Ebola transit center is progressing normally in Beni - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) transit center construction progresses in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as MSF funds the response. The facility comprises four blocks for suspected and confirmed cases; each block has four rooms with a total of 16 beds (64 beds overall), plus dedicated patient showers and toilets. The site includes a morgue, a child creche, a drying area, a laundry, a staff block, kitchen, potable-water well, storage, and a generator for power. Two separate entrances exist: east for patients and west for administrative staff. Visitors may communicate with patients through a secure glass window but cannot approach them. Inpatients will receive three full meals daily and medicines. Completion is expected within three weeks, weather permitting. MSF has also built a modern isolation building at Kanzulinzuli health center in Bungulu and is finishing another at Malepe health center in Beu.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニのエボラ・トランジットセンターの建設工事は順調に進行 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既知のDRCエボラ対応におけるMSF支援の隔離施設建設進捗報告であり、新規感染拡大や異常事象を示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRomania（Mureş州、Beu等）が含まれているが、これは地名の同名誤認識によるものであり、記事内容はDRC北キブ州のエボラ対応施設建設に限定される。記事自体は既存対応のインフラ整備の進捗報告であり、新規症例やアウトブレイク拡大の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : construction d'un centre de traitement d'une capacité de 32 lits à Nizi (Médecin chef de zone de santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Construction of a 32-bed treatment center in Nizi (the health zone's chief medical officer) - ACP
article.articleSummary: An Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) with an initial 32-bed capacity is under construction at the General Reference Hospital of Nizi in Djugu, Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to Dr. Jean-Claude Lonzama, the zone medical officer. The health zone had estimated a need for 60 beds; three buildings are being erected to provide 32 beds initially, with the facility soon operational and capable of relieving the nearby isolation center, which already houses about 50 beds and is near saturation. The ETC opening is planned in the coming week. The project is supported by Ebola response partners, notably the NGO ALIMA, to strengthen patient intake in a zone facing bed shortages since the outbreak began. Previously, suspected and confirmed cases were sent to Bunia treatment centers, whose saturation limited transfers; the new ETC should improve capacity and quality of care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ニジ保健地区に32床の治療センターを建設（保健地区医療責任者）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、既存の隔離施設が飽和状態にあり新規治療センター建設が必要となるほど症例が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既存の隔離センター（約50床）が飽和状態にあり、患者受け入れ能力不足が深刻。国際NGO（ALIMA）が支援していることから、既にアウトブレイク対応が進行中であることが示唆される。フルRRAでの詳細な症例数・致死率・地理的拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus has expanded since a May 15 declaration, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths reported in Congo; Uganda has confirmed cases as well. A US citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Congo has tested positive for Ebola; the CDC is coordinating with the employer, US agencies, public health authorities, and Congolese partners to identify close contacts and prevent further transmission. Earlier this week, an American doctor infected in Congo was transferred to Germany for treatment. The outbreak features no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus, and clinical treatment trials began recently. Containment challenges include a funding gap, attacks on health centers, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict. Plans to relocate exposed Americans to a Kenyan facility were suspended by a Kenyan court.

triage.headline_ja: 米国市民、コンゴでエボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1,830症例・648死亡の大規模エボラ流行が拡大し、ウガンダへの越境、米国市民感染、ドイツへの搬送等、国際的拡大とワクチン未承認という深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUnited States、Germany、Kenya、Ugandaも含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダでの症例確認は記事に記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法未承認、資金不足、東部コンゴの紛争、医療施設への攻撃など封じ込めの課題が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por el avance del ébola en Congo: 648 muertos y más de 1.800 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert over the spread of Ebola in Congo: 648 dead and more than 1,800 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus drives a severe outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan borders. As of the latest official tally, Congo reports 1,830 Ebola cases and 648 deaths (case fatality rate 34.1%). About 764 patients remain isolated or hospitalized, with 295 recoveries. Contact tracing stands at 78.6%. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, which has confirmed 20 cases, including 2 deaths, with 15 imported from the DRC. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976 and is among the most deadly. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently has no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment. WHO warns insecurity and high population mobility hinder response, complicating access and transmission control. Typical symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, and potential hemorrhage in severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ拡大に警戒:死者648人、確定症例1,800人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率34%の大規模エボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されている。ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ治安要因で対応困難であり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内のイトゥリ州が中心。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による致死率34.1%の重大流行。

article.articleHeadline: Tecnologia contra a dengue chega a São Carlos e promete reduzir transmissão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Technology to Combat Dengue Arrives in São Carlos and Promises to Reduce Transmission.
article.articleSummary: São Carlos, São Paulo, Brazil launches Wolbachia-based control to reduce transmission of Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya by Aedes aegypti. The municipal Health Surveillance Department advances preparations after selecting the city in 2025 based on vector infestation. The program releases Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes (Wolbitos) in defined areas; over generations, the bacterium spreads, lowering viral replication in mosquitoes and transmission risk. First releases are planned for September, occurring gradually over about 26 weeks, with monitoring of Wolbachia establishment and epidemiological analyses to assess disease reduction. Community engagement is essential, including education and household surveys before releases. The technology is considered safe and WHO-approved, complementing existing measures like breeding-site elimination and vector control. Outpatient and international precedents report substantial reductions: Niterói (Dengue 89%, Chikungunya 60%, Zika 37%), Campo Grande Dengue 63%; Vietnam 86%, Indonesia 77%, Colombia 97%, Australia 97%.

triage.headline_ja: サンカルロスにデング熱対策技術が導入、感染拡大の抑制に期待
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、既存のデング・ジカ・チクングニア対策としてワクチン技術（ウォルバキア）導入を紹介する内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の媒介動物対策技術（ウォルバキア）の導入に関するもので、新規感染症発生や急激な増加を示す情報はない。ベトナム・インドネシア・コロンビア・オーストラリアは過去の導入実績の比較例として言及されているのみで、当該国での新規イベントではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : trois nouveaux guéris sortis du centre de traitement de Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: Three newly recovered patients discharged from the Beni Ebola Treatment Center - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Three more patients recovered from Ebola virus disease in Beni, North Kivu, in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, as the Beni Ebola Treatment Center discharged them on 11 July 2026. With these three, total survivors at the CTE Beni reach five since the outbreak began in the health zone. The trio includes a man, a woman, and a child. The second recovery was recorded on 7 July 2026: the woman tested positive, received 15 days of care, and was declared cured. Health authorities note that earlier hospital presentation improves chances of survival, and highlight ongoing collaboration between residents and response teams to contain the outbreak in Beni.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：北キブ州、ベニのエボラ治療センターから新たに3名の回復者退院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報告であり、重篤な疾患かつヒト-ヒト感染のリスクがあるため、経過を含めフルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラアウトブレイク（ベニ、北キブ州）における回復者退院を報じるフォローアップ記事。新規発生や急激な悪化を示すものではないが、エボラ自体の重篤性と継続中の感染リスクからPICKUPとして経過観察・評価対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : arrivée du ministre de la Santé pour renforcer la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: arrival of the Minister of Health to bolster the Ebola response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 11 July 2026, Kisangani in the Tshopo province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo welcomed Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba for a mission to bolster the Ebola response. The visit aims to assess the implementation of prevention and response activities in Tshopo, engage health professionals, and identify major challenges faced by response teams. During the stay, the minister will chair working sessions with provincial authorities, inspect health facilities involved in patient care, and meet technical and financial partners mobilized for the Ebola response. Provincial authorities say the mission should improve coordination among the central government, local authorities, and health actors to enhance response effectiveness and protect populations. The province currently has two Ebola patients under treatment at the Ebola Treatment Center at Kisangani’s Cinquantenaire Hospital, with several contact cases under health surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:保健大臣がエボラ対応強化のため到着 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の患者が確認され、保健大臣が対応強化のため現地入りしており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: エボラ治療センターに2名の患者が入院中で、複数の接触者が監視下にある。保健大臣の現地訪問は対応の深刻さを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Criança de dois anos morre com suspeita de dengue no Sul do Piauí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A two-year-old child dies with suspected dengue in southern Piauí.
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old dies in southern Piauí with suspected dengue. The child, a resident of Pio IX, died last Thursday (the 9th) after initial symptoms began on Monday (the 6th) and a positive dengue test at a health unit in Pio IX. Critically ill, he was transferred to Hospital Regional Justino Luz in Picos, but he did not survive. The mother said the Pau Ferro community, where they live in Pio XI, has many dengue cases. The Secretaria de Estado da Saúde (Sesapi) will investigate the death; confirmation will come after laboratory tests by Lacen. Pio IX has intensified dengue-control actions amid rising cases in recent weeks, with 91 infections confirmed in 2026, including two severe dengue. Authorities urge removing water-holding containers, keeping water tanks closed, using repellent, and seeking medical care promptly for fever, body aches, headaches, rash, or eye pain.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州南部で2歳児がデング熱疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一地域での小児死亡例だが、デング熱は当該国で流行性疾患であり突発的異常性は低い。地域内での症例増加傾向は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、対象国リストの定義上ブラジル(3469034)は含まれるIDリストに存在するため確認が必要。リスト上3469034=Brazilは対象国に含まれているため、実際にはverified_locationsに含めるべきである。

article.articleHeadline: Vakalarda endişelendiren artış! Burun deliklerinden giriyor: Beyin yiyen amip çocuğu hayattan kopardı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming rise in cases! It enters through the nostrils: the brain-eating amoeba claimed the child's life.
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, caused the death of an 11-year-old American boy, Jordan Smelski, during a Costa Rica vacation after swimming in a natural pool near a hotel; seven days later he developed severe headaches and hallucinations and died in intensive care, diagnosed as primary amebic meningoencephalitis (PAM). The infection enters via nasal passages and rapidly attacks brain tissue. Globally, PAM remains rare but highly fatal: 1962–2023 saw 488 cases, about 97% fatal; last year India reported more than 200 infections, a record outbreak. In recent decades, cases have appeared in colder regions (Italy, Belgium, Minnesota), with Slovakia’s first confirmed case in 2023 and Taiwan reporting a 2023 case linked to an indoor surfing facility. Climate-driven warming of lakes and pools is expanding the amoeba’s range, increasing risk, especially for children; officials urge vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 症例の増加が懸念される！鼻から侵入する脳食いアメーバが子供の命を奪った
