triage.triage_reason: Naegleria fowleri(原発性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎)に関する既知疾患の啓発的まとめ記事であり、新規の緊急発生事案ではないが、気候変動による発生地域拡大やインドでの記録的症例数增加が言及されており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコスタリカでの少年死亡事例を中心に、Naegleria fowleri感染の世界的傾向(気候変動による寒冷地域への拡大、インドでの記録的アウトブレイク等)をまとめた啓発記事。人-人感染はなく水系感染のため国際的拡大リスクは低い。インドでの200件超の感染事例は具体的事実として言及されているためverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : "12 des 19 décès d'Ebola ont bénéficié d'un enterrement digne et sécurisé" (Division provinciale de la santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele: "12 of the 19 Ebola deaths benefited from a dignified and secure burial" (Provincial Health Division) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease in Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, reports 19 deaths from 24 suspected cases as of July 9, 2026. Seven samples from Wamba tested positive at INRB; additional suspected cases in Boma-Mangbetu, Pawa, and Isiro await results. By July 11, 2026, deaths: 13 in Wamba, 3 in Pawa, 3 in Isiro. Twelve of the 19 deaths had dignified and secure burials, with gaps attributed to late reporting or resistance to safe burials, prompting intensified prevention messaging. Authorities ban transport of corpses and forbid handling of Ebola patients by prayer houses or traditional practitioners; patients must be directed to nearest health facilities. Response coordinated by the Haut-Uele Provincial Health Division with provincial and central government support, plus assistance from the Ituri region via Nia-Nia; a budgeted outbreak response plan aims to mobilize additional resources.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州:「エボラによる19人の死亡者のうち12人は尊厳ある安全な埋葬が行われた」（州保健局）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部でエボラ出血熱の死者19人・疑い例24人が確認されており、致死性が高く国際的拡大リスクもあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の即時通報対象疾患であり、致死率も高く、安全な埋葬への抵抗や祈祷師による患者取扱いなど感染拡大要因が指摘されている。州・中央政府に加え他地域からの支援も動員されており、外部支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus Outbreak in Gujarat: 3 Children Dead
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat: Three children have died and six tested positive in the past 10 days, with 17 suspected cases and 10 negatives, according to Health Minister Praful Pansheriya in Surat. Initial cluster reported earlier in Panchmahal district, where two children died, and a third fatality involved a six-year-old from Rajasthan treated at Himmatnagar Civil Hospital in Sabarkantha. The virus is transmitted by sand flies and causes acute encephalitis syndrome in children; symptoms start with high fever, vomiting, and headache and can progress to seizures and altered consciousness. There is no specific antiviral treatment or vaccine; care is supportive. Authorities have intensified surveillance, door-to-door screening, blood sampling, and insecticide spraying; medical teams deployed. The renewed outbreak follows Gujarat’s two-year gap since its large 2024 monsoon outbreak, and monsoon period remains a focus.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染症流行:子供3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性の2つに該当し、子供の死亡例を伴う脳炎流行が継続していることからフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介性で人-人感染は報告されていないが、モンスーン期に子供を中心とした急性脳炎症候群を引き起こし、2024年の大規模流行から2年ぶりの再流行である点が懸念される。ラジャスタン州由来の症例も含まれるため州境を越えた拡大の可能性にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Un trabajador estadounidense contrajo ébola en Congo y EE. UU. refuerza la prevención
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American worker contracted Ebola in Congo, and the United States strengthens prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: An American humanitarian worker contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid Africa’s major outbreak, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths; Uganda has also reported cases. The Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine or approved treatment; last week clinical trials began to treat it. The CDC, citing CBS, is coordinating with the worker’s employer, U.S. agencies, Congolese authorities, and partners to prevent transmission and identify close contacts, with no further patient details released. Congo declared the outbreak on May 15 after weeks of undetected spread, a delay that widened transmission, while conflict and attacks on health facilities hinder surveillance. Earlier, a U.S. physician contracted Ebola, was treated in Germany, recovered, and returned in June. The White House seeks $1.4 billion to respond; plans to relocate exposed Americans to a Kenyan center were blocked by a Kenyan court. CDC focuses on breaking transmission chains and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人労働者がコンゴでエボラに感染、米国が予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行（確定1,830例、死亡648例）が継続中で、国際的な感染拡大（米国人労働者・医師の感染、ウガンダでの症例）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（ブンディブギョ変異株）での大規模流行を主題とし、米国人労働者・医師への感染拡大、ウガンダでの症例、ケニアへの避難計画の裁判所差し止め、ホワイトハウスによる14億ドルの対応予算要求など、国際的関心・対応の必要性が高いことを示している。ウガンダ・米国・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: La directora de emergencias de la OMS en África, desde Congo: "Todo apunta a que será el peor brote de ébola hasta ahora"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO's Africa Emergency Director, reporting from Congo: "Everything points to this being the worst Ebola outbreak to date."
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, WHO Africa Emergency Director Marie Roseline Belizaire, back in Brazzaville after 48 days on the ground in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, says the third Ebola outbreak there is likely the worst to date. Bunia serves as the epicenter of the crisis. Belizaire—a Haitian physician educated in Cuba with a PhD in Epidemiology and Public Health from Spain—has led responses to AIDS in Haiti, Ebola in West Africa, yellow fever in Angola, and dengue plus Crimean-Congo fever in Mauritania. She warns that effective outbreak control must blend local customs and beliefs with scientific measures to avoid resistance and distrust. Her larger aim beyond containment is to improve people’s lives after the outbreak, ensuring access to food, water and latrines.

triage.headline_ja: WHOアフリカ地域緊急対応局長、コンゴから「これまでで最悪のエボラ流行になるだろう」と発言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行がWHO当局者により「過去最悪」と評価されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（ブニア）でのエボラ流行が主題。他の疾患（黄熱病、CCHF、デング熱）や国（アンゴラ、モーリタニア、ハイチ、キューバ、スペイン）はWHO職員の経歴紹介であり、現在進行中の発生イベントではないため verified_locations から除外した。コンゴ共和国（ブラザビル）も同様に活動拠点であり発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: CG antecipa preparo da saúde contra avanço da dengue e chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CG anticipates health preparations against the spread of dengue and chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, is accelerating preparations of its Municipal Health Network ahead of the arbovirus transmission peak, amid dengue with new serotypes and chikungunya spreading in the state. The 2nd Arboviroses in Focus workshop, held on July 7 by SESAU, aims to update staff for improved dengue and chikungunya diagnosis, clinical management, and network response before the summer surge. Dengue serotype 3 is re-emerging, leaving much of the population susceptible and heightening risk across municipalities including Dourados. Ministry of Health officials stress early preparation, while Fiocruz highlights clinical observation and context-aware decisions. The event underscores ongoing SUS integration and permanent professional training as essential to strengthen public health response to arboviruses.

triage.headline_ja: CGがデング熱・チクングニア熱の拡大に備え医療体制を早期整備
triage.triage_reason: デング熱新血清型（DENV-3）の再流行とチクングニア熱の拡大が懸念されるが、現時点では自治体レベルの予防的準備段階であり深刻な公衆衛生影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: デング熱血清型3型の再流行により免疫のない人口が多く、季節的流行拡大のリスクがあるため今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: US aid worker in Congo infected with Ebola during record outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Ebola, with the CDC coordinating to identify close contacts and prevent further transmission. The Congo outbreak has surged to 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, with confirmed cases also reported in neighboring Uganda. Congolese authorities declared a fresh outbreak on May 15, caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Earlier in the outbreak, an American doctor tested positive in Congo and was treated in Germany. Containment is hampered by a funding gap, attacks on health centers, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict; last week clinical trials for treatment began.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの記録的なエボラ流行下、米国人援助従事者が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当。ウガンダへの越境拡大、米国人感染者の存在、ワクチン・治療法なしという重大な状況。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびドイツも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCでの流行は1,830症例・648死亡と致死率が高く、Bundibugyoウイルスによる株でワクチン・治療法が未承認。資金不足、医療施設への攻撃、東部コンゴ紛争が封じ込めを妨げている。CDCが接触者特定に協力しており国際的関与が既に発生している点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Un deuxième travailleur humanitaire américain infecté par Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A second American aid worker infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: CDC announced on Friday that an American aid worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo has contracted the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola. No further details about the patient were released. Working with the employer, other U.S. agencies, and Congolese partners, the CDC is trying to halt the virus’s spread. A few days after the mid-May outbreak announcement, the first U.S. case was reported—a physician working for an NGO who was transferred to Germany for care and has since recovered. At the end of June, the virus appeared in Europe for the first time with a French doctor affiliated with an NGO operating in Congo; he boarded in Kinshasa without symptoms, fell ill during the flight, and has recovered; no new European cases have been reported. The outbreak remains out of control, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; two treatments are in clinical trials begun last week. Response is hampered by regional insecurity and a strike by Congolese humanitarian workers demanding pay and better conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人援助従事者2人目がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当(深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク)が確認され、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で制御不能な流行となり、米国・欧州へも感染者が拡大している重大事案。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国での大規模流行（1,830症例、648死亡）が主題で、地域の不安定化とストライキが対応を妨げている。ワクチン・特効薬なし、治療法は臨床試験段階。

article.articleHeadline: Jamshedpur News: जिले में मलेरिया से एक और मौत, 128 नए मरीज मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jamshedpur News: Another malaria death in the district, 128 new cases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 11, 2026, malaria deaths in East Singhbhum district, Jharkhand total nine this year, including a 25-year-old Ritik Singh who died from cerebral malaria. In the latest wave, 14,200 people were tested on Friday, with 128 new cases detected. Potka block recorded the highest daily cases (35), followed by Ghatsila and Patamda (21 each), Dumuria (19), and Baharagora and Chakulia (1 each). Seventeen rapid-response teams were deployed to 17 villages for screening and awareness, aided by a Jamshedpur street-theatre team. Civil Surgeon Dr. Shahir Pal visited Chemizudi and Rangamatia, oversaw fogging and facility readiness, and directed intensified testing and outreach. In Potka, 40 malaria-affected villages have seen 18,939 people tested with 619 positives; most recovered, others under surveillance. Authorities urge prompt treatment at government centers, prevent water stagnation, and have ordered 100,000 malaria test kits to maintain screening.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルニュース：地区でマラリアによる死亡がまた1件、新たに128人の感染者
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州の一地区における季節性マラリアの流行で、死亡例・症例数は一定数あるが、地域内で対応可能な状況であり異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 季節性マラリアの地域流行であり、East Singhbhum地区(Jharkhand州)で迅速対応チームや検査キットの手配など地方保健当局による対応が進行中。バングラデシュは地図上の座標範囲に含まれるが記事内容とは無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Acre registra mais de 500 novos casos de tuberculose em 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre records more than 500 new tuberculosis cases in 2025.
article.articleSummary: Acre state, Brazil, reported 502 new tuberculosis cases in 2025, with an incidence above the national average of 39.7 per 100,000. Pulmonary TB accounted for 443 cases (88.2%), with 184 women (36.7%) and 318 men (63.3%); 2 cases were recorded post-mortem. Rio Branco logged 285 new TB cases, an incidence of 73.3 per 100,000. In 2024, TB caused 34 deaths in the state: 1 aged 0–14; 22 aged 15–59; and 11 aged 60+. Regional comparison shows Acre’s incidence is lower than Amazonas (93.0) and Pará, Amapá and Roraima (60.0–61.2). TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and is primarily pulmonary; transmission is airborne. Diagnostic methods include rapid molecular tests (TRM-TB) or smear, culture, and drug-sensitivity testing, complemented by clinical assessment and chest X-ray. High-risk groups include incarcerated individuals, the elderly, and children/adolescents.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州、2025年に結核新規症例500件以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: 結核はブラジルでは既知の風土病であり、報告数値は統計的な年次報告に過ぎず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核はブラジルにおいて既知の風土病であり、本記事は地域衛生統計の定期報告に相当する内容。

article.articleHeadline: Três Lagoas confirma terceiro caso de doença meningocócica - Perfil News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Três Lagoas confirms third case of meningococcal disease - Perfil News
article.articleSummary: As of 11 July 2026, Três Lagoas confirms the municipality’s third case of meningococcal disease. The first case was serogroup B; the second and third cases are serogroup C. The hospitalized patient remains under medical care with ongoing monitoring. The Municipal Health Secretariat reports immediate epidemiological investigation, identification and monitoring of close contacts, and implementation of prevention and control measures per Ministry of Health protocols. Meningococcal disease is a notifiable condition, and all suspected cases are investigated to enable rapid risk reduction. Common signs and symptoms include high fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, drowsiness, confusion, and, in some cases, red or purplish skin spots. Surveillance and public health actions continue to protect the population and ensure transparency in reporting.

triage.headline_ja: トレス・ラゴアス市で髄膜炎菌性疾患の第3例目を確認 - Perfil News
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一自治体で髄膜炎菌性疾患が3例（血清型B・C）確認され、うち1例が入院中だが、地域保健当局が通常の疫学調査・接触者管理を実施している段階であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 同一自治体内で異なる血清型（B型・C型）の症例が続いている点は注視すべきだが、現時点では地元保健当局により通常の届出疾患対応がなされており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。続報でクラスター拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas recebe projeto-piloto com mosquitos 'modificados' para combate à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas hosts a pilot project with 'modified' mosquitoes to combat dengue.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, will host a pilot using Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes to combat dengue, with six São Paulo state cities implementing the approach, including Campinas, Presidente Prudente, and São Carlos. Releases are planned to begin May 2027, with impact expected in 2028. The program, led by Fiocruz with the Ministry of Health, uses non-genetically modified Wolbachia bacteria to halt dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission and, in some cases, reduce mosquito reproduction. Wolbachia is transmitted by eggs, making the intervention self-sustaining. A biofactory will be built in Campinas; 59 environmental health agents and two biologists will be hired; 14 vehicles and equipment procured. Total cost estimated at BRL 20–22 million, with about BRL 7 million from the Ministry. In late 2025, Campinas reported 3,368 dengue and 6 chikungunya in the week; top case sites included UPA Anchieta Metropolitana, UPA São José, Centro Médico, Hospital Santa Teresa, and Hospital Madre Theodora; no deaths.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスがデング熱対策のため「改変」蚊を用いたパイロットプロジェクトを実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱対策としてのWolbachia感染蚊を用いた予防プロジェクトの紹介であり、突発的なアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱は季節性流行病としてブラジルで継続的に発生しているが、本記事は予防的な公衆衛生プログラムの紹介であり、新規の異常事態ではない。参考情報として2025年末のカンピーナスにおけるデング熱症例数（週間3,368件）が記載されているが、死亡例はなく、通常の流行状況と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا أكبر من البيانات الرسمية بمعدل 2-4 مرات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak is larger than official data by a factor of 2-4.
article.articleSummary: 80% of new Ebola infections in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo have no known link to existing patients, according to a World Health Organization official, suggesting the outbreak’s true size could be 2–4 times higher than official counts. Current data list 1,792 cases and 625 deaths. About 90% of cases are in Ituri Province, with transmission also reported in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. In Bunia, the capital of Ituri, roughly half of those tested were positive, signaling sustained community transmission. The Bundibugyo strain implicated may cause milder symptoms, potentially delaying care and enabling further spread. Officials warn that under-detection means the outbreak could be larger than reported, even as some indicators point to progress in containment in less-affected areas. Key locations: Ituri, Bunia, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo; dates pertain to ongoing outbreak status through July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ出血熱の流行は公式データより2〜4倍規模が大きい
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラ流行の過小報告と大規模なコミュニティ内感染（80%が感染経路不明）を指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 感染経路不明な症例が80%に上り、実際の感染規模が公式統計の2〜4倍である可能性がWHOにより指摘されている。Bundibugyo株は症状が軽度なため受診遅延・感染拡大のリスクが高い。イトゥリ州ブニアでは検査陽性率約50%と地域内持続伝播が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa confirma foco de gripe aviária e mercado acompanha possível impacto no preço da carne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa confirms an avian influenza outbreak, and the market tracks the potential impact on meat prices.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Anvisa confirmed new avian influenza outbreaks, prompting renewed sanitary controls and heightened vigilance in the poultry sector. The virus affects wild and farmed birds, triggering strict surveillance, isolation of affected flocks, and sanitary measures to curb spread. Authorities reiterate that products from inspected sources remain safe for consumption when properly prepared. Economists warn that production or export restrictions on chicken meat could redirect demand toward beef and pork, potentially lifting prices if supply tight, though no price increases are confirmed yet. The market also monitors export partners, which may impose temporary restrictions on purchases from regions with detected cases, varying by trade agreement. Brazil continues applying control protocols to safeguard domestic production. Consumers are advised to buy from regulated suppliers, maintain proper hygiene, and monitor the evolving situation over the coming months.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa(ブラジル衛生監督庁)が鳥インフルエンザの発生を確認、市場は食肉価格への影響を注視
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの鳥インフルエンザ発生により輸出制限や貿易への影響が生じており、IHR基準（国際的拡大リスク・貿易制限リスク）に2つ該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家禽・野鳥における動物感染症の発生であり、人への感染事例は報告されていない。経済・貿易面（食肉価格、輸出制限）への影響が主な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação do sorotipo DENV-3 acende sinal de alerta para risco de surto | ContilNet Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Circulation of DENV-3 Serotype Raises Alarm Over Outbreak Risk
article.articleSummary: Dengue virus serotype 3 (DENV-3) has re-circulated in Acre, Brazil, identified in recent laboratory surveillance, raising public health concern. The Sesacre epidemiological bulletin SE 01–20/2026 reports a substantial reduction in overall dengue incidence in 2026 versus 2025, but simultaneous circulation of dengue serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2 and DENV-3 increases outbreak risk. DENV-2 and DENV-3 circulation remains low, with laboratory-confirmed cases concentrated in Rio Branco through the analyzed period. The bulletin warns that co-circulation heightens the risk of outbreaks and severe dengue in previously infected individuals and calls for intensified epidemiological and laboratory surveillance, vector control, and vaccination. Vaccination coverage is heterogeneous in Acre; the target is to improve complete vaccination (two doses) for children and adolescents aged 10–14 years. Emphasis on preventive measures and monitoring viral spread to avert recrudescence.

triage.headline_ja: DENV-3血清型の流行拡大が警鐘を鳴らす、アウトブレイクリスクの上昇
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の複数血清型（DENV-1/2/3）の共存流行が確認され重症化・アウトブレイクリスクが指摘されているが、現時点では全体的な発生数は減少しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の要素は見られない。
triage.notes: 地方公衆衛生当局（Sesacre）が血清型共存によるアウトブレイクリスクを警告し、サーベイランス強化とワクチン接種率向上を呼びかけている。全体の発生数は前年より減少傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgını yayılıyor: Salgın ilan edilen eyalet sayısı 4'e çıktı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in Congo: the number of states in which the outbreak has been declared has risen to four.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has expanded to four provinces. In Haut-Uele, northeast DRC, seven deaths have occurred, prompting authorities to declare an outbreak across Haut-Uele, making it the fourth province officially affected. Health officials say the outbreak remains in an active phase and has not yet peaked. Nationwide, three provinces are most affected, reporting 1,792 confirmed (laboratory-confirmed) cases, 625 deaths, and 295 recoveries to date. The report provides limited detail on infection sources or imported/exported cases beyond provincial declarations as of July 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行拡大：流行宣言された州の数が4に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で4州に拡大し、累計1,792例・625死亡と規模が大きく、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準も複数該当するため、フルRRAへ移行すべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（625/1792例、約35%）、複数州への拡大が続いており、国際的な支援・監視が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: American Tests Positive for Ebola in Congo, Will Be Evacuated
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-11, a US humanitarian worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola and will be evacuated to Europe for treatment, according to Samaritan's Purse, a religious humanitarian aid group. The patient is a US national who has worked with Samaritan's Purse's disaster response team for 15 years and has been active in Congo relief efforts. The organization says the infection is Ebola and intends to transfer the individual to a European medical facility for specialized care. The case represents an exported Ebola infection from Congo to Europe, underscoring the ongoing risk of Ebola exposure to international aid workers operating in the region. No further clinical details, location specifics, or travel timing are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がコンゴでエボラ陽性反応、ヨーロッパへ搬送予定
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染者が国際的に(ヨーロッパへ)搬送される事例であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染源はコンゴ民主共和国であり、搬送先の米国・欧州は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。詳細な発生地域や渡航歴、現地の流行状況については追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Un ciudadano estadounidense da positivo por ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen working with a humanitarian organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Ebola virus disease (EVD). The patient is among the ongoing Congo outbreak, described as Africa's fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date, with 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths in the DRC, and additional cases in Uganda. Congolese authorities declared the outbreak on May 15. The U.S. CDC is coordinating with the patient’s employer, federal agencies, and public health authorities to prevent further transmission and identify close contacts; no patient details were released. Earlier in the outbreak, an American physician in Congo also tested positive and was evacuated to Germany. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Containment has been hampered by limited funding, attacks on health centers, and eastern Congo conflict. Last week, clinical trials to develop a treatment began.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでアメリカ人男性がエボラウイルスに陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で「アフリカ史上最速拡大」とされる大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、米国人感染者やウガンダへの拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大やアメリカ人・ドイツへの搬送例も報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・米国・ドイツは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ資金不足・武力紛争により封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sulbar memercepat eliminasi TBC pada desa lokus program Garatta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Sulawesi Provincial Health Office accelerates TB elimination in the Garatta program's focal village.
article.articleSummary: West Sulawesi Province health authorities accelerate TB elimination through the Garatta TB program in Majene Regency. January–June 2026 screenings at three focal villages showed increased activity but uneven case detection. In Palipi Soreang (Totoli PHC), 30 suspected TB (65% of target 46) were found, with 7 diagnosed (78% of target 9). In Bonde (Pamboang PHC), 35 suspected TB (65% of target 54) and 2 diagnosed (20% of target 10). In Bonde Utara, 69 suspected TB (111% of target 62) with 7 diagnosed (54% of target 13). Bonde Utara exceeded its suspected-TB target, while overall conversion to diagnosed cases remains below target in several sites. The program emphasizes intensified community screening to identify at-risk individuals sooner and initiate treatment, highlighting collaboration among health workers, village governments, and community organizations as essential for TB elimination.

triage.headline_ja: 西スラウェシ州保健局、Garattaプログラムの重点村で結核根絶を加速
triage.triage_reason: 既存のTB対策プログラムの進捗報告であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 結核の通常のスクリーニング・診断プログラムに関する定例報告であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ciudadano de EEUU arroja positivo a ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American citizen tests positive for Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has tested positive for Ebola virus disease, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). The confirmation comes as the country seeks to contain a growing outbreak. The report provides no details on symptoms, hospitalization status, laboratory confirmation methods, infection source, or whether the case is imported or locally acquired. This incident adds to the ongoing public health response in central Africa as authorities implement containment measures and monitor potential further transmission. International health authorities, including the CDC, are tracking the development as of July 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 米国市民、コンゴでエボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当する重大疾患であり、米国人感染例かつ拡大中のアウトブレイクとの関連が示唆されるため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに関連する事例であり、感染源・症状詳細など情報不足のため続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Another US citizen tests positive for Ebola virus while working in Congo amid record outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo virus has reached 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, with Uganda also reporting cases. WHO says global spread risk remains low; transmission occurs via bodily fluids, not airborne. The Congolese authorities declared the outbreak on May 15. A second U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in the DRC has tested positive for Ebola, per the CDC, following the earlier case of Dr. Peter Stafford who recovered after evacuation to Germany in May and returned to the U.S. last month after testing negative. The CDC is coordinating with the employing organization, other U.S. agencies, and DRC authorities to conduct contact tracing and risk assessments to identify high-risk contacts. A French doctor recently tested positive in Paris; no U.S. cases have been detected. The U.S. has imposed enhanced health screenings and entry restrictions for non-U.S. citizens returning from the region. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの活動中に別の米国市民がエボラウイルス陽性反応、記録的な流行の最中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例1,830件・死亡648件に達する記録的なエボラ流行が進行中で、ウガンダやフランス・米国にも感染者が波及し、米国が入国制限を課すなど国際的な対応が取られているため。
triage.notes: WHOはグローバルな拡大リスクは低いとしているが、米国・フランスへの感染拡大や入国制限措置など国際的関心が高く、フルRRAでの評価が妥当。ウガンダ・米国・フランス・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: CDC證實：一美國公民在剛果金確診埃博拉 | 埃博拉病毒 | 川普 | 烏干達
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC confirms: An American citizen diagnosed with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | Ebola virus | Trump | Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-11, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirmed an American citizen diagnosed with Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient, a humanitarian worker, is infected with the Bundibugyo strain. In the DRC, authorities report 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths. The World Health Organization warns the true outbreak size may be two to four times higher than official counts. There are currently no cases identified in the United States. The Trump administration has requested $1.4 billion in supplemental funding from Congress to support outbreak response in the DRC and in neighboring Uganda. The report notes ongoing international response efforts surrounding this Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: CDC確認:米国市民がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱と診断される|エボラウイルス|トランプ|ウガンダ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが継続中で1,830例・648死亡が報告され、実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性がWHOにより指摘されている。国際的な人的移動を伴う感染例(米国人渡航者)や周辺国ウガンダへの拡大懸念、多額の国際支援要請があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 米国およびウガンダは発生地域として記載されているが、記事の主題は米国人患者がDRCで感染したこと及びDRCでの大規模アウトブレイクであり、米国・ウガンダは対象国リスト外/実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus outbreak offers lessons for the next pandemic
article.articleSummary: Andes virus hantavirus outbreak aboard expedition ship MV Hondius (May 2–13, 2026) caused 13 cases and 3 deaths among passengers and crew from 23 countries, with the voyage sailing from the southern tip of South America toward the Canary Islands. Investigators traced the source to a Dutch birdwatcher who contracted the virus on land in Chile and Argentina and infected others aboard before dying. Andes virus is the only hantavirus known to spread between people, via respiratory droplets; most hantaviruses are rodent-borne. The outbreak remained contained, with 16 contacts monitored in Nebraska and some exposed individuals quarantined in the United States, while Canada monitored at home. Public fear outpaced evidence; the response relied on WHO guidance, CDC leadership, and academic collaborators. The episode contrasts with a larger Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (500+ cases, ~100 deaths) and with a 2018–2019 Argentine Andes outbreak (34 cases, 11 deaths) stopped by self-isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスの発生、次のパンデミックへの教訓を提供
triage.triage_reason: アンデスウイルス（ハンタウイルス）によるヒト-ヒト感染が確認され、23か国籍の乗客・乗員に影響し複数国で接触者監視・隔離が行われた点で、異常性と国際的拡大の基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 本イベントはチリ・アルゼンチン発の探検船（MV Hondius）上でのアンデスウイルス（ハンタウイルス）アウトブレイクであり、発生・拡大国（チリ、アルゼンチン、米国、カナダ、カナリア諸島/スペイン）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれない。記事中でDRCのエボラ流行（500例以上、死者約100人）が比較対象として言及されているが、これは本イベントの主題ではなく過去の別事例としての引用であるためverified_locationsには含めない。アウトブレイク自体はすでに終息しており（2026年5月）、続報の必要性は低いが、ヒト-ヒト感染するハンタウイルスという稀有な事例のため学術的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果爆伊波拉病毒感染　赴當地美籍救援人員確診 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo; American rescuers who traveled to the area diagnosed with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus infection detected in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) involving an American humanitarian worker. The patient, affiliated with a local relief organization operating in the DRC, tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus. CDC confirmed the case on Friday and said it is coordinating with the worker’s organization, other U.S. federal agencies, and Congolese partners to prevent further spread, including tracing high-risk close contacts. The U.S. State Department acknowledged the case on Saturday and is providing assistance to the affected American citizen, while privacy protections limit details on the patient’s condition and treatment. The response emphasizes containment, surveillance, and protection of workers in the region amid Ebola activity in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱発生、現地に派遣された米国人救援者が感染確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）発生に加え、米国人援助従事者の感染が確認され、CDC・米国務省が対応に関与するなど国際的拡大の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。CDCが接触者追跡を実施中であり、DRC国内での二次感染拡大リスクに注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Στους 648 οι νεκροί από Έμπολα - Γιατί η νέα έξαρση προκαλεί παγκόσμια ανησυχία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola death toll reaches 648 — Why the latest outbreak is causing global concern.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's latest Ebola outbreak has produced 648 deaths among 1,830 laboratory-confirmed cases, less than two months after the outbreak was declared on May 15. The 17th epidemic in the country is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific therapy, unlike the more common Zaire strain. Ebola causes severe hemorrhagic fever and has claimed more than 15,000 lives across Africa in five decades. The Democratic Republic of Congo has endured previous deadly outbreaks, most notably 2018–2020, when nearly 2,300 people died from about 3,500 cases. The current situation is attracting heightened global concern due to the lack of a targeted vaccine and treatment for Bundibugyo, complicating control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラによる死者648人に達す — なぜ今回の流行が世界的懸念を引き起こしているのか
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行で死者648人、承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在せず国際的拡大・対応能力の懸念が大きいため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特効薬がなく、ザイール株より対応が困難。致死率約35%(648/1830)と高く、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威となりうる。

article.articleHeadline: Another U.S. Citizen Tests Positive for Ebola While Working in Congo Amid Record Outbreak - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: A U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization in Democratic Republic of the Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo virus, a form of Ebola, CDC said. The patient’s name was not released, and this marks the second American known to have contracted Ebola in current outbreak. First case, Dr. Peter Stafford, was evacuated to Germany in May and has since recovered. Congo outbreak—declared May 15 and described as Africa’s fastest-growing Ebola outbreak—reports 1,830 confirmed cases and 648 deaths, with cases in Uganda. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment. CDC is coordinating with the employer, U.S. agencies, Congolese public health authorities, and local partners to limit spread via contact tracing and risk assessments for high-risk exposures. In Paris, a French doctor tested positive after returning home; no U.S. cases, and WHO says outbreak risk remains low. U.S. entry screenings for travelers returning from the region have been increased.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの記録的アウトブレイクの中、別の米国市民がエボラ陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でアフリカ最速拡大とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)アウトブレイクが発生し、1,830例確定・648死亡、ウガンダへの拡大や米国人・フランス人感染者も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 米国・フランス・ウガンダでの感染者報告もあるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyo virusによるアウトブレイクで、致死率が高く国際的懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Rebels, Hospital Worker Strikes, and Ebola: How Fractured Governance Is Fueling Congo's Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues in Ituri Province, with Bunia as epicenter. Since May 15, 1,561 cases have been confirmed and 506 deaths reported, over 500 fatalities overall. Frontline workers—epidemiological surveillance, safety and security, community outreach, and burial teams—have begun striking over unpaid wages and bonuses, while Bunia airport closure hampers response. Ebola cases have reached the rebel-held zone, including a single infection in Goma, raising concern about spread to M23-controlled areas such as Goma and Bukavu. WHO and the DRC have launched a clinical trial in affected regions to test MBP134 monoclonal antibodies, remdesivir, or a combination; enrollment has begun, with meaningful results potentially taking several months to about a year. The situation is worsened by fractured governance, logistics disruptions, and attacks on isolation wards, underscoring the need for stable funding, logistics, and trust.

triage.headline_ja: 反政府勢力、病院職員のストライキ、そしてエボラ:統治の分裂がコンゴの流行をどう悪化させているか
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で1,561症例・506人以上の死亡を伴うエボラ流行が継続し、反政府勢力支配地域（ゴマ）にも拡大するなど国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められるため、フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株という名称はウガンダ由来だが、現在の流行地はDRCイトゥリ州（ブニア中心）であり、ウガンダでの発生は記事中に確認されないため除外した。反政府勢力支配地域（ゴマ、ブカブ）への拡大が懸念されており、対応要員のストライキや空港閉鎖が状況を悪化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết tại Huế tăng, ngành y tế cảnh báo bước vào cao điểm dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever in Hue is rising; health authorities warn that the outbreak is entering its peak.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Hue, Vietnam, is entering its peak season. For the first six months of 2026, Hue reported 143 dengue cases across 27 communes, up 9.1% from the same period last year, including 2 clinical cases and 7 imported cases, with no deaths. Laboratory typing on 38 samples found 26 positives: 11 Dengue virus serotype 1 (D1) and 15 serotype 2 (D2). Kim Long Ward accounted for the most cases (53, 37% of Hue’s total). The rise is linked to high vector indices, many outdoor water containers, ongoing urbanization, tourism, and festivals, with uneven community participation in control measures. Hue CDC conducts surveillance with 24–48 hour investigations and vector control, including 2–3 rounds of insecticide spraying 7–10 days apart until 14 days pass without new cases. Advice: seal water containers, use fish to deter larvae, remove breeding sites weekly, and seek care for fever; avoid aspirin or ibuprofen unless advised.

triage.headline_ja: フエ省でデング熱が増加、保健当局が流行ピークに入ったと警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的増加であり、死亡例なし・地域限定的だが、流行のピーク入りとして当局が注意喚起しており経過観察の対象とする。
triage.notes: フエ市（Hue）における季節性デング熱の増加。死亡例なし、地域保健当局が対応中で外部支援の必要性は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO estimates Congo Ebola outbreak far exceeds official figures
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, dominated by Ituri Province, with 1,792 confirmed cases and 625 deaths reported as of 12 July 2026; about 90% of cases are in Ituri, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo. WHO notes that roughly 80% of new infections cannot be linked to known cases, indicating extensive community transmission. Bunia shows consistently high test positivity, signifying ongoing transmission despite progress in other areas. The figures align with an earlier report citing 1,759 confirmed cases and 600 deaths. This laboratory-confirmed outbreak emphasizes Ebola infection, with no specific infection source detailed beyond unlinked cases and no exported/imported case information provided.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ流行は公式統計を大幅に上回ると推定
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,792例の確定症例と625人の死亡が報告され、新規感染の約80%が既知の感染源と紐付けられないなど、広範な地域社会感染が示唆されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Ituri州が中心だが、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tshopoにも拡大。80%の新規感染が感染経路不明であり、地域社会での持続的な感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织官员：非洲埃博拉疫情规模或远超统计
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO official: Africa's Ebola outbreak may be far larger than official figures.
article.articleSummary: On July 10, 2026, WHO Emergency Programme head Chikwe Ihekweazu warned that Africa’s Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be far larger than official tallies, with many infections undetected. In some areas of the DRC, roughly four of every five new Ebola cases have no known link to existing patients, and the outbreak’s true size could be two to four times higher than reported. About 90% of confirmed Ebola cases remain in Ituri Province, though transmission has spread to neighboring provinces. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific therapeutic option. The statement highlights under-detection and continued spread despite containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO当局者:アフリカのエボラ流行、公式統計を大きく上回る可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHO幹部がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が公式統計を大幅に上回る可能性を指摘し、感染連鎖不明の症例が多く、ワクチン・治療薬も無いため国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行で、感染源不明の症例が約8割を占め過小報告の懸念が強い。WHOによる公式声明であり信頼性が高い。
